items.title: Cordis 与无特权核心
items.supports: 全部产品部件都是插件；通过共享 context 的 service、typed event 和 reversible effect 组合。
items.titleEn: Cordis and the unprivileged core
items.supportsEn: Every product component is a plugin composed through services, typed events, and reversible effects on a shared context.

items.title: Profile、Bundle 与 patch 叠层
items.supports: 运行时插件树按 bundle、profile patch、home patch、CLI overlay 的顺序组合。
items.titleEn: Profile, bundle, and patch layers
items.supportsEn: The runtime plugin tree is composed in bundle, profile patch, home patch, and CLI overlay order.

items.title: Turn / Step 主流程
items.supports: turn、step、prompt、LLM、工具与 live waterfall 的关系。
items.titleEn: Turn and step flow
items.supportsEn: The relationship among turns, steps, prompts, LLM calls, tools, and live waterfalls.

items.title: Session log 与 capability seam
items.supports: 日志是模型上下文事实源；model-visible 必须可从日志重建；seam 包含定义、提供者与消费者。
items.titleEn: Session log and capability seams
items.supportsEn: The log is the source of truth for model context; model-visible data must be reconstructable, and a seam includes definition, provider, and consumer.

items.title: Developer Preview 的兼容立场
items.supports: 首个 tag 前优先正确基础而非兼容 shim；磁盘格式没有兼容承诺。
items.titleEn: Developer Preview compatibility posture
items.supportsEn: Before the first tag, sound foundations take precedence over compatibility shims, and on-disk formats carry no compatibility promise.

items.title: 注册即 effect 与 waterfall 语义
items.supports: 贡献通过 effect/on 注册并可处置；waterfall listener 必须调用 next。
items.titleEn: Registration as effects and waterfall semantics
items.supportsEn: Contributions register through effect/on and are disposable; waterfall listeners must call next.

items.title: Model-visible 等价于 Logged
items.supports: 任何进入模型请求的输入都需要 session event，可从日志重建。
items.titleEn: Model-visible means logged
items.supportsEn: Every input entering a model request requires a session event and must be reconstructable from the log.

items.title: 显式边界与快速失败
items.supports: 跨包默认值显式 resolve，部署参数可配置，错误配置尽早失败，外部 ID 使用 branded 类型。
items.titleEn: Explicit boundaries and fail-fast behavior
items.supportsEn: Cross-package defaults resolve explicitly, deployment parameters are configurable, invalid configuration fails early, and external IDs use branded types.

items.title: 静态边界和运行时边界的验证哲学
items.supports: 同进程静态类型边界信任 TypeScript；解析、模型 JSON、持久化、进程、worker 与 wire 边界做运行时验证。
items.titleEn: Validation at static and runtime boundaries
items.supportsEn: Same-process statically typed values trust TypeScript, while parsing, model JSON, persistence, processes, workers, and wire boundaries receive runtime validation.

items.title: 工具执行管线
items.supports: pre、单调 guard、around execute、post、normalization、finalize 和 immutable result 的完整顺序。
items.titleEn: Tool execution pipeline
items.supportsEn: The complete order of pre hooks, monotonic guards, around execution, post hooks, normalization, finalization, and immutable results.

items.title: Agent turn/step 时序
items.supports: 输入认领、durable events、并行工具结算、停止点和 SDK 事件面的时序。
items.titleEn: Agent turn and step sequence
items.supportsEn: The sequence of input claims, durable events, parallel tool settlement, stop points, and SDK-facing events.

items.title: 包分组与依赖方向
items.supports: 49 个 package group 的职责、发布预期以及 extension 只依赖 service definition 的方向规则。
items.titleEn: Package groups and dependency direction
items.supportsEn: Responsibilities and publication expectations for 49 package groups, plus the rule that extensions depend only on service definitions.

items.title: Package 生命周期与不变量规则
items.supports: 插件导出、组合测试、owner、commit point、disposal 和每包 invariant 的约束。
items.titleEn: Package lifecycle and invariant rules
items.supportsEn: Constraints for plugin exports, composition tests, ownership, commit points, disposal, and per-package invariants.

items.title: CLI 启动模式分派
items.supports: CLI 解析后仅分派 profile、plugin 与 dump-config；profile 路径传入环境快照、profile、patch 与内部参数。
items.titleEn: CLI launch-mode dispatch
items.supportsEn: After parsing, the CLI dispatches only profile, plugin, and dump-config modes; the profile path receives the environment snapshot, profile, patches, and inner arguments.

items.title: 空根配置与 Profile 准备
items.supports: 每次启动重写空根 cordis.yml，实际树完全由 patch 层构成，并避免 Loader write-back 烘焙组合结果。
items.titleEn: Empty root and profile preparation
items.supportsEn: Every launch rewrites an empty cordis.yml; patches define the entire real tree and prevent Loader write-back from baking in composed rows.

items.title: Profile patch 的实际组合顺序
items.supports: bundle、profile、home、CLI overlay、启动器 preset 与 telemetry overlay 的应用顺序以及行索引构建。
items.titleEn: Effective profile patch order
items.supportsEn: The application order for bundle, profile, home, CLI, launcher preset, and telemetry overlays, including construction of the row index.

items.title: 用户 patch 的在线重组
items.supports: 每代重新读取两个用户层、克隆 patch 防止引用污染，并在缺少 HMR 时挂载只监听配置的实例。
items.titleEn: Live recomposition of user patches
items.supportsEn: Each generation rereads both user layers, clones patches to prevent reference contamination, and mounts a config-only HMR instance when needed.

items.title: Profile 目录与内置模板
items.supports: profile 名校验、web/headless bundle 模板、默认 base bundle，以及幂等初始化的三个文件。
items.titleEn: Profile directories and built-in templates
items.supportsEn: Profile-name validation, web/headless bundle templates, the default base bundle, and idempotent initialization of three files.

items.title: Profile 的扁平模块 fallback
items.supports: 对 dependencies 与 peerDependencies 做 BFS，从安装位置建立 profiles/node_modules 符号链接闭包。
items.titleEn: Flat module fallback for profiles
items.supportsEn: A breadth-first traversal of dependencies and peerDependencies creates a profiles/node_modules symlink closure from installation locations.

items.title: Bundle 解析与同构组合
items.supports: 按 manifest 顺序解析 bundle 声明，缺失 dsh.bundle 时失败，并用与启动相同的 applyEntryPatches 在空根上组合。
items.titleEn: Bundle resolution and isomorphic composition
items.supportsEn: Bundle declarations resolve in manifest order, missing dsh.bundle metadata fails, and the same applyEntryPatches operation used by boot composes over an empty root.

items.title: 事务化用户配置刷新
items.supports: HMR 精确监听用户 patch，重新生成完整 patch 列表并通过 entry.update 事务化替换；退出竞态返回空 disposer。
items.titleEn: Transactional user-configuration refresh
items.supportsEn: HMR watches the exact user patch, regenerates the full patch list, and replaces it transactionally through entry.update; shutdown races return a no-op disposer.

items.title: 事务化启动与失败清理
items.supports: host prepare 先于树挂载，Loader settle 后检查激活；任意失败先处置部分根并保留最深层错误栈。
items.titleEn: Transactional boot and failure cleanup
items.supportsEn: Host preparation precedes tree mounting, activation is audited after Loader settlement, and any failure disposes the partial root while preserving the deepest error stack.

items.title: Base bundle 的 patch 与激活语义
items.supports: base 是空根上的一次 insert；后层按 id 最后写入；config 整体替换；行顺序不承载加载语义。
items.titleEn: Base-bundle patch and activation semantics
items.supportsEn: Base is one insert over an empty root; later layers are last-write-wins by ID, config is replaced wholesale, and row order carries no load semantics.

items.title: Base bundle 的运行时骨架
items.supports: base 直接装配 LLM、session、API、agent、jobs、retry、settings、credentials、adapter 与 JSONL persistence 等共享服务。
items.titleEn: The base bundle runtime spine
items.supportsEn: Base directly assembles shared LLM, session, API, agent, jobs, retry, settings, credentials, adapter, and JSONL persistence services.

items.title: Headless 产品面
items.supports: headless 不挂载 Host、HTTP、Web 或浏览器插件，只增加代码运行时、启动参数 provider 与一次性 Agent driver。
items.titleEn: The headless product surface
items.supportsEn: Headless mounts no Host, HTTP, Web, or browser plugins; it adds only the code runtime, launch-argument provider, and a one-shot Agent driver.

items.title: Web 的 host plane 与 agent plane 分界
items.supports: Web 禁用 base 中每 Agent 能力行，由每会话 preset 挂载；跨会话 registry 与 host API 依赖服务保留在 host plane。
items.titleEn: The Web host-plane and agent-plane boundary
items.supportsEn: Web disables per-Agent capability rows from base and mounts them through per-session presets, while cross-session registries and host-API dependencies remain in the host plane.

items.title: Bundle 与用户层顺序测试
items.supports: 测试验证 bundle manifest 顺序、后层整块配置覆盖以及无用户层的空组合。
items.titleEn: Bundle and user-layer ordering test
items.supportsEn: The test verifies bundle manifest order, wholesale configuration replacement by later layers, and empty composition without a user layer.

items.title: HMR 保留最后成功配置测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖新增、应用失败、解析失败、恢复与删除，失败候选不会替换上一棵有效插件树。
items.titleEn: HMR last-known-good configuration test
items.supportsEn: The test covers addition, apply failure, parse failure, recovery, and removal; failed candidates never replace the previous valid plugin tree.

items.title: Agent 公共接口与状态语义
items.supports: 定义 provider/model/maxTokens、idle/running、session/inbox/scoped context，以及 cancel、idle、maintenance 和四种输入操作。
items.titleEn: Public Agent interface and status semantics
items.supportsEn: Defines provider/model/maxTokens, idle/running state, session/inbox/scoped context, cancellation, idle observation, maintenance, and four input operations.

items.title: 不可见 setup、commit 与 owned handle 合同
items.supports: create/resume setup 在对象未发布时构建 scoped world，可返回同步 commit；AgentHandle 是拥有 teardown 权限的 capability。
items.titleEn: Unpublished setup, commit, and owned-handle contract
items.supportsEn: Create/resume setup composes the scoped world while objects remain unpublished and may return a synchronous commit; AgentHandle is the teardown capability.

items.title: Registry 与具体 loop 之间的 factory seam
items.supports: Registry effect-scoped 注册唯一 factory，并通过调用者 context 重新 trace create/resume，使所有权跟随真正消费者。
items.titleEn: Factory seam between the registry and concrete loop
items.supportsEn: The registry effect-scopes one factory and retraces create/resume through the caller context so ownership follows the actual consumer.

items.title: AgentRegistry enter、announce 与精确 detach
items.supports: enter 验证共享身份并仲裁冲突，announce 单次发布；重入 detach 延迟到 dispatch 结束，陈旧 closure 不能删除同 ID replacement。
items.titleEn: AgentRegistry enter, announce, and exact detach
items.supportsEn: Enter verifies shared identity and arbitrates collisions, announce publishes once, reentrant detach waits for dispatch, and stale closures cannot delete a same-ID replacement.

items.title: 进程内 initiator 归因 API
items.supports: current/require/with/withoutInitiator 用 AsyncLocalStorage 传递当前 driver 的因果 Agent，但不把 ambient identity 当作授权。
items.titleEn: Process-local initiator attribution API
items.supportsEn: current/require/with/withoutInitiator propagate the causal Agent of a driver through AsyncLocalStorage without treating ambient identity as authorization.

items.title: Initiator teardown 的 drain 语义
items.supports: 服务关闭后拒绝新 boundary，等待已返回的 Promise boundary 结算，排除启动自身卸载的嵌套链以避免自锁，最后 disable storage。
items.titleEn: Initiator teardown drain semantics
items.supportsEn: Shutdown rejects new boundaries, drains returned-Promise boundaries, excludes nested chains that initiated their own unload to avoid deadlock, and finally disables storage.

items.title: Inbox 的事件重建与 claim 顺序
items.supports: Inbox 从 seed boundary 之后的 durable splice 重建；claim 总是先取全部 next-step，再按需取一个 next-turn，并逐消息通知。
items.titleEn: Inbox event reconstruction and claim order
items.supportsEn: Inbox reconstructs durable splices after the seed boundary; a claim takes every next-step item first and optionally one next-turn item, then notifies per message.

items.title: Inbox splice 的耐久提交与身份不变量
items.supports: 先 append agent/inbox/spliced 再改 live projection；删除可标 canceled；MessageId 在两个 pending 列表上全局唯一。
items.titleEn: Durable inbox-splice commit and identity invariant
items.supportsEn: agent/inbox/spliced is appended before the live projection mutates, removals may be marked canceled, and MessageId is unique across both pending lists.

items.title: 具体 Agent 的 scope、phase 与输入映射
items.supports: ReactLoopAgent 从日志恢复 turn 与 inbox，创建 agent scope，idle/maintenance 映射为 idle，followup/steer/inject 映射到两级 inbox，cancel 默认清空。
items.titleEn: Concrete Agent scope, phase, and input mapping
items.supportsEn: ReactLoopAgent restores turns and inbox state from the log, creates an Agent scope, maps idle/maintenance to idle, routes followup/steer/inject into two inbox levels, and clears pending work on cancel by default.

items.title: Agent 准备、发布与反向 teardown
items.supports: 在资源创建前融合 caller/factory/owner 取消；发布顺序为 session enter、agent enter、session announce、agent announce、session-start；dispose 共享同一 quiescence。
items.titleEn: Agent preparation, publication, and reverse teardown
items.supportsEn: Caller, factory, and owner cancellation fuse before resources exist; publication orders session enter, agent enter, session announce, agent announce, and session-start; disposal shares one quiescence boundary.

items.title: Create、setupAndPublish 与 resume 控制流
items.supports: 新 session 与持久化 session 汇合到同一 prepare/setup/commit/publish 路径；resume load 也受 owner、caller 和 factory 取消约束。
items.titleEn: Create, setupAndPublish, and resume control flow
items.supportsEn: Fresh and persisted sessions converge on one prepare/setup/commit/publish path, while resume loading is also bounded by owner, caller, and factory cancellation.

items.title: 原子发布、并发同 ID 与 creation-only signal 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 setup 完成前两个 registry 均不可见、发布事件有序、并发准备仅一方进入，且 creation signal 不影响已返回 handle。
items.titleEn: Atomic publication, concurrent same-ID, and creation-only signal tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove both registries stay unpublished through setup, announcements are ordered, only one concurrent preparation enters, and a creation signal cannot cancel a returned live handle.

items.title: 创建通知内重入 teardown 的顺序测试
items.supports: 测试证明通知 dispatch 中 registry 对所有 listener 保持稳定；rollback 依次卸载 scope、发布 agent/disposed，再发布 session/disposed。
items.titleEn: Reentrant teardown ordering during creation notifications
items.supportsEn: Tests prove the registry remains stable for every listener during notification; rollback then unwinds scope, emits agent/disposed, and emits session/disposed in order.

items.title: Inbox replay、替换、唯一身份与取消测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖非法持久化 splice、跨队列 replace、重复 MessageId 拒绝，以及 clear 生成两条 canceled durable splice。
items.titleEn: Inbox replay, replacement, unique identity, and cancellation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover invalid persisted splices, replacement across queues, duplicate MessageId rejection, and clear producing two durable canceled splices.

items.title: Registry split publication 与陈旧 detach 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 enter 与 announce 分离、detach 幂等、旧 capability 不删除 replacement，以及 created listener 中 detach 延迟到全部 listener 返回。
items.titleEn: Registry split-publication and stale-detach tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove enter and announce are separate, detach is idempotent, stale capabilities cannot delete replacements, and detach from a created listener waits for every listener to return.

items.title: Driver containment 与 pre-step 准备
items.supports: kick 把 turn 失败和取消收敛到 driver 边界；preStep 先 claim、组装 prompt、投影动态上下文，再进入 agent/pre-step waterfall。
items.titleEn: Driver containment and pre-step preparation
items.supportsEn: kick contains turn failure and cancellation at the driver boundary; preStep claims input, assembles the prompt, projects runtime context, and then enters the agent/pre-step waterfall.

items.title: Turn 状态机与结束原因
items.supports: turn/start 先于 claim；reject、空首步、step 循环、turn-stopping、异常归一化、turn/end 与连续 queued turn 的全部分支。
items.titleEn: Turn state machine and end reasons
items.supportsEn: Covers turn/start before claims, reject, empty initial steps, the step loop, turn-stopping, error normalization, turn/end, and consecutive queued turns.

items.title: Step 的模型流与工具续跑
items.supports: 每次 request 从 deriveMessages 构建，chunk 逐条落日志，成功必写 assistant/message；max-tokens、无工具、工具 concluded 与继续下一步分支明确。
items.titleEn: Step model stream and tool continuation
items.supportsEn: Each request uses deriveMessages, logs every chunk, and writes assistant/message on success; max-tokens, no-tool, concluded-tool, and continuation branches are explicit.

items.title: 可重建冻结请求的构建
items.supports: request waterfall、exact-adapter prepareCall、adapter default 标记、request/header、request/context 与最终 frozen marked request 的顺序。
items.titleEn: Construction of reconstructable frozen requests
items.supportsEn: Shows the request waterfall, exact-adapter prepareCall, adapter-default markers, request/header, request/context, and the final frozen marked request in order.

items.title: 动态 runtime context 投影
items.supports: 从 retained surface 恢复最近 snapshot，监听 replacement，只有内容变化时生成未提交 user message，空集合用 cleared marker 覆盖旧语义。
items.titleEn: Dynamic runtime-context projection
items.supportsEn: Restores the latest retained snapshot from the surface, follows replacements, proposes an uncommitted user message only on change, and uses a cleared marker to retire old semantics.

items.title: LLM 请求的日志重建不变量
items.supports: 对 loop-marked request 检查冻结、live session、step/header 存在，并独立对比 deriveMessages 与 folded header。
items.titleEn: Log-reconstruction invariant for LLM requests
items.supportsEn: For loop-marked requests, verifies freezing, a live session, step/header presence, and independently compares deriveMessages and the folded header.

items.title: 简单 turn 与工具 round-trip 顺序测试
items.supports: 测试证明 inbox receipt 先于 turn，四个边界严格嵌套，assistant usage 持久化，工具 call/result 进入第二次派生请求。
items.titleEn: Simple-turn and tool-round-trip ordering tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove inbox receipt precedes the turn, four boundaries nest strictly, assistant usage is durable, and tool call/result enter the second derived request.

items.title: 空 continuation、blocked 与 pre-step 并发输入测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 completed 后空 decision 不开新 step、reject 只留 turn 边界，以及 claim 之后注入的 steer/inject 保留到下一步或下一次 wake。
items.titleEn: Empty continuation, blocked step, and concurrent pre-step input tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover an empty post-completion decision opening no step, rejection retaining only turn boundaries, and steer/inject arriving after a claim remaining for the next step or wake.

items.title: Request error recovery 边界测试
items.supports: 中间件失败不进入 recovery；provider failure 可在同一步多次 retry；取消优先于 retry；recovery listener 失败使 turn error。
items.titleEn: Request-error recovery boundary tests
items.supportsEn: Middleware failures bypass recovery, provider failures may retry repeatedly within one step, cancellation beats retry, and a failing recovery listener ends the turn in error.

items.title: 每次请求仅凭日志 byte-equal 重建测试
items.supports: 跨工具 step、后续 turn、prompt 与 request config 变化，测试用新 Session 从 dispatch 前事件重建 messages 和 folded header 并逐字段相等。
items.titleEn: Byte-equal request reconstruction from the log
items.supportsEn: Across tool steps, later turns, prompt changes, and request-config changes, a fresh Session rebuilds messages and folded headers from pre-dispatch events with field equality.

items.title: Abort 与 sticky max-tokens 结果测试
items.supports: 测试确认中途取消写 aborted；max-tokens 是当前 turn 内 sticky，但不泄漏到下一 turn，且截断 step 不执行 tool call。
items.titleEn: Abort and sticky max-tokens outcome tests
items.supportsEn: Tests confirm mid-stream cancellation records aborted, max-tokens is sticky within one turn but not across turns, and a truncated step does not execute tool calls.

items.title: 错误耐久化与 loop unload 测试
items.supports: 模型错误同时成为 live agent/error 与 durable turn/end error；中途卸载 owner 会停止 driver 并从 registry 移除。
items.titleEn: Durable error and loop-unload tests
items.supportsEn: A model failure becomes both live agent/error and durable turn/end error; unloading an owner mid-turn stops the driver and removes it from the registry.

items.title: Cordis 的服务、事件、waterfall 与 effect 语义
items.supports: 插件通过 service key 解耦实现，通过声明式 inject 等待依赖，通过 typed event 协作，并由可逆 effect 绑定注册与卸载。
items.titleEn: Cordis service, event, waterfall, and effect semantics
items.supportsEn: Plugins decouple implementations through service keys, wait through declarative injection, coordinate through typed events, and bind registration to teardown with reversible effects.

items.title: 所有权、提交点、边界和包级不变量规则
items.supports: 异步操作需要单一生命周期所有者；能力合同由全部消费者塑造；状态只能在提交点发布；限制必须作用于完整结果；每包拥有自己的运行时不变量。
items.titleEn: Ownership, commit-point, boundary, and package-invariant rules
items.supportsEn: Asynchronous work needs one lifecycle owner; capability contracts serve all consumers; state publishes only at commit; bounds apply to complete results; and each package owns its runtime invariants.

items.title: 作用域可见性与 effect 所有权的统一实现
items.supports: ScopedLayers 把全局贡献与作用域链叠加，最近作用域覆盖同名项；注册上下文同时决定可见性和 effect 所有权，撤销后回收空层。
items.titleEn: Unified scope visibility and effect ownership
items.supportsEn: ScopedLayers overlays global and scope-chain contributions with the nearest scope winning; the registration context determines both visibility and effect ownership, and undo reclaims empty layers.

items.title: 作用域继承、隔离和反向清理测试
items.supports: 测试验证最近 tag、同步注册、共享 quiescence、反序 teardown、按 key 路由，以及事件只向祖先作用域可见而不向后代泄漏。
items.titleEn: Scope inheritance, isolation, and reverse-teardown tests
items.supportsEn: Tests verify nearest tags, synchronous registration, shared quiescence, reverse teardown, key-based routing, and events flowing to ancestor scopes without leaking down to descendants.

items.title: 包归属的运行时不变量注册器
items.supports: 不变量按 package 选择和唯一注册，在服务自有 child fiber 中运行；失败携带 package 归属，安装失败与处置都会释放注册。
items.titleEn: Package-owned runtime invariant registry
items.supportsEn: Invariants are selected and uniquely registered per package, run in service-owned child fibers, attribute failures to their package, and release registrations on failed setup or disposal.

items.title: Prompt 五类可逆注册与默认 section
items.supports: SystemPrompt 以 scoped effect 注册 section、context、runtime-context suppressor、tool provider 和 variable；默认 identity 与 persona 也是普通 section。
items.titleEn: Five reversible prompt registrations and default sections
items.supportsEn: SystemPrompt effect-registers scoped sections, contexts, runtime-context suppressors, tool providers, and variables; the default identity and persona are ordinary sections too.

items.title: 每次 assembly 的精确求值与 waterfall 顺序
items.supports: 先融合 scope/variables/named entries，快照并求值 tool providers，再排序和求值 sections/contexts，canonicalize tools，最后运行 waterfall 并重施 complete/suppression 约束。
items.titleEn: Exact evaluation and waterfall order of each assembly
items.supportsEn: Assembly merges scope, variables, and named entries; snapshots and evaluates tool providers; orders and evaluates sections and contexts; canonicalizes tools; then runs the waterfall before reapplying complete and suppression constraints.

items.title: Section/context 的严格变量插值
items.supports: 渲染丢弃空项并严格校验变量名、存在性和值；阻止 prototype lookup 和递归插值，对 malformed 引用快速失败。
items.titleEn: Strict section and context interpolation
items.supportsEn: Rendering drops empty entries and strictly validates variable names, ownership, and values; it blocks prototype lookup and recursive interpolation and fails on malformed references.

items.title: Scoped persona 覆盖与 provider 不求值测试
items.supports: 测试证明同名 scoped section 只覆盖对应 scope，global view 不受影响，且 shadow 发生在 text provider 求值前。
items.titleEn: Scoped persona shadowing and provider non-evaluation test
items.supportsEn: Tests prove a same-name scoped section shadows only its scope, leaves the global view intact, and prevents evaluation of the shadowed text provider.

items.title: Provider membership、complete 与 assembly snapshot 测试
items.supports: 测试固定 tool-provider membership 快照、complete section 恢复/冲突，以及对一次 assembly 的修改不会泄漏到下一次。
items.titleEn: Provider membership, complete section, and assembly snapshot tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin tool-provider membership snapshots, complete-section restoration and conflicts, and isolation of mutations between assemblies.

items.title: 变量 live iteration 与严格插值测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖同一 generation 新增 variable、unknown/undefined/malformed 引用、prototype 名和替换值不递归扫描。
items.titleEn: Variable live iteration and strict interpolation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover same-generation variable registration, unknown, undefined, and malformed references, prototype-like names, and non-recursive substitution values.

items.title: Tool schema 的确定性排序规则
items.supports: 默认按 code-unit 字典序；显式顺序必须包含唯一 rest marker，未知名失败，已知但被 scope 隐藏的工具可缺席。
items.titleEn: Deterministic tool-schema ordering rules
items.supportsEn: The default is code-unit lexicographic order; explicit ordering requires one rest marker, rejects unknown names, and permits known tools hidden in a scope to be absent.

items.title: 每个拟执行 step 的 prompt 组装边界
items.supports: preStep 先 claim，再 assemble、渲染 runtime context、生成候选消息并进入 pre-step waterfall；reject 或空首步可能在已组装后仍不开 step。
items.titleEn: Prompt assembly boundary for every proposed step
items.supportsEn: PreStep claims input, assembles the prompt, renders runtime context, proposes its message, and enters the pre-step waterfall; rejection or an empty initial step can still avoid opening a step after assembly.

items.title: 同一 step 内 retry 不重新组装 prompt
items.supports: System 在 retry loop 外从 assembly 渲染；每次 provider retry 重新 build request 与 derive messages，但复用该 step 的 assembly 与 tool schema。
items.titleEn: Provider retries do not reassemble the prompt within a step
items.supportsEn: The system prompt is rendered from the assembly outside the retry loop; provider retries rebuild the request and derive messages while reusing that step's assembly and tool schemas.

items.title: 请求 header 的 canonicalization、比较与 fold
items.supports: 空 system/tool 字段归一为缺席；比较覆盖 config、adapter defaults、system 与有序 schema；离线 fold 取最后一份完整 snapshot。
items.titleEn: Request-header canonicalization, comparison, and folding
items.supportsEn: Empty system and tool fields canonicalize to absence; equality covers config, adapter defaults, system, and ordered schemas; offline folding takes the latest full snapshot.

items.title: 稳定 prompt 不写 header、真实变化写完整 snapshot 测试
items.supports: 测试证明每 step 重组装不会因值相同追加 header；真正 system prompt 变化写 reason=change 的第二份完整 header 且保留历史。
items.titleEn: Stable prompts omit headers while real changes write full snapshots
items.supportsEn: Tests prove per-step reassembly adds no header when values are equal; a real system-prompt change writes a second full header with reason change while preserving history.

items.title: 真实 DeepSeek API 前缀缓存测试
items.supports: 有 API key 时的 E2E 要求首请求后的每次 assistant usage 都报告正数 cacheReadTokens，并验证工具结果进入最终回答；本研究未执行该测试。
items.titleEn: Real DeepSeek API prefix-cache test
items.supportsEn: When an API key is present, the E2E requires every assistant usage after the first to report positive cacheReadTokens and verifies the tool value reaches the final answer; this study did not execute the test.

items.title: DeepSeek wire request 的稳定前缀布局
items.supports: Adapter 把 system 作为首条 wire message，再序列化 durable history；始终流式并请求 usage，没有在该路径写入显式 cache-control。
items.titleEn: Stable-prefix layout of the DeepSeek wire request
items.supportsEn: The adapter places system first, then serializes durable history, always streams, and requests usage; this path writes no explicit cache-control directive.

items.title: 工作区指令通过 pre-step 消息进入
items.supports: Agent instructions 在下游 decision 后计算，处理 pending projection，并把新消息插到 claimed batch 后、driver runtime-context 前。
items.titleEn: Workspace instructions enter through a pre-step message
items.supportsEn: Agent instructions compute after downstream decisions, reconcile pending projections, and insert a new message after the claimed batch and before driver runtime context.

items.title: 时间上下文的 per-step sourced message
items.supports: Time context 在 prepend listener 的 next 返回后解析时区和刷新规则，把带 plugin snapshot source 的 user message 追加到 decision。
items.titleEn: Per-step sourced message for time context
items.supportsEn: Time context resolves timezone and refresh rules after the prepended listener's next returns, then appends a user message with a plugin snapshot source.

items.title: Tmux 上下文的首步与变化门控
items.supports: Tmux listener 只在 step 1、shell 可用、refresh 到期且状态变化时查询，并把 sourced snapshot 放在 decision messages 之前。
items.titleEn: First-step and change gates for tmux context
items.supportsEn: The tmux listener queries only on step one when shell exists, refresh is due, and state changed, then prepends a sourced snapshot to the decision messages.

items.title: Prompt assembly 期间 disposal/cancel 的无 step 测试
items.supports: 测试证明阻塞 assembly 期间 dispose 或 cancel 后只保留 turn/start 与 aborted turn/end，不产生 step、chunk、message 或 adapter request。
items.titleEn: No-step disposal and cancellation during prompt assembly
items.supportsEn: Tests prove disposal or cancellation during blocked assembly leaves only turn start and aborted turn end, with no step, chunk, message, or adapter request.

items.title: Provider-neutral content 与 usage 词汇
items.supports: 核心 block 只有 text、reasoning、image、tool-call 和 tool-result；tool 参数保留原始 JSON 字符串，usage bucket 互斥。
items.titleEn: Provider-neutral content and usage vocabulary
items.supportsEn: Core blocks are text, reasoning, image, tool-call, and tool-result; tool arguments remain raw JSON strings and usage buckets are disjoint.

items.title: 封闭的流式 chunk 与完整 request 协议
items.supports: 流以 indexed block start/delta/end、usage 和唯一 terminal finish 表示；GenerateOptions 同时承载 config、system、tools、messages、session 与 auxiliary purpose。
items.titleEn: Closed streaming chunks and complete request protocol
items.supportsEn: Streams use indexed block start, delta, end, usage, and one terminal finish; GenerateOptions carries config, system, tools, messages, session identity, and auxiliary purpose.

items.title: Assistant provider provenance 与 replay state
items.supports: 模型消息携带 provider、model 与可选 adapter-private lossless replay state；仅同一 adapter ownership 可安全复用。
items.titleEn: Assistant provider provenance and replay state
items.supportsEn: Model messages carry provider, model, and optional adapter-private lossless replay state, which is reusable only under the same adapter ownership.

items.title: 单一不可变 Message value
items.supports: 内部会话、投递和 provider request 共享 stable id、role、content、source 的同一表示；创建时 clone 并 deep-freeze。
items.titleEn: One immutable Message value
items.supportsEn: Delivery, durable history, and provider requests share one stable id, role, content, and source representation, cloned and deep-frozen at creation.

items.title: Chunk 到 assistant message 的规范组装器
items.supports: 支持交错 index 与 delta-only 协议，首次 block-end 胜出；max-token 时丢弃不安全 tool call，并把 usage、finish、replay state 汇入最终消息。
items.titleEn: Canonical chunk-to-assistant-message assembler
items.supportsEn: Supports interleaved indexes and delta-only protocols, lets the first block-end win, drops unsafe tool calls on max-token truncation, and carries usage, finish, and replay state.

items.title: 一对一 provider route registry
items.supports: Adapter 必须拥有非空唯一 route；冲突 all-or-nothing 失败，effect disposal 精确释放，replace 原子交换 route 并发更新事件。
items.titleEn: One-to-one provider-route registry
items.supportsEn: Adapters own non-empty unique routes; conflicts fail all-or-nothing, effect disposal releases exact routes, and replace atomically swaps routes before publishing an update.

items.title: Registration-bound 的一次性 PreparedLlmCall
items.supports: prepareCall 固定 resolved config、model context、adapter defaults 与 retry policy；stream 只能一次且拒绝 dispatch 前 config drift。
items.titleEn: One-shot registration-bound PreparedLlmCall
items.supportsEn: prepareCall captures resolved config, model context, adapter defaults, and retry policy; stream is one-shot and rejects config drift before dispatch.

items.title: Adapter failure 的归一化边界
items.supports: Selection、dispatch、iterator 构造和 iteration failure 变成 terminal failure chunk；middleware、consumer 与 cleanup failure 保持 throw。
items.titleEn: Adapter-failure normalization boundary
items.supportsEn: Selection, dispatch, iterator construction, and iteration failures become terminal failure chunks, while middleware, consumer, and cleanup failures remain thrown.

items.title: Prepared call 固定旧 route 与 retry policy 测试
items.supports: 测试在 route replacement 后 dispatch 已准备调用，确认旧 adapter 与旧 policy 继续服务，而 registry 已暴露新 policy。
items.titleEn: Prepared-call route and retry-policy pinning test
items.supportsEn: The test dispatches a prepared call after route replacement and proves the old adapter and policy still serve it while the registry exposes the new policy.

items.title: DeepSeek 配置解析、last-good 与 route 注册
items.supports: 配置显式解析并验证；动态坏快照保留 last-good；凭据每次 request 解析；唯一 deepseek-official route 的 retry policy 变化用原子 replace 刷新。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek config resolution, last-good state, and route registration
items.supportsEn: Config is explicitly resolved and validated, bad live snapshots retain last-good state, credentials resolve per request, and retry-policy changes atomically replace the sole deepseek-official route.

items.title: DeepSeek model capability 与默认值
items.supports: 默认 1M context、256K output、text-only；catalog 外 model 仍可直通；deployment thinking policy 决定 off/high/max 能力与默认 effort。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek model capabilities and defaults
items.supportsEn: Defaults are a 1M context, 256K output, and text-only input; uncatalogued model ids still pass through, while deployment thinking policy controls off, high, max, and the default effort.

items.title: DeepSeek request snapshot、HTTP 与 SSE 边界
items.supports: 每次 stream 固定 connection/key，发送 attribution、匿名 user/session/compaction header；状态、Retry-After 与 request id 进入结构化错误，idle timeout 与 transport 分型。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek request snapshot, HTTP, and SSE boundary
items.supportsEn: Each stream captures connection and key, sends attribution plus anonymous user, session, and compaction headers, preserves status, Retry-After, and request id, and classifies idle timeout and transport failures.

items.title: 内部消息到 DeepSeek chat-completions 的投影
items.supports: 拒绝 image，把 tool-result user message 展开成 role=tool；tool-call turn 才回传 reasoning_content，session title 强制关闭 thinking，始终请求 streaming usage。
items.titleEn: Projection from internal messages to DeepSeek chat completions
items.supportsEn: Rejects images, expands user-role tool results into role=tool, replays reasoning_content only on tool-call turns, forces thinking off for session titles, and always requests streaming usage.

items.title: DeepSeek SSE 到内部 chunk 的有状态翻译
items.supports: 按 reasoning/text/tool index 组块，延迟 block-end、usage 与 finish 到 DONE；cache hit 从 prompt total 中扣除，空 stop、坏 JSON 与无 DONE 分别失败。
items.titleEn: Stateful translation from DeepSeek SSE to internal chunks
items.supportsEn: Builds reasoning, text, and tool indexes, defers block-end, usage, and finish until DONE, subtracts cache hits from prompt totals, and fails empty stop, malformed JSON, or missing DONE distinctly.

items.title: Pi AI catalog reuse 与手工协议表
items.supports: Catalog route 保留原 provider 的 API/auth；手工 route 只支持 openai-completions、openai-responses 与 anthropic-messages，并按配置构建。
items.titleEn: Pi AI catalog reuse and manual protocol table
items.supportsEn: Catalog routes retain their original provider API and auth; manual routes support only openai-completions, openai-responses, and anthropic-messages and are built from configuration.

items.title: Pi AI 多 provider profile 配置形状
items.supports: 默认 routes 为空；每个 profile 拥有 credential、endpoint、model catalog/override、reasoning、cache retention、transport、timeout、header 与 retry policy。
items.titleEn: Pi AI multi-provider profile shape
items.supportsEn: Routes default to empty; each profile owns credentials, endpoint, model catalog and overrides, reasoning, cache retention, transport, timeouts, headers, and retry policy.

items.title: Pi AI exact-model 与 stream snapshot 边界
items.supports: 未知 model 在 I/O 前失败；stop 不支持；一次调用固定 profile/model/credential，SDK retries 为零；image 需 model capability 与 durable attachment service。
items.titleEn: Pi AI exact-model and stream-snapshot boundary
items.supportsEn: Unknown models fail before I/O, stop is unsupported, one call captures profile, model, and credential with SDK retries disabled, and images require model capability plus a durable attachment service.

items.title: Pi AI 的版本化 adapter-private replay state
items.supports: Durable content 保持权威，versioned state 只保存 API、响应 identity、stop reason 与 provider signature；读回时逐字段和逐 block 验证。
items.titleEn: Versioned adapter-private Pi AI replay state
items.supportsEn: Durable content remains authoritative while versioned state stores API, response identity, stop reason, and provider signatures and is validated field-by-field and block-by-block on replay.

items.title: Keyless 测试 replay script 的日志派生
items.supports: 以每个 finish 切分 assistant chunks，同一 turn/step 可包含多次 retry call；抛错或挂起无法仅凭日志派生，必须用显式 sidecar。
items.titleEn: Log derivation of keyless test replay scripts
items.supportsEn: Assistant chunks split at each finish and one turn and step may contain multiple retry calls; throws and hangs cannot be derived from the log alone and require an explicit sidecar.

items.title: Provider-owned retry policy 默认值与校验
items.supports: Normal 默认两次，覆盖 EMPTY_RESPONSE、RATE_LIMIT、SERVER、TIMEOUT、TRANSPORT，500ms 到 10s 指数退避和 10% jitter；always 无次数上限。
items.titleEn: Provider-owned retry-policy defaults and validation
items.supportsEn: Normal defaults to two retries for EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, and TRANSPORT with 500ms-to-10s exponential backoff and 10 percent jitter; always is unbounded.

items.title: 耐久 retry 调度与可取消 backoff
items.supports: 先写 llm/retry 再等待，等待结束写 llm/retry-started 才返回 retry；Retry-After 超 cap 时 normal 委派、always 回退本地延迟；disposal abort 并 drain。
items.titleEn: Durable retry scheduling and cancellable backoff
items.supportsEn: Writes llm/retry before waiting and llm/retry-started before returning retry; over-cap Retry-After delegates in normal mode and falls back locally in always mode, while disposal aborts and drains.

items.title: Retry 保持同一 Turn/Step 的测试
items.supports: 测试让第一次 provider attempt 失败、第二次成功，只存在一个 turn/start 与一个 step/start，而 adapter 收到两次请求。
items.titleEn: Retry remains in the same Turn and Step test
items.supportsEn: The first provider attempt fails and the second succeeds; only one turn/start and one step/start exist while the adapter receives two requests.

items.title: 真实 wire retry 的相同 body 与 partial chunk 语义
items.supports: 测试期望失败与成功 attempt 的 request body 相同，失败 chunks 留在非 surface 日志，最终只提交一个 assistant message；STREAM_CLOSED 默认不 retry。
items.titleEn: Identical wire bodies and partial-chunk semantics across retries
items.supportsEn: Tests expect identical request bodies across failed and successful attempts, retain failed chunks outside the surface, commit only one assistant message, and do not retry STREAM_CLOSED by default.

items.title: 按 Turn/Step last-sample-replaces 的 usage 投影
items.supports: Projection 只保留一个 last sample；同一 turn/step 的后续 usage 会从 totals 扣掉前样本再替换，设计目标是避免 chunk 与 final message 双计。
items.titleEn: Last-sample-replaces usage projection keyed by Turn and Step
items.supportsEn: The projection retains one last sample and replaces totals for later usage in the same turn and step, intended to avoid double-counting chunk and final-message usage.

items.title: 同一 Turn/Step 多次 provider attempt 的 replay 测试
items.supports: 测试明确把共享 turn/step 的失败与成功 chunk 流按各自 finish 切成两个 provider call，证明 attempt identity 不能只用 turn/step 表示。
items.titleEn: Replay test for multiple provider attempts in one Turn and Step
items.supportsEn: The test explicitly splits failed and successful chunk streams sharing a turn and step into two provider calls, proving attempt identity cannot be represented by turn and step alone.

items.title: Adapter dispatch 前的 durable checkpoint
items.supports: llm/stream waterfall 在创建下游 adapter stream 前 flush 完整 request prefix；flush 失败时 fail-closed，不发生 model I/O。
items.titleEn: Durable checkpoint before adapter dispatch
items.supportsEn: The llm/stream waterfall flushes the complete request prefix before constructing the downstream adapter stream and fails closed with no model I/O when flushing fails.

items.title: Request reconstruction invariant 的字段覆盖
items.supports: Invariant 比较 messages、model、system、temperature、maxTokens、stop 与 tools，但没有比较 provider 或 reasoningEffort。
items.titleEn: Field coverage of the request-reconstruction invariant
items.supportsEn: The invariant compares messages, model, system, temperature, maxTokens, stop, and tools, but not provider or reasoningEffort.

items.title: Retry README 与当前 loop 的边界漂移
items.supports: README 多处称 retry 会关闭旧 Turn 并开启新编号 Turn；生产源码和测试实际在同一 while loop、同一 turn/step 内 continue。
items.titleEn: Retry README drift from the current loop boundary
items.supportsEn: The README repeatedly says retries close the old Turn and open a freshly numbered Turn, while production source and tests continue in the same loop, Turn, and Step.

items.title: Session format version 与持久 header
items.supports: 格式版本固定为 0 且无兼容承诺；header 保存 identity、createdAt、cwd、fork parent/seedLength、subagent origin/depth 与 agent preset。
items.titleEn: Session format version and durable header
items.supportsEn: The format version is fixed at zero with no compatibility promise; the header stores identity, creation time, cwd, fork parent and seed length, subagent origin and depth, and agent preset.

items.title: 核心 SessionEvent vocabulary
items.supports: 核心声明 Turn/Step、user、raw assistant chunks、assembled assistant、tool call/result、todo、request header/context 与 end-seed 事件及其 payload 语义。
items.titleEn: Core SessionEvent vocabulary
items.supportsEn: Core declares Turn and Step boundaries, user messages, raw assistant chunks, assembled assistants, tool calls and results, todos, request header and context, and end-seed events with their payload semantics.

items.title: SessionEvent envelope、surface marker 与 ignorable
items.supports: 事件是按 type 区分的 union，含 seq/time/data；只有三类 message event 可带 surfaceOp/sourceEventSeqs，未知事件只有 ignorable=true 才可安全跳过。
items.titleEn: SessionEvent envelope, surface markers, and ignorable flag
items.supportsEn: Events are a type-discriminated union with seq, time, and data; only three message event types may carry surfaceOp and sourceEventSeqs, and an unknown event is skippable only with ignorable=true.

items.title: 本构建识别的 44 种事件
items.supports: 生成 catalog 列出全仓库声明的 44 个事件类型；持久化读路径用它拒绝未知 required vocabulary。
items.titleEn: The 44 event types known to this build
items.supportsEn: The generated catalog lists all 44 event types declared in the repository and lets persistence refuse unknown required vocabulary.

items.title: 一次遍历的 lossless-JSON snapshot
items.supports: 迭代遍历一次读取、校验并复制 plain JSON graph；拒绝稀疏/循环/exotic object、负零、非有限数和非字符串 own key。
items.titleEn: Single-pass lossless-JSON snapshot
items.supportsEn: An iterative traversal reads, validates, and copies a plain JSON graph once, rejecting sparse, cyclic, and exotic objects, negative zero, non-finite numbers, and non-string own keys.

items.title: Seed 的逐事件接纳与 end-seed 边界
items.supports: Seed 事件被 snapshot/adopt、校验 envelope/header/连续 seq，并经同一 surface transition 接纳；构造后记录 firstLiveSeq，缺少 marker 时追加 end-seed。
items.titleEn: Per-event seed acceptance and end-seed boundary
items.supportsEn: Seed events are snapshotted or adopted, checked for envelope, header, and contiguous sequence, and accepted through the same surface transition; construction records firstLiveSeq and appends end-seed when absent.

items.title: Session.append 的同步提交点
items.supports: Append 先 snapshot JSON 与 surface metadata、freeze candidate、验证 surface、解析 precommit dispatch；log.push 是提交点，随后 observer failure 被隔离，重入 append 被拒绝。
items.titleEn: Synchronous commit point of Session.append
items.supportsEn: Append snapshots JSON and surface metadata, freezes the candidate, validates the surface, and resolves precommit dispatch; log.push is the commit point, after which observer failures are contained and reentrant append is rejected.

items.title: Append precommit veto、postcommit containment 与 surface 原子性测试
items.supports: 测试证明 observer 在通知前已看到 committed event，observer 失败不回滚；internal dispatch 可在 commit 前 veto，失败 surface plan 不污染下一 append。
items.titleEn: Append precommit veto, postcommit containment, and surface atomicity tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove observers see an already committed event and cannot roll it back; internal dispatch may veto before commit, and a rejected surface plan does not pollute the next append.

items.title: 派生消息不可改写日志与非法 JSON 源头拒绝测试
items.supports: 测试尝试修改派生 message/content 均因冻结失败；BigInt、函数、Symbol、Map、undefined、Infinity、稀疏/循环 graph 在 append 前拒绝且日志不增长。
items.titleEn: Derived-message immutability and source rejection of invalid JSON
items.supportsEn: Tests cannot mutate frozen derived messages or content, and append rejects BigInt, functions, symbols, maps, undefined, infinity, sparse arrays, and cyclic graphs without growing the log.

items.title: Event 到 model-visible message 的唯一投影
items.supports: 只有 user/message、非空 assistant/message 与 tool/result 投影，且直接复用已冻结 message；boundary、chunk 和 log-only event 不进入模型历史。
items.titleEn: The sole event-to-model-visible-message projection
items.supportsEn: Only user messages, non-empty assistant messages, and tool results project, reusing frozen messages directly; boundaries, chunks, and log-only events never enter model history.

items.title: Surface eligibility 与 source provenance 校验
items.supports: 三类 eligible event 强制 surfaceOp，其他事件禁止 surface metadata；source seq 必须唯一且更早，replacement 必须覆盖每个被遮蔽 node。
items.titleEn: Surface eligibility and source-provenance validation
items.supportsEn: The three eligible event types require surfaceOp while all others forbid surface metadata; source sequences must be unique and earlier, and replacements must cite every shadowed node.

items.title: Positional surface replacement 的原子 fold
items.supports: Replace 在当前 node list 中定位 start/end，计划后一次 splice 成新 node 并递增 generation；tool/result 只能改写一个当前 result 的 content。
items.titleEn: Atomic fold of positional surface replacement
items.supportsEn: Replace locates start and end in the current node list, then one splice installs the new node and increments generation; a tool result may rewrite only the content of one current result.

items.title: Derived message 的增量 cache
items.supports: 无 replacement 时只投影新增 surface nodes；generation 变化则全量重建；每次返回新 array，但共享事件中已冻结 message。
items.titleEn: Incremental derived-message cache
items.supportsEn: Without replacement only new surface nodes are projected; a generation change rebuilds fully; every call returns a fresh array while sharing frozen messages from events.

items.title: 增量派生与 fresh replay oracle 等价测试
items.supports: 测试在 append、空 assistant 与 replacement 后比较 live cache 和 fresh Session replay，并验证旧 array snapshot 不随新 append 增长。
items.titleEn: Incremental derivation equality with a fresh replay oracle
items.supportsEn: Tests compare the live cache with a fresh Session replay after appends, an empty assistant, and replacement, and prove a previously returned array does not grow after later appends.

items.title: 可选的 Turn/Step/tool 关系 invariant
items.supports: Companion 检查 seq、Turn/Step 编号与闭合、execution event enclosure、同 Step call/result 配对；merge-extensible 事件关系交给 owner。
items.titleEn: Optional Turn, Step, and tool relational invariant
items.supportsEn: The companion checks sequence order, Turn and Step numbering and closure, execution-event enclosure, and same-Step call/result pairing, leaving merge-extensible event relations to their owner.

items.title: Invariant 的 precommit staging 与 postcommit advance
items.supports: Companion 从现有日志建 trace，在 internal/dispatch 纯验证并暂存 transition，只有匹配的 session/event 发布后才推进；veto 不污染状态。
items.titleEn: Invariant precommit staging and postcommit advancement
items.supportsEn: The companion builds traces from existing logs, validates and stages a pure transition during internal dispatch, and advances only after matching session/event publication, so a veto cannot pollute state.

items.title: 未知 required event 的恢复拒绝
items.supports: 持久化 load 在 normalization 后逐事件检查 known catalog；未知且未标 ignorable 的 event 使整份 session fail-closed。
items.titleEn: Recovery refusal for unknown required events
items.supportsEn: After normalization, persistence load checks every event against the known catalog and fails the entire session closed when an unknown event is not marked ignorable.

items.title: 未知 required/ignorable event 的 load 测试
items.supports: 测试定义未知 required event 必须报 SessionFormatUnsupportedError，而 ignorable=true 的未知 event 保留在 loaded event log 中。
items.titleEn: Load test for unknown required and ignorable events
items.supportsEn: The test requires an unknown required event to raise SessionFormatUnsupportedError while retaining an unknown ignorable=true event in the loaded event log.

items.title: Seed replay 与 end-seed 幂等测试
items.supports: 测试证明 seeded Session 派生消息等同原始日志、保留 verbatim prefix、追加一次 end-seed；再次打开已标记 seed 不继续增长。
items.titleEn: Seed replay and idempotent end-seed test
items.supportsEn: The test proves a seeded Session derives the same messages, retains the verbatim prefix, appends one end-seed, and does not keep growing when an already marked seed is reopened.

items.title: 每次模型尝试的 raw chunk 与语义消息提交
items.supports: 每次请求从当前 Surface 派生消息；所有 chunk 先逐条入日志，成功后才追加引用这些 seq 的 assistant/message，失败并重试时不提交语义消息。
items.titleEn: Raw chunks and semantic-message commit for each model attempt
items.supportsEn: Each request derives messages from the current Surface; every chunk is logged first, and only a successful attempt appends an assistant message citing those seqs, while a failed retrying attempt commits no semantic message.

items.title: Raw chunk 流完整留存与重组测试
items.supports: 测试要求产生文本 abc 的七个协议 chunk 全部按顺序保留，并可由规范 assembler 重组。
items.titleEn: Complete raw-chunk retention and reassembly test
items.supportsEn: The test requires all seven protocol chunks that produce text abc to remain in order and be reassembled by the canonical assembler.

items.title: 每次请求可由日志前缀字节等价重建定理测试
items.supports: Fresh Session 从首个 chunk 之前的事件前缀重建 messages，request/header fold 重建 model、reasoning、system、tools、temperature、maxTokens 与 stop，并与实际 dispatch request deep-equal。
items.titleEn: Theorem test for byte-equal reconstruction of every request
items.supportsEn: A fresh Session rebuilds messages from the event prefix before the first chunk, while the request-header fold rebuilds model, reasoning, system, tools, temperature, maxTokens, and stop, all deep-equal to the dispatched request.

items.title: 客户端 assistant 流、retry 与 interruption 投影
items.supports: 客户端按 chunk 增量折叠；llm/retry 隐藏并清空失败 attempt 的局部内容但保留 first-token time；有 chunk 证据却无最终消息时可在闭合边界合成 interrupted node。
items.titleEn: Client projection of assistant streams, retries, and interruption
items.supportsEn: The client folds chunks incrementally; llm/retry hides and clears failed-attempt partials while preserving first-token time, and a closed boundary with chunk evidence but no final message can synthesize an interrupted node.

items.title: 崩溃尾部的确定性合成闭合事件
items.supports: 修复只扫描尾部 open turn；未记录开始的调用写 TOOL_NOT_STARTED，已记录 call 却无 result 写 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN，随后按需补 step/end 和 interrupted turn/end，沿用最后真实时间并连续编号。
items.titleEn: Deterministic synthetic closers for a crash tail
items.supportsEn: Repair scans only the tail open turn; an unrecorded start gets TOOL_NOT_STARTED, a recorded call without a result gets TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, then step/end and interrupted turn/end are added as needed with contiguous seqs and the last real timestamp.

items.title: Inspect 不提交而 Load 提交恢复的后端契约测试
items.supports: 契约测试证明 inspect 返回带合成闭合事件的平衡逻辑视图但 revision 不变；load 把恢复写入后端并推进 revision，恢复后的 transcript 配对 call/result。
items.titleEn: Backend contract test: inspect does not commit repair while load does
items.supportsEn: The contract proves inspect returns a balanced logical view with synthetic closers without changing revision, whereas load persists recovery, advances revision, and yields paired calls and results.

items.title: Torn tail 截断与真实前缀保留测试
items.supports: 测试让后端返回有效提交前缀加 torn marker；load 截掉残片、保留全部已提交 open-turn 事件并追加确定性 closers。
items.titleEn: Torn-tail truncation and committed-prefix preservation test
items.supportsEn: The backend returns a valid committed prefix plus a torn marker; load truncates the fragment, retains every committed open-turn event, and appends deterministic closers.

items.title: prepare、load、inspect 与 readFrom 的四种读契约
items.supports: prepare 预留唯一可发布 Session 并提交恢复；load 提交恢复后返回平衡视图；inspect 只做逻辑恢复不发布不写盘；readFrom 返回物理存储 suffix 且不做恢复。
items.titleEn: Four read contracts: prepare, load, inspect, and readFrom
items.supportsEn: Prepare reserves the sole publishable Session and commits recovery; load commits recovery and returns a balanced view; inspect performs logical repair without publication or writes; readFrom returns a physical stored suffix without recovery.

items.title: Prepared repair 的 revision 校验与精确提交
items.supports: Cold source 读取后合成 closers 并通过 Session seed 校验；commitRepair 后因 revision 已变化而重新加载，避免把旧内存图错误绑定到新 revision；live load 先 flush 且拒绝 open turn。
items.titleEn: Revision checking and exact commit of prepared repair
items.supportsEn: A cold source synthesizes closers and validates them through Session seeding; after commitRepair changes revision it reloads instead of binding an old memory graph to a new revision, while live load flushes first and rejects an open turn.

items.title: 每 Session write-behind 队列与显式 quiescence barrier
items.supports: 事件被克隆进固定 deadline 队列；稳定 batch 写失败会按原顺序放回并暂停自动重试；并发 flush 共享 barrier，显式重试直到队列和 active write 都静止。
items.titleEn: Per-session write-behind queue and explicit quiescence barrier
items.supportsEn: Events are cloned into a fixed-deadline queue; a failed stable batch is restored in order and pauses automatic retry, while concurrent flushes share a barrier that explicitly retries until the queue and active write are quiescent.

items.title: 模型与工具副作用前的语义 durability checkpoint
items.supports: 策略在模型 stream 构造、顶层工具 body 和每个 pre-step 前 flush；checkpoint 失败时 adapter 或工具副作用体不会运行，嵌套 tool dispatch 复用外层边界。
items.titleEn: Semantic durability checkpoints before model and tool side effects
items.supportsEn: The policy flushes before model-stream construction, a top-level tool body, and every pre-step; a failed checkpoint prevents the adapter or tool side-effect body from running, while nested tool dispatch reuses the outer boundary.

items.title: Core Fork 的 live-source 与平衡前缀规则
items.supports: Core 只允许从当前 live Session 复制 inclusive prefix；边界必须存在且连续，不能落在 open turn 内，child 继承 cwd、parentSession 和精确 seedLength。
items.titleEn: Core Fork rules for live sources and balanced prefixes
items.supportsEn: Core copies an inclusive prefix only from the current live Session; the boundary must exist and be contiguous, may not end inside an open turn, and the child inherits cwd, parentSession, and exact seedLength.

items.title: 空 Fork、稳定边界、冻结 seed 与拒绝矩阵测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖空 child lineage、detached frozen seed、source open tail 之前的早期边界、所有 turn-end reason、turn 后 log-only 事件，以及非法、stale、open-turn 和 duplicate child 拒绝。
items.titleEn: Tests for empty forks, stable boundaries, frozen seeds, and rejection cases
items.supportsEn: Tests cover empty-child lineage, detached frozen seeds, earlier boundaries before an open source tail, every turn-end reason, post-turn log-only events, and rejection of invalid, stale, open-turn, and duplicate-child cases.

items.title: Host Fork 的消息锚点与 composition 继承
items.supports: atSeq 选择其所在 Turn 的首个 turn/end，再包含下一 turn/start 前的独立事件；child 继承 cwd、lineage、seedLength 与当前 composition，创建后 workspace attach 失败不会撤销已发布 child。
items.titleEn: Host Fork message anchors and composition inheritance
items.supportsEn: atSeq selects the first turn/end for its containing Turn and includes standalone events before the next turn/start; the child inherits cwd, lineage, seedLength, and current composition, and a later workspace-attach failure does not unpublish it.

items.title: Session 创建后的异步持久化 admission
items.supports: session/created listener 以 fire-and-observe 方式启动 initFor；session/event 进入 write-behind；session/flush 是显式 barrier，fork seed 的物理存储不与 child publication 构成原子事务。
items.titleEn: Asynchronous persistence admission after Session creation
items.supportsEn: The session/created listener starts initFor in a fire-and-observe manner, session/event enters write-behind, and session/flush is the explicit barrier, so physical persistence of a fork seed is not atomic with child publication.

items.title: History raw-entry 与 Fork wire-level 契约
items.supports: History 返回 raw event 加可选即时 tool view，分页按 append-origin message group，tail 含 partial，冷读不 resume Agent；Fork 的 atSeq 是 completed-turn anchor。
items.titleEn: Wire-level contracts for raw history entries and Fork
items.supportsEn: History returns each raw event plus an optional current tool view, pages by append-origin message groups, includes tail partials, and never resumes a cold Agent; Fork atSeq is a completed-turn anchor.

items.title: 按 append-origin message group 的连续 raw 分页
items.supports: 算法向后计数 append-origin user/assistant message，replacement 不占 quota，并用 sourceEventSeqs 把 cut 扩到 raw chunk group 起点，因此不在一个 assistant attempt 中间切页。
items.titleEn: Contiguous raw pagination by append-origin message group
items.supportsEn: The algorithm counts append-origin user and assistant messages backward, gives replacements no quota, and uses sourceEventSeqs to extend the cut to the raw chunk group's start so a page never splits an assistant attempt.

items.title: 历史事件与 projection baseline 的同一同步 cut
items.supports: Attached history 复制 live events，cold history 使用 inspect；所有 await 之后同步读取 events 与 projection watermark，避免一个响应混用 N 与 N+1 两个时刻。
items.titleEn: One synchronous cut for history events and the projection baseline
items.supportsEn: Attached history copies live events while cold history uses inspect; after all awaits, events and the projection watermark are read synchronously so one response cannot mix moments N and N+1.

items.title: Tool view 的分页时计算与跨页 soft fallback
items.supports: History 只在当前 raw page 内回扫 tool/call 参数，再用当前 presenter 生成 view；call 位于旧页或参数不可解析时返回 undefined，让客户端使用 generic card。
items.titleEn: Pagination-time tool views and cross-page soft fallback
items.supportsEn: History backscans tool-call arguments only within the current raw page and invokes the current presenter; a call on an older page or unparseable arguments returns undefined so the client uses a generic card.

items.title: History 请求和响应的 wire validation
items.supports: beforeSeq 与 maxMessages 只校验非负/正整数，maxMessages 没有上限；响应逐 entry 校验 raw event 与可选 view，但 transport schema 不声明连续窗口 invariant。
items.titleEn: Wire validation for history requests and responses
items.supportsEn: beforeSeq and maxMessages are checked only as non-negative and positive integers, with no maximum for maxMessages; each response entry validates its raw event and optional view, while the transport schema does not express the contiguous-window invariant.

items.title: History window、live buffer、去重与 gap repair
items.supports: 客户端先装 tail page，再按 seq 拼接订阅期间 buffer；重叠事件丢弃，发现 seq hole 就缓存并重新拉 tail page，避免向 conversation engine 注入不连续窗口。
items.titleEn: History-window stitching, live buffering, deduplication, and gap repair
items.supportsEn: The client installs a tail page, stitches events buffered during subscription by seq, drops overlap, and buffers plus refetches the tail on a seq hole so the conversation engine never receives a discontinuous window.

items.title: 连续 raw window 上的增量 UI business-context engine
items.supports: Assembler 在 replaceWindow 时全量重建，在 append 时只处理 tail，在 prepend 时补旧页并保持已有 context/view identity；业务 Definition 决定事件如何成为 UI node。
items.titleEn: Incremental UI business-context engine over a contiguous raw window
items.supportsEn: The assembler fully rebuilds on replaceWindow, handles only the tail on append, and adds older pages on prepend while preserving existing context and view identity; business Definitions decide how events become UI nodes.

items.title: Surface replacement、source 与 Session lineage 查询
items.supports: Query 先用 canonical Surface fold 把事件标为 current/shadowed/log-only，再返回 replacement chain、直接 source/derived links；Session lineage 沿 header parent 建祖先与递归后代并显式报告缺失 parent。
items.titleEn: Queries for Surface replacement, sources, and Session lineage
items.supportsEn: Query first applies the canonical Surface fold to classify events as current, shadowed, or log-only, then returns replacement chains and direct source or derived links; Session lineage follows header parents into ancestors and recursive descendants and explicitly reports a missing parent.

items.title: Flush 后逐字节导出 raw artifact 与 lineage media
items.supports: 导出每个 live Session 前先过权威 flush barrier，再把后端 artifact 原文、可选后代日志与去重后的引用媒体流式写入 ZIP；导出不重新投影 UI 或 Surface。
items.titleEn: Byte-preserving export of raw artifacts and lineage media after flush
items.supportsEn: Export passes every live Session through the authoritative flush barrier, then streams the backend artifact verbatim with optional descendant logs and deduplicated referenced media into ZIP, without rebuilding UI or Surface projections.

items.title: Compaction backend seam 与三种入口
items.supports: 抽象引擎区分 pressure/overflow 自动判断、idle compactNow 与显式 compactRegion；成功都把一个平衡 Surface span 替换成带统一 checkpoint source 的 user message。
items.titleEn: Compaction backend seam and its three entry points
items.supportsEn: The abstract engine separates pressure or overflow policy, idle compactNow, and explicit compactRegion; every success replaces one balanced Surface span with a user message carrying the common checkpoint source.

items.title: Compaction 生命周期、shadow price 与结果事件词汇
items.supports: start/summary/end 是 log-only bracket；summary 记录 shadowed seq/token price、route、raw output 和 usage，紧随其后的 replacement user message 才改变 Surface；prune 是 model-free shadow-price event。
items.titleEn: Compaction lifecycle, shadow-price, and result event vocabulary
items.supportsEn: Start, summary, and end form a log-only bracket; summary records shadowed seqs and token price, route, raw output, and usage, while the following replacement user message changes the Surface; prune is the model-free shadow-price event.

items.title: 按精确 Provider/Model 解析的阈值与保留预算
items.supports: 默认 thresholdRatio=.8、retainRatio=.16、maxTokens=8192、一次额外 summary retry 和一次 overflow retry；exact route 可部分覆盖，capacity 将 ratio 缩放为 absolute budgets。
items.titleEn: Threshold and retention budgets resolved per exact Provider and Model
items.supportsEn: Defaults are thresholdRatio .8, retainRatio .16, maxTokens 8192, one extra summary retry, and one overflow retry; exact routes can partially override them, and capacity scales ratios into absolute budgets.

items.title: Pre-step pressure 与 same-step overflow recovery
items.supports: Pre-step listener 失败只警告并继续；canonical context overflow 在独立 budget 内尝试压缩，只有 Surface generation 前进才返回 retry，prune 已落地后 summary 失败也可作为进展，取消最终优先。
items.titleEn: Pre-step pressure and same-Step overflow recovery
items.supportsEn: The pre-step listener warns and continues on failure; canonical context overflow uses an independent budget and returns retry only after Surface generation advances, including durable prune progress before a later summary failure, while cancellation remains final.

items.title: Pressure、prune、retention 与 summary retry 主循环
items.supports: Pressure 先解析 routed capacity 并过 threshold，再可选 prune、重测、选择保留 tail 的 head range；overflow 跳过 threshold/retention 并先 prune；每次 summary 后重测直到低于阈值或耗尽 bounded retries。
items.titleEn: Main loop for pressure, pruning, retention, and summary retries
items.supportsEn: Pressure first resolves routed capacity and crosses its threshold, optionally prunes and remeasures, then selects a head range retaining a tail; overflow bypasses threshold and retention and prunes first; every summary is remeasured until below threshold or bounded retries expire.

items.title: Replay-aware request pressure measurement
items.supports: 匹配 request header 时优先复用保守 provider usage anchor，再叠加 Surface signed delta；不匹配则重估 header+surface；每次返回 immutable O(surface) positional nodes。
items.titleEn: Replay-aware request-pressure measurement
items.supportsEn: With a matching request header, measurement prefers a conservative Provider-usage anchor plus signed Surface delta; otherwise it reprices header and Surface heuristically, returning immutable O(surface) positional nodes each time.

items.title: Provider usage anchor 与 chunk-source 重组
items.supports: Meter 在 assistant/message 处以 step-start Surface 为 anchor，从 cited raw chunks 重组真实 Provider output；usage total 小于完整 heuristic anchor 时退回估算，避免负 delta 低估压力。
items.titleEn: Provider-usage anchors and reconstruction from cited chunks
items.supportsEn: At assistant/message, the meter anchors to the Step-start Surface and reassembles real Provider output from cited raw chunks; when reported usage is lower than the full heuristic anchor it falls back to the estimate so negative deltas cannot understate pressure.

items.title: 固定密度 token heuristic
items.supports: 文本/推理按每四个 JS code units 加 block overhead 估算，tool args/schema 用 JSON 长度，message 加 role overhead；它是统一启发式而非真实 tokenizer。
items.titleEn: Fixed-density token heuristic
items.supportsEn: Text and reasoning use four JavaScript code units per token plus block overhead, tool arguments and schemas use JSON length, and messages add role overhead; this is one shared heuristic, not an exact tokenizer.

items.title: 保留近期 tail 的 head-anchored range selection
items.supports: 从 Surface 尾部累计至少 retainTokens，再把 cut 向 head 移到 tool-pair balanced boundary；没有可压缩 head 或单个不可分割单位时返回 null。
items.titleEn: Head-anchored range selection that retains a recent tail
items.supportsEn: The selector accumulates at least retainTokens from the Surface tail, then moves the cut headward to a tool-pair-balanced boundary; it returns null when no compactable head or only one indivisible unit remains.

items.title: Durable start-lock 与 exactly-one close attempt transaction
items.supports: 验证后同步写 start 作为锁，摘要后重验稳定性，提交 body 再写 end；任何后续失败尝试一次 error end，close 自身失败会故意留下 unmatched start；manual closed attempt 可再 flush。
items.titleEn: Transaction with a durable start lock and exactly one close attempt
items.supportsEn: After validation it synchronously writes start as the lock, rechecks stability after summarization, commits the body, then writes end; every later failure attempts one error end, while a failed close deliberately leaves an unmatched start, and a closed manual attempt may then flush.

items.title: Snapshot、shrink validation、稳定性与同步 commit body
items.supports: 选中 span 以 token nodes 与消息 snapshot 定价；framed checkpoint 必须严格更小；automatic 要求 whole Surface 不变，manual 只要求 selected span 稳定；summary event 与 replacement 同步相邻 append。
items.titleEn: Snapshot, shrink validation, stability, and synchronous commit body
items.supportsEn: The selected span is priced and snapshotted as token nodes and messages; the framed checkpoint must be strictly smaller; automatic mode requires the whole Surface unchanged while manual mode requires only the selected span stable; summary event and replacement append synchronously adjacent.

items.title: Cache-shaped one-shot summary request 与 checkpoint framing
items.supports: 摘要请求重用会话 system/tools/selected messages 并只在尾部加固定英文结构指令；target 优先显式 summary route，再最新 route/Agent options；只接受非空 text，image 或 max-token truncation 失败，raw output/usage 另存。
items.titleEn: Cache-shaped one-shot summary request and checkpoint framing
items.supportsEn: The summary request reuses conversation system, tools, and selected messages and appends one fixed English structure directive; target preference is explicit summary route, then latest route or Agent options; only nonempty text is accepted, images or max-token truncation fail, and raw output and usage are stored separately.

items.title: Tool-result pruner 的 code-point budgets
items.supports: 默认超过 8192 Unicode code points 才触发，保留 4096 head、1024 tail 和固定 marker；配置保证输出不超过 threshold 且可收敛。
items.titleEn: Code-point budgets for the tool-result pruner
items.supportsEn: The default triggers above 8192 Unicode code points and keeps a 4096-point head, 1024-point tail, and fixed marker; validation guarantees output stays within the threshold and can converge.

items.title: Replay-safe、model-free 的 content-only tool-result replacement
items.supports: 只统计/裁剪 text blocks，中段按 code point 移除、rich blocks 原序保留；对 Surface snapshot 中每个超限 result 先写 shadow price，再用 Session 允许的 content-only replacement 引用原 seq。
items.titleEn: Replay-safe model-free content-only tool-result replacement
items.supportsEn: Only text blocks are measured and pruned by code point while rich blocks retain order; for every oversized result in a Surface snapshot it writes a shadow price, then uses Session's content-only replacement citing the original seq.

items.title: 按当前 Surface 顺序计算 tool call/result balanced cuts
items.supports: Fold 以 assistant tool-call 数加一、tool result 减一，为 N nodes 计算 N+1 个 cut；replacement generation 变化时重建，普通 append 增量扩展。
items.titleEn: Tool-call and result balanced cuts in current Surface order
items.supportsEn: The fold increments for assistant tool calls and decrements for tool results to compute N+1 cuts for N nodes; it rebuilds when replacement generation changes and extends incrementally for ordinary appends.

items.title: Compaction bracket、owner 与 checkpoint runtime invariant
items.supports: Companion 校验 transaction/command ID、Turn enclosure、单一 summary、shadow endpoints/token count、checkpoint source 与成功 end；它不校验 summary/prune 必须紧邻对应 replacement。
items.titleEn: Runtime invariant for compaction brackets, owners, and checkpoints
items.supportsEn: The companion validates transaction and command IDs, Turn enclosure, one summary, shadow endpoints and token count, checkpoint source, and successful end; it does not validate that summary or prune is immediately adjacent to its replacement.

items.title: Idle maintenance 下的手动 compaction
items.supports: compactNow 同步进入 runMaintenance，只在 idle 且无 waking work 时运行，以 retain=0 选 useful range，写 turn:null bracket，允许 span 外 append，并在返回前 flush closed attempt。
items.titleEn: Manual compaction under idle maintenance
items.supportsEn: compactNow synchronously enters runMaintenance only while idle with no waking work, selects a useful range with retain zero, writes a turn-null bracket, permits appends outside the span, and flushes a closed attempt before returning.

items.title: Human-facing /compact 与失败分类
items.supports: 无参数命令把 busy/cancelled/changed/summary/commit/persistence 映射为不同用户结果，成功报告 shadowed items/tokens 并以 summary seq 关联展示；teardown drain active handlers。
items.titleEn: Human-facing /compact and failure classification
items.supportsEn: The argument-free command maps busy, cancelled, changed, summary, commit, and persistence failures to distinct user outcomes, reports shadowed items and tokens with the summary seq on success, and drains active handlers on teardown.

items.title: 真实 Loop 中 between-step 与 same-step overflow 合同测试
items.supports: 测试源码要求 pressure 位于上个 step/end 与下个 step/start 之间；overflow 在同一 Step 内生成 checkpoint 并重试同一请求，旧 sentinel 从 retry messages 消失。
items.titleEn: Real-loop contract tests for between-Step pressure and same-Step overflow
items.supportsEn: Test source requires pressure to run between the prior step/end and next step/start; overflow creates a checkpoint and retries within the same Step, removing the old sentinel from retry messages.

items.title: Prune-first 两机制组合与 replay checkpoint 测试
items.supports: 测试源码要求低压不机会式 prune、prune 足够时不调用 LLM、不足时摘要读取已裁剪 Surface，并验证 checkpoint source/token price 与 fresh Session replay 等价。
items.titleEn: Tests for prune-first two-mechanism composition and replayable checkpoints
items.supportsEn: Test source requires no opportunistic pruning below pressure, no LLM call when pruning suffices, summarization of the pruned Surface when it does not, and checkpoint source and token price with fresh-Session replay equality.

items.title: Pre-step candidate、waterfall 与消息 commit 顺序
items.supports: Agent 在 waterfall 前 claim 输入、组装 prompt、计算 runtime-context candidate；waterfall 返回后才写 step/start 和 user messages，因此 waterfall 内 pressure measurement 看不到本次 entering batch。
items.titleEn: Ordering of the pre-Step candidate, waterfall, and message commit
items.supportsEn: Before the waterfall, the Agent claims input, assembles the prompt, and computes the runtime-context candidate; only after the waterfall returns does it write step/start and user messages, so pressure measurement inside the waterfall cannot see this entering batch.

items.title: Dynamic runtime-context retained snapshot projection
items.supports: Projection 记住最新仍在 Surface 的 owned snapshot；replacement 引用它时把 retained 设 null，project 只在当前 text 与 retained 不同时产生候选消息。
items.titleEn: Retained-snapshot projection for dynamic runtime context
items.supportsEn: The projection remembers the latest owned snapshot still on the Surface, sets retained to null when a replacement cites it, and produces a candidate message only when current text differs from the retained value.

items.title: 主会话 usage 与 next-request pressure projections
items.supports: Usage fold 只读取 assistant usage chunk/message，按 Turn/Step last-wins 累积；context pressure 用 provider prompt sample 加 Surface shadow-price delta 推测下一请求，compaction/summary 自带 usage 不进入累计。
items.titleEn: Primary-conversation usage and next-request pressure projections
items.supportsEn: The usage fold reads only assistant usage chunks and messages and accumulates last-wins per Turn and Step; context pressure combines a Provider prompt sample with Surface shadow-price deltas for the next request, while usage stored on compaction/summary is not accumulated.

items.title: O(1) projection 的 adjacent shadow-price protocol
items.supports: Bounded projection 只保留 running total 与一个 pending claim；summary/prune 应为下一 replacement 定价，任意其他事件使 claim 过期；无 claim 的历史 replacement 以 zero delta 降级而非失败。
items.titleEn: Adjacent shadow-price protocol for O(1) projections
items.supportsEn: The bounded projection retains only a running total and one pending claim; summary or prune is meant to price the next replacement, any other event expires the claim, and a historical replacement without a claim degrades to zero delta rather than failing.

items.title: Projection baseline 与非权威 checkpoint 类型
items.supports: ProjectionSnapshot 定义共享 asOfSeq cut；ProjectionCheckpointRow 记录版本、水位与内部状态，并明确 row 只是 fold shortcut、不是 authority。
items.titleEn: Projection baselines and non-authoritative checkpoint rows
items.supportsEn: ProjectionSnapshot defines one shared asOfSeq cut, while ProjectionCheckpointRow records version, watermark, and internal state and explicitly declares the row a fold shortcut rather than an authority.

items.title: 发布组合显式挂载持久化、Projection 与 checkpoint policy
items.supports: Base patch 在独立 rows 中挂载 JSONL Session persistence、共享 projection registry 和模型请求/顶层工具前的 semantic checkpoint policy；三者不是一个隐式服务。
items.titleEn: The shipped composition explicitly mounts persistence, projections, and checkpoint policy
items.supportsEn: The base patch mounts JSONL Session persistence, the shared projection registry, and the semantic checkpoint policy for model requests and top-level tools as separate rows rather than one implicit service.

items.title: Per-Session projection cells、同步 snapshot 与 eager drive
items.supports: Registry 以 WeakMap cell 保存 state/observedSeq，单次订阅驱动所有 unit；缺失 cell 从内存日志 lazy fold，Object.is 只让 reference 变化产生通知，而 observedSeq 对每个事件前进。
items.titleEn: Per-Session projection cells, synchronous snapshots, and eager drive
items.supportsEn: The registry holds state and observedSeq in WeakMap cells and drives every unit from one subscription; missing cells lazily fold the in-memory log, Object.is gates notifications, and observedSeq advances for every event.

items.title: 同 key 注册的 refcount 与 version 冲突规则
items.supports: 同 key、同 stateVersion 的 registrant 共享第一份 unit 并增加 refs；version 不同才拒绝。最后一个 disposer 删除 registration 与全部 cells，且 runtime 无法比较函数语义。
items.titleEn: Reference counting and version conflicts for registrations sharing one key
items.supportsEn: Registrants with the same key and stateVersion share the first unit and increment refs, while a different version is rejected; the final disposer removes the registration and all cells, and runtime cannot compare function semantics.

items.title: Projection change frame 与 Host 自有 projection units
items.supports: API Proxy 把 registry change 广播为 session/projection frame，并注册 sessionListMetadata 与 per-boot imageLimits；imageLimits apply 永远返回同一 state，因此只通过 baseline 传播。
items.titleEn: Projection change frames and Host-owned projection units
items.supportsEn: The API Proxy broadcasts registry changes as session/projection frames and registers sessionListMetadata plus per-boot imageLimits; imageLimits always returns the same state from apply and therefore travels only through baselines.

items.title: Versioned row、日志生命周期 identity 与 cache domain
items.supports: 每个 checkpoint row 包含 ver/seq/JSON val；完整 Session record 绑定 createdAt/cwd identity；session_projcache domain v3 可整体丢弃，因为它只保存派生状态。
items.titleEn: Versioned rows, log-lifecycle identity, and the cache domain
items.supportsEn: Each checkpoint row contains ver, seq, and a JSON value; a complete Session record binds rows to createdAt and cwd identity, and the version-3 session_projcache domain stores derived state that can be discarded.

items.title: Anchored restore floor 与安全 tail fold
items.supports: restoreFloor 选择最低可用水位前的一条事件；restore 只接受 version 匹配且位于可证明日志端点内的 row，不安全的 partial restore 会要求从 seq 0 重读。
items.titleEn: Anchored restore floors and safe tail folding
items.supportsEn: restoreFloor selects one event below the lowest usable watermark, while restore accepts only version-matching rows within the provable log endpoint and requires a reread from seq zero for an unsafe partial restore.

items.title: Projection cache 的 cold tail-replay ladder
items.supports: coldSnapshot 读取 checkpoint、计算 restore floor、调用 persistence.readFrom 做 tail fold；identity 或 watermark overreach 时回退到 full read，并 fail-soft 写回刷新结果。
items.titleEn: The projection cache cold tail-replay ladder
items.supportsEn: coldSnapshot reads checkpoints, computes a restore floor, and tail-folds persistence.readFrom; identity or watermark overreach falls back to a full read, followed by a fail-soft refreshed write-back.

items.title: 发布的 list 与 detached History projection 路径
items.supports: Session list 对 live row 使用 registry snapshot、对 cold row 只使用 cachedSnapshot；detached History 直接以空 checkpoint 对完整 inspected events 从零 restore。
items.titleEn: Shipped list and detached-History projection paths
items.supportsEn: Session list uses a registry snapshot for live rows and only cachedSnapshot for cold rows, while detached History restores the complete inspected event log from zero with an empty checkpoint.

items.title: Exact prepared Session 的 setup、publication 与 rollback
items.supports: Agent resume 需要 persistence.prepare，在融合 cancellation 下取得 exact preparation；setup 在 publish 前运行，失败会 dispose，finally 释放 reservation，不存在 resume 失败后自动 fresh-create 的分支。
items.titleEn: Setup, publication, and rollback for an exact prepared Session
items.supportsEn: Agent resume requires persistence.prepare under fused cancellation, runs setup before publishing the exact preparation, disposes on failure, releases the reservation in finally, and contains no automatic fresh-create branch after resume failure.

items.title: Cold History 使用 inspect 而不取得 Agent ownership
items.supports: History 优先读取 attached Session，否则调用 servable inspection；所有 await 结束后同步取得 events 与 projection cut，整个路径不 resume 或 publish Agent。
items.titleEn: Cold History uses inspection without acquiring Agent ownership
items.supportsEn: History reads an attached Session when present and otherwise uses servable inspection; after all awaits it synchronously takes events and the projection cut without resuming or publishing an Agent.
