items.title: Client projection 的 higher-seq-wins、完整 seed 与 generation truncate
items.supports: Value store 对 baseline 与 push 都拒绝 lower/equal seq；完整 seed 会清除 cut 时缺失的旧 key，而 subscribed truncate 只删除 seq 超过 Host durable lastSeq 的 rows。
items.titleEn: Higher-seq-wins, full seeding, and generation truncation in the client projection store
items.supportsEn: The value store rejects lower or equal seq for both baselines and pushes; a full seed clears old keys omitted at the cut, while subscribed truncation removes only rows beyond the Host's durable lastSeq.

items.title: List baseline、pre-instantiation push 与 subscribed repair 的收敛
items.supports: Manager 在 list pull 后 replay 并发 mutations；局部 list projection 只 apply carried keys；session/projection 在 Session 实例化前也进入 resident store，subscribed 再 truncate phantom rows 并重置 generation state。
items.titleEn: Convergence through list baselines, pre-instantiation pushes, and subscribed repair
items.supportsEn: The manager replays mutations that arrived during a list pull, applies only carried keys from partial list projections, stores session/projection frames before Session instantiation, and uses subscribed to truncate phantom rows and reset generation state.

items.title: Live checkpoint 的 log-before-cache barrier 与 detach 例外
items.supports: 普通 write 在 registry cut 后 flush 仍 live 的 Session，再 put cache；disposed listener 异步触发 flushSoft，但此时 live-store 检查可失败而跳过显式 flush，源码注释承认 residual overreach 由 cold read 检测。
items.titleEn: The log-before-cache barrier for live checkpoints and its detach exception
items.supportsEn: A normal write flushes a still-live Session after taking the registry cut and before putting the cache, while the disposed listener starts flushSoft asynchronously after the live-store check can fail and skip the explicit flush; the source notes residual overreach is left for cold-read detection.

items.title: Equal-seq update 拒绝与严格大于 lastSeq 的 truncate
items.supports: apply 在 seq 小于或等于现有 row 时直接返回；seed 复用该规则；generation truncate 只删除 row.seq 大于 lastSeq 的状态，因此同水位的新 generation value 无法替换旧值。
items.titleEn: Equal-seq rejection and truncation only beyond lastSeq
items.supportsEn: apply returns immediately when seq is lower than or equal to the resident row, seed reuses that rule, and generation truncation removes only rows whose seq is greater than lastSeq, so a new-generation value at the same watermark cannot replace the old one.

items.title: Per-boot、baseline-only 的 imageLimits projection
items.supports: imageLimits unit 的 state 恒为 null，apply 永远返回同一 reference，view 直接读取当前 attachments service 配置；因此启动内不发 change frame，只由 baseline 传播。
items.titleEn: The per-boot, baseline-only imageLimits projection
items.supportsEn: The imageLimits unit keeps null state, always returns the same reference from apply, and reads the current attachments-service configuration in view, so it emits no change frame within a boot and travels only through baselines.

items.title: Ordinary History 将 projection 异常折叠为 internal error
items.supports: History 在同一 try 中取得 source、composition、projection cut 与页面；除 SessionNotFound 外的任何异常都返回 history unavailable/internal，没有像 list 或 subagent History 那样省略 projection block 的降级分支。
items.titleEn: Ordinary History maps projection failures to an internal error
items.supportsEn: History obtains its source, composition, projection cut, and page inside one try; every error except SessionNotFound becomes history unavailable/internal, with no branch that degrades by omitting the projection block as list and subagent History do.

items.title: ToolDefinition 的 canonical output、执行与展示合同
items.supports: 定义同时声明模型 schema、canonical output schema/render/meta、body、timeout/concurrency metadata、finalizer 与纯 UI presenters；成功值和持久 content 明确分层。
items.titleEn: Canonical output, execution, and presentation contracts in ToolDefinition
items.supportsEn: A definition combines model schema, canonical output schema/render/meta, body, timeout and concurrency metadata, finalization, and pure UI presenters while explicitly separating successful values from durable content.

items.title: ToolExecutionResult 与 pre/post decision unions
items.supports: 成功结果携带 execution-local value、content/meta/context 与可选 concludesTurn；失败没有 value；pre 为 allow/deny/ask，post 为 accept/value-or-content replacement/block。
items.titleEn: ToolExecutionResult and pre/post decision unions
items.supportsEn: A success carries an execution-local value, content, metadata, context, and optional concludesTurn, while a failure has no value; pre decisions are allow, deny, or ask and post decisions accept, replace value or content, or block.

items.title: Canonical value 验证、纯 projection 与最终 materialization
items.supports: Registry snapshot/验证 body 或 policy value，运行 render/meta，并用 execution token 标记 canonical result；未标记 wrapper success 会重新规范化，最终 snapshot 冻结且 durable projection 不含 value。
items.titleEn: Canonical-value validation, pure projections, and final materialization
items.supportsEn: The registry snapshots and validates body or policy values, runs render and metadata projections, marks canonical results with the execution token, renormalizes unmarked wrapper successes, and freezes a durable projection that omits the value.

items.title: Agent loop 的 tool/call、ordered result 与 context commit
items.supports: Loop 在 prepare 前写 raw tool/call，分阶段运行 Registry，按模型顺序写 final tool/result 并引用 call seq，再接受 additional context 和 concludesTurn；取消的未启动 call 获得 synthetic pair。
items.titleEn: Agent-loop commits for tool calls, ordered results, and context
items.supportsEn: The loop appends raw tool/call before prepare, runs the staged registry, commits final tool/result in model order citing the call seq, then accepts additional context and concludesTurn; cancelled unstarted calls receive synthetic pairs.

items.title: 受执行的 JSON Schema 子集与 stack-safe validator
items.supports: Schema vocabulary 限定 type/oneOf/container/literal constraints 与 lossless annotations，拒绝未知关键字、循环、exotic records 与稀疏数组，并用显式 task stack 收集路径化 violations。
items.titleEn: The enforced JSON Schema subset and stack-safe validator
items.supportsEn: The schema vocabulary is limited to types, oneOf, container and literal constraints, and lossless annotations; it rejects unknown keywords, cycles, exotic records, and sparse arrays and uses an explicit task stack for path-qualified violations.

items.title: defineTool 的硬执行校验与软 replay 校验
items.supports: Helper 编译 schema、在 body 前硬校验 arguments 并抛 INVALID_ARGS，同时让 presenter 与 concurrency classifier 对旧/非法参数 fail-soft；它还绑定 typed output projectors。
items.titleEn: Hard execution validation and soft replay validation in defineTool
items.supportsEn: The helper compiles schemas, hard-validates arguments before the body with INVALID_ARGS, makes presenters and the concurrency classifier fail softly for old or invalid arguments, and binds typed output projectors.

items.title: Raw ToolDefinition 的注册校验边界
items.supports: 注册检查 output contract、支持的 output schema、timeout 与 reserved name，并按 calling scope 插入 live definition；它没有为 raw definition 包装 per-call parameter validation。
items.titleEn: Registration-validation boundary for raw ToolDefinition values
items.supportsEn: Registration checks the output contract, supported output schema, timeout, and reserved name and inserts the live definition in the calling scope; it does not wrap raw definitions with per-call parameter validation.

items.title: Execution 创建、参数 materialization 与 ordered pre/guard gate
items.supports: Registry mint token、snapshot/freeze arguments、处理 code-mode collapse 与 pre-dispatch abort，再按 scope 运行 pre waterfall、approval 和 monotonic guards；普通 policy failures 规范化为 staged results。
items.titleEn: Execution creation, argument materialization, and the ordered pre/guard gate
items.supportsEn: The registry mints a token, snapshots and freezes arguments, handles Code Mode collapse and pre-dispatch aborts, then runs scoped pre-policy, approval, and monotonic guards, normalizing ordinary policy failures into staged results.

items.title: Scoped restriction、shadowing、guard 与统一 visibility resolver
items.supports: Restrictions 只过滤继承能力且沿链相交，own registrations 例外并可 shadow；global/chain guards 只能拒绝；get/schema/dispatch 从同一 live view 解析。
items.titleEn: Scoped restrictions, shadowing, guards, and one visibility resolver
items.supportsEn: Restrictions intersect along the chain and filter inherited capability while exempting and allowing shadows from own registrations; global and chain guards can only deny, and get, schema, and dispatch resolve from the same live view.

items.title: Native、Code、Both 与 per-scope presentation
items.supports: 配置或 scoped presentAs 选择 native/code/both；code mode 添加 collapse instruction、typed SDK 与 reserved run_code，只在 code 下过滤 Provider schemas 为 transport，同时保持 SDK end-capability view。
items.titleEn: Native, Code, Both, and per-scope presentation
items.supportsEn: Configuration or scoped presentAs selects native, code, or both; Code Mode adds the collapse instruction, typed SDK, and reserved run_code and filters Provider schemas to the transport only under code while retaining the SDK end-capability view.

items.title: 模型 schema allowlist、Code SDK output schema 与 fail-closed classifier
items.supports: Native schema 只投影 name/description/parameters 的 detached copy；Code SDK 另带 output schema；executionMode 只有 classifier 精确返回 true 才 parallel，缺失、invalid 或 throw 都 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Model-schema allowlist, Code SDK output schema, and fail-closed classification
items.supportsEn: Native schemas project only detached name, description, and parameters, the Code SDK additionally carries output schemas, and executionMode is parallel only for an exact true while absence, invalid input, or exceptions are exclusive.

items.title: Root/call/token identity、nested parent 与结果控制信号
items.supports: ToolExecutionInput 区分 root call、opaque parent token、Agent 与 caller signal；Registry execution 添加不可伪造 token，ToolRunContext 只通过 deferContext/concludeTurn 把控制信号带回自身结果。
items.titleEn: Root, call, and token identity, nested parentage, and result control signals
items.supportsEn: ToolExecutionInput distinguishes root calls, opaque parent tokens, Agent, and caller signal; registry executions add an unforgeable token, while ToolRunContext carries control only through deferContext and concludeTurn on its own result.

items.title: Around-dispatch、caller signal fusion、body 与 deferred context
items.supports: Registry 将 wrapper signal 与原 caller signal 融合，resolve 当前 definition、等待 body 静止、验证成功 value，并在恢复 wrapper signal 后规范化 around result 与 body-deferred contexts；pipeline throw 成为 final error。
items.titleEn: Around dispatch, caller-signal fusion, body execution, and deferred context
items.supportsEn: The registry fuses wrapper and original caller signals, resolves the current definition, awaits body quiescence, validates a successful value, restores the wrapper signal, and normalizes around results and body-deferred contexts; pipeline throws become final errors.

items.title: Post 后的 captured finalizer、双 materialization 与 observer containment
items.supports: Finalization 运行 post 后重查取消，materialize candidate，调用调用开始时捕获的 content-only finalizer，再 materialize/freeze；result observers 的同步/异步失败全部隔离。
items.titleEn: Captured finalizer, double materialization, and observer containment after post
items.supportsEn: Finalization runs post and rechecks cancellation, materializes the candidate, invokes the content-only finalizer captured at call start, materializes and freezes again, and contains all synchronous and asynchronous result-observer failures.

items.title: Pre/post decision vocabulary 与单调 guard
items.supports: Pre 只能 allow/deny/ask，刻意没有 argument rewrite；post 可 accept、替换单一 projection、追加 context 或 block；guard 只有 reason/abstain，不能 force-allow。
items.titleEn: Pre and post decision vocabulary and monotonic guards
items.supportsEn: Pre decisions can only allow, deny, or ask and deliberately cannot rewrite arguments; post may accept, replace one projection, add context, or block; a guard can return a reason or abstain but cannot force allow.

items.title: Caller/wrapper signal fusion 与两种取消结果
items.supports: Dispatch-scoped relay 同时监听 caller 与 wrapper 并在 settle 清理；取消按 body 是否启动映射为 ABORTED 或 ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH，并保留已有 additional contexts。
items.titleEn: Caller and wrapper signal fusion and the two cancellation outcomes
items.supportsEn: A dispatch-scoped relay watches caller and wrapper signals and cleans up at settlement; cancellation maps to ABORTED or ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH according to whether the body started and preserves existing additional contexts.

items.title: Post-execute 的 value/content replacement、block 与 context 规则
items.supports: Post accept 可替换 value 或 content 但不能同时；value 重新走 canonical projection，failed value 不可替换；block 丢弃 body contexts，仅保留 blocker 明示 contexts。
items.titleEn: Value or content replacement, blocking, and context rules in post-execute
items.supportsEn: Post accept may replace value or content but not both; value reruns canonical projection and cannot replace a failure, while block discards body contexts and keeps only contexts explicitly supplied by the blocker.

items.title: Provider-neutral call/result render-intent vocabulary
items.supports: Core 定义 generic/terminal/diff pending cards 与 generic/terminal/diff/search/read/web completed cards；结构化 fields 支持 follow-along、truncation、line views 和 citations，而不依赖具体 UI。
items.titleEn: Provider-neutral call and result render-intent vocabulary
items.supportsEn: Core defines generic, terminal, and diff pending cards plus generic, terminal, diff, search, read, and web completed cards, with structured fields for follow-along, truncation, line views, and citations independent of a particular UI.

items.title: Host 对 live/replay presenter 的配对与 fail-soft 回退
items.supports: Host 用当前 scoped definition 计算 call/result view，result 需回查 args；跨页缺 call、JSON parse 或 presenter throw 都只省略 view，原 event 仍交付 generic client fallback。
items.titleEn: Host pairing and fail-soft fallback for live and replay presenters
items.supportsEn: The Host computes call and result views from the current scoped definition and looks up result arguments; a cross-page missing call, JSON parse error, or presenter throw only omits the view while the original event still ships for generic client fallback.

items.title: Tool pipeline 顺序、冻结与 Code dispatch lineage invariant
items.supports: Companion 检查每个 execution 的 pre/execute/post 阶段顺序、最终 execution/result/content 冻结与非空 identity，并验证 nested code dispatch root/parent 与 open Turn enclosure。
items.titleEn: Invariant for tool-pipeline order, freezing, and Code dispatch lineage
items.supportsEn: The companion checks pre, execute, and post stage order per execution, frozen final execution, result, and content with nonempty identity, and nested Code dispatch root/parent lineage within an open Turn.

items.title: Code runtime 在 assembly 与 execution 之间未绑定的动态窗口
items.supports: Runtime 在 prompt assembly 与 run_code 执行时分别 live-read；源码明确记录热重载跨语言可能把一种 SDK 写出的程序交给另一 runtime，并将 request binding 推迟。
items.titleEn: The unbound Code-runtime window between assembly and execution
items.supportsEn: The runtime is read live during prompt assembly and again during run_code execution; source explicitly records that a cross-language hot reload could hand a program written for one SDK to another runtime and defers request binding.

items.title: 生成工具目录的口径与完整 package map
items.supports: 目录说明真实启动工具插件以收集动态 schema、默认与 required 分支、可配置名称和 examples 排除，并列出固定基线全部 shipped 工具包及其名称、依赖、副作用和别名。
items.titleEn: Generated-tool-catalog scope and complete package map
items.supportsEn: The catalog explains real plugin boot for dynamic schemas, default and required branches, configurable names, and excluded examples, then lists every shipped tool package at the pinned baseline with names, dependencies, effects, and aliases.

items.title: 目录 completeness guard、逐包独立 boot 与 schema 渲染
items.supports: 生成器拒绝遗漏磁盘 tool package 和零 schema 的 pending boot；每包使用 fresh Context 装载 ToolRuntime、收集 scoped schemas、dispose，再渲染 name、description、parameters 与 source。
items.titleEn: Catalog completeness guards, isolated package boots, and schema rendering
items.supportsEn: The generator rejects omitted on-disk tool packages and pending boots that harvest zero schemas, then uses a fresh Context per package to load ToolRuntime, collect scoped schemas, dispose, and render name, description, parameters, and source.

items.title: 24 个 shipped 工具包的名称与能力 seam
items.supports: Package map 逐包列出模型可见名称、requires、writes/affects、shipped aliases 和 deployment note，包括 opt-in Cordis、条件 read_image、可配置 subagent 与 child-only report。
items.titleEn: Names and capability seams for 24 shipped tool packages
items.supportsEn: The package map lists model-visible names, requirements, writes or effects, shipped aliases, and deployment notes for every package, including opt-in Cordis, conditional read_image, configured subagents, and child-only report.

items.title: Standard preset 的 shell、filesystem、jobs、skill、goal 与 plan 工具
items.supports: 配置按平台二选一 shell，装载 fs/search、job controls、Skill、Goal 与固定存在的 exit_plan_mode，并明确计划模式保持 tool catalog 不变以稳定 request cache。
items.titleEn: Shell, filesystem, jobs, Skill, Goal, and plan tools in the standard preset
items.supportsEn: The preset selects one platform shell, mounts fs/search, job controls, Skill, Goal, and the stable exit_plan_mode schema, and explicitly keeps the tool catalog unchanged across plan-mode transitions for request-cache stability.

items.title: Standard preset 的 delegation、workflow、interaction 与 Web 工具
items.supports: 配置装载三项 child control、spawn/fork 两个 continuable 名称、workflow、Ralph、ask、todo 与仅 search 的 Web 工具，并把 Codex/Claude Code delegation 和 fetch 显式关闭。
items.titleEn: Delegation, workflow, interaction, and Web tools in the standard preset
items.supportsEn: The preset mounts three child controls, continuable spawn and fork names, workflow, Ralph, ask, todo, and search-only Web, while explicitly disabling Codex and Claude Code delegation and fetch.

items.title: Base host 的 JSONL、local attachment 与关闭 FTS 组合
items.supports: 基线 Host 装载 local attachment service，使 standard fs package 能注册 read_image；同一片段也显示 Session Query service 存在但全文搜索默认 openAt never。
items.titleEn: JSONL, local attachments, and disabled FTS in the base Host
items.supportsEn: The baseline Host mounts a local attachment service, allowing the standard fs package to register read_image; the same region shows Session Query present while full-text search defaults to openAt never.

items.title: Minimal preset 的完整两工具 composition
items.supports: Minimal 用 complete fixed persona、关闭 runtime context、无 compaction，并在 isolated PTY 与 filesystem realms 中只暴露 persistent bash 和 str_replace_editor。
items.titleEn: The complete two-tool minimal composition
items.supportsEn: Minimal uses a complete fixed persona, suppresses runtime context, omits compaction, and exposes only persistent bash and str_replace_editor in isolated PTY and filesystem realms.

items.title: Shipped 工具的保守并行声明清单
items.supports: 实现说明把 Web search/fetch、filesystem read、Session Query trace/read 与 subagent delegation 列为 opt-in，并明确写/edit、shell、query search、workflow、human、todo、Code 与 Cordis 保持 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Conservative parallel declarations for shipped tools
items.supportsEn: The implementation note lists Web search and fetch, filesystem reads, Session Query trace and read, and subagent delegation as opt-ins, while writes and edits, shells, query searches, workflow, human interaction, todo, Code, and Cordis remain exclusive.

items.title: 从 pre-step 到 Provider request 的模型上下文构造
items.supports: Agent 认领输入并组装 system/runtime context，经 waterfall 接受后把 user/context message 写入 Session；每次请求只使用 deriveMessages() 的当前 Surface，并耐久记录 route、system 与 tools header。
items.titleEn: Model-context construction from pre-step to Provider request
items.supportsEn: The Agent claims input and assembles system and runtime context, durably appends accepted user and context messages after the waterfall, builds each request from the current Surface via deriveMessages(), and records route, system, and tools headers.

items.title: 默认 JSONL 持久化与关闭的全文索引
items.supports: Base 把 Session 日志写入 DSH home 下的 sessions，并挂载 SQLite sessionQuery；openAt: never 保留 exact read、title 与 lineage，却让全文搜索失败且不打开 SQLite。
items.titleEn: Default JSONL persistence with full-text indexing disabled
items.supportsEn: Base writes Session logs under the DSH home sessions directory and mounts SQLite sessionQuery; openAt never preserves exact reads, titles, and lineage while search fails and SQLite is never opened.

items.title: Standard preset 的 Skills 与 compaction 组合
items.supports: Standard 挂载 filesystem skill provider、model-facing skill tool，以及 basic compaction、manual command 和 tool-result pruner。
items.titleEn: Skills and compaction in the standard preset
items.supportsEn: The standard preset mounts the filesystem Skill provider, model-facing Skill tool, basic compaction, manual command, and tool-result pruner.

items.title: Minimal preset 明确省略 runtime context、compaction 与 Skills
items.supports: Minimal 是 fixed-prompt 两工具组合，关闭 runtime-context snapshot，只挂载 persistent bash 与 str_replace_editor，并在配置注释中明确没有 context compaction。
items.titleEn: The minimal preset explicitly omits runtime context, compaction, and Skills
items.supportsEn: Minimal is a fixed-prompt two-tool composition that suppresses runtime-context snapshots, mounts only persistent Bash and str_replace_editor, and explicitly states that context compaction is absent.

items.title: 耐久 append commit 与 exact prepare/load
items.supports: Coordinator 校验 seq 连续性，只有 backend batch commit 后才推进 durable cursor；prepare/load 通过 reservation 和稳定日志取得精确恢复视图。
items.titleEn: Durable append commits and exact prepare/load
items.supportsEn: The coordinator validates contiguous seq values, advances its durable cursor only after a backend batch commits, and uses reservations plus a stable log to produce exact prepared and loaded recovery views.

items.title: Session write-behind、flush barrier 与 disposal drain
items.supports: 每个 frozen event 进入 persistence-owned bounded write queue，session/flush 是即时耐久屏障，Session disposal 会 drain 写入后再释放 lifecycle state。
items.titleEn: Session write-behind, flush barriers, and disposal drains
items.supportsEn: Every frozen event enters a persistence-owned bounded write queue, session/flush is the immediate durability barrier, and Session disposal drains writes before releasing lifecycle state.

items.title: JSONL 的 owner-only 与不覆盖发布路径
items.supports: POSIX materialization 以 0700 建目录、0600 建同步临时文件，通过 link 和目录 fsync 发布，并拒绝覆盖既有 Session 日志。
items.titleEn: Owner-only, non-overwriting JSONL publication
items.supportsEn: POSIX materialization creates directories with 0700 and synchronized temporary files with 0600, publishes through link plus directory fsync, and refuses to overwrite an existing Session log.

items.title: 显式跨会话快照的候选、预算与注入
items.supports: Resolver 把来源标为 untrusted read-only，默认最多 3 个引用、50 个候选和每来源 65536 bytes；候选 cwd 只排序，prepare 按精确 ID 读取 Surface 并产生一个带来源 user context。
items.titleEn: Candidate, budget, and injection semantics of explicit cross-Session snapshots
items.supportsEn: The resolver marks sources untrusted and read-only, defaults to three references, 50 candidates, and 65,536 bytes per source, uses cwd only for candidate ranking, and prepares one sourced user context from exact Surface reads.

items.title: Session reference 的文本投影与精确 UTF-8 retention
items.supports: Projection 只保留直接用户、assistant text 与 canonical checkpoint；工具和注入上下文被排除，超预算时先丢旧非 checkpoint 消息，再 head/tail 截断并记录精确遗漏字节。
items.titleEn: Text projection and exact UTF-8 retention for Session references
items.supportsEn: Projection keeps direct-user text, assistant text, and canonical checkpoints, excludes tools and injected context, then drops older non-checkpoint messages and head-tail truncates with exact omitted-byte accounting when over budget.

items.title: Session reference 快照、排除与 replay 独立性测试
items.supports: 测试要求只投影当前对话与 checkpoint、排除嵌套注入，固定 capture metadata；来源后续 mutation、compaction 或删除不会改变目标，并可由 fresh Session replay。
items.titleEn: Session-reference snapshot, exclusion, and replay-independence tests
items.supportsEn: Tests require projection of only current conversation and checkpoints, exclusion of nested injections, fixed capture metadata, target independence after source mutation, compaction, or deletion, and equality after fresh Session replay.

items.title: Context 包总览将 session-reference 标为 opt-in
items.supports: Context package overview 只称 agent-instructions 属于默认 bundle，并把 time-context、tmux-context 与 session-reference 明确列为 opt-in。
items.titleEn: The context package overview marks session-reference as opt-in
items.supportsEn: The context package overview names only agent-instructions as part of the default bundle and explicitly classifies time-context, tmux-context, and session-reference as opt-in.

items.title: Session reference 的 trusted-caller 与 snapshot 限制
items.supports: README 明确声明 service 假定 Host 已获准读取 sessionQuery 暴露的全部 Session，且引用是 text-only snapshot，不是 live link、fork、resume 或 subscription。
items.titleEn: Trusted-caller and snapshot limitations of Session reference
items.supportsEn: The README explicitly says the service assumes its Host may read every Session exposed by sessionQuery and that references are text-only snapshots, not live links, forks, resumes, or subscriptions.

items.title: README 所宣称的 standard TUI 注入集成
items.supports: README 声称 standard TUI 在 idle 时安装 one-shot pre-step wrapper，并在 running 时 inject 后 steer；固定提交的发布 composition 与生产消费方没有对应挂载。
items.titleEn: README claim of standard-TUI injection integration
items.supportsEn: The README says the standard TUI installs a one-shot pre-step wrapper while idle and injects before steering while running, but the pinned shipped composition and production consumers contain no corresponding mount.

items.title: Session query 的 live-first logical corpus
items.supports: Query 列举 persistence 与 live Session 时以 live 覆盖，单目标始终优先 detached live snapshot；cold batch 有界并发、逐项隔离失败，并在 persistence read 后重查 attach race。
items.titleEn: The live-first logical corpus of Session query
items.supportsEn: Query merges persistence with live Sessions using live precedence, always prefers a detached live snapshot for one target, bounds cold-batch concurrency, isolates per-item failures, and rechecks attachment after persisted reads.

items.title: Raw log 到 current/shadowed/log-only 搜索文档
items.supports: Document builder 对完整 raw log 使用 canonical Surface fold，为每个可搜索事件保留 Session、seq、type、time、surface classification 与抽取文本。
items.titleEn: Raw-log projection into current, shadowed, and log-only search documents
items.supportsEn: The document builder applies the canonical Surface fold to a complete raw log and retains Session, seq, type, time, Surface classification, and extracted text for every searchable event.

items.title: 第一方 Session 搜索文本抽取规则
items.supports: 抽取包含 user/assistant text、tool name/arguments/results、Todo 与部分 Turn error，排除 reasoning、raw chunk、request header、未知 event/block；user/message 路径不检查 source。
items.titleEn: First-party Session search-text extraction rules
items.supportsEn: Extraction includes user and assistant text, tool names, arguments and results, Todos, and selected Turn errors, excludes reasoning, raw chunks, request headers, and unknown events or blocks, and does not inspect user-message source.

items.title: Owner-only 的可丢弃 SQLite FTS5 派生索引
items.supports: 持久数据库目录/文件以 0700/0600 创建，拒绝外来数据库并可重建旧派生 schema；persistent/live 文档以 unicode61 FTS5 明文表保存。
items.titleEn: Owner-only disposable SQLite FTS5 derived index
items.supportsEn: Persistent database directories and files are created with 0700 and 0600, foreign databases are refused, old derived schemas may be rebuilt, and persistent and live documents use plaintext unicode61 FTS5 tables.

items.title: openAt 模式与完全关闭全文搜索的分支
items.supports: openAt 可为 startup、first-search 或 never；never 保留继承的 exact read/filter/trace，但在 import/open SQLite 前确定性拒绝两个全文搜索 API。
items.titleEn: openAt modes and the branch that fully disables full-text search
items.supportsEn: openAt may be startup, first-search, or never; never retains inherited exact reads, filters, and traces but deterministically rejects both full-text APIs before importing or opening SQLite.

items.title: 默认未挂载的 model-facing Session query tools
items.supports: Opt-in 包声明五个模型工具，发布 Host 默认不挂载；README 同时定义 exact-cwd authority、隐藏未授权 lineage，并说明包自身不截断输出。
items.titleEn: Model-facing Session-query tools not mounted by default
items.supportsEn: The opt-in package declares five model tools that shipped Hosts do not mount by default, defines exact-cwd authority and hidden unauthorized lineage, and states that the package itself does not truncate output.

items.title: Session query 模型工具的 workspace 授权与复查
items.supports: Caller 必须来自 exec.agent；self 可读，跨会话必须 exact cwd match，批量 ID 先过滤，读取后的 header 再校验，未经授权的 lineage 子树被折叠为 null marker。
items.titleEn: Workspace authorization and rechecks for Session-query model tools
items.supportsEn: The caller must come from exec.agent; self is readable, cross-Session access requires exact cwd equality, batches are prefiltered, observed headers are rechecked, and unauthorized lineage subtrees collapse to null markers.

items.title: Workspace Browser 的本地优先与远端内容搜索 UX
items.supports: 非空查询立即匹配 title/workspace，250ms 后合并 Host current-conversation content hits；远端失败保留本地结果并警告，最终去重并限制 20 条。
items.titleEn: Local-first and remote-content search UX in Workspace Browser
items.supportsEn: A nonblank query immediately matches title and workspace, then merges Host current-conversation content hits after 250 ms; remote failure preserves local results with a warning, and the final list is deduplicated and capped at 20.

items.title: Web Session 可见 baseline、搜索 hit gate 与错误边界
items.supports: Host 以 attached 与带 cwd 的可服务 cold Session 构造可见集合，搜索只接受该集合中的 current user/assistant hit；失败响应仍拼接底层错误，并注明多用户部署前应 redact。
items.titleEn: Web Session visibility baseline, search-hit gate, and error boundary
items.supportsEn: The Host builds visibility from attached and servable cwd-bearing cold Sessions, accepts only current user or assistant hits in that set, and still interpolates underlying errors with a note to redact before multi-user deployment.

items.title: 分层 Skill registry、shadowing 与按需加载
items.supports: Registry 合并 global 与 scope chain，最近 scope 的同名项覆盖远层、层内按 rank 去重；list/snapshot 返回摘要，get 按需向 winning provider 加载完整定义。
items.titleEn: Layered Skill registry, shadowing, and on-demand loading
items.supportsEn: The registry merges global and scope-chain layers, lets the nearest scope shadow same-name entries while rank resolves within a layer, returns summaries from list and snapshot, and loads the winning full definition on demand through get.

items.title: Filesystem Skill provider 的顺序、watch 默认值与名称漂移
items.supports: 配置定义项目/custom/用户 rank，默认 watch、follow symlinks 和 128 个 project watchers；JSDoc 称 providerName 默认 local，而 schema 实际默认 filesystem。
items.titleEn: Filesystem Skill provider ordering, watch defaults, and naming drift
items.supportsEn: Configuration defines project, custom, and user ranks and defaults watching, symlink following, and 128 project watchers; JSDoc says providerName defaults to local while the schema actually defaults to filesystem.

items.title: Project、custom、user 与 bundled Skill roots
items.supports: Provider 从最近项目的 .dsh/skills 与 .agents/skills 开始，再加入 custom roots、两个用户 roots 与可选 trusted bundled root。
items.titleEn: Project, custom, user, and bundled Skill roots
items.supportsEn: The provider starts with the nearest project's .dsh/skills and .agents/skills, then adds custom roots, two user roots, and an optional trusted bundled root.

items.title: Skill 文件发现、frontmatter 解析与无 body cap 读取
items.supports: 扫描仅接受 flat .md 或一层目录 SKILL.md，解析 name/description/invocation 并保留完整 trimmed body；Node 与 policy filesystem read 路径都没有 Skill-level byte cap。
items.titleEn: Skill-file discovery, frontmatter parsing, and uncapped body reads
items.supportsEn: Discovery accepts flat .md files or one-level SKILL.md directories, parses name, description, and invocation while retaining the full trimmed body, and neither Node nor policy-filesystem reads impose a Skill-level byte cap.

items.title: Skill catalog、model load 与用户显式注入
items.supports: 每条 catalog description 默认 cap 500，但 whole catalog 无总量 cap；模型工具与 user gesture 都复查 invocation policy，完整正文按需加载，只有 direct-user 的空白边界 /name 可产生耐久 instructions context。
items.titleEn: Skill catalog, model loading, and explicit user injection
items.supportsEn: Each catalog description defaults to a 500-character cap but the whole catalog has no aggregate cap; the model tool and user gesture recheck invocation policy, load full bodies on demand, and only whitespace-bounded /name in direct user input creates durable instructions context.

items.title: Host skill.list 的 Session scope 与 user-invocable 过滤
items.supports: Host 不创建或 resume Agent，只从 attached Session header 解析 cwd，并按 live/preset scope 读取 registry，最终只返回 user-invocable Skill 的 wire projection。
items.titleEn: Session scope and user-invocable filtering in Host skill.list
items.supportsEn: The Host neither creates nor resumes an Agent, resolves cwd from an attached Session header, reads the registry through the live or preset scope, and returns only the wire projection of user-invocable Skills.

items.title: Web Skill 候选缓存、字面量 gesture 与失败降级
items.supports: 客户端按普通 Session 缓存 user-invocable catalog，/ 菜单选择写入字面量 /name，Host pre-step 统一解释；skill.list 失败会被折叠成静默菜单分组缺失。
items.titleEn: Web Skill candidate caching, literal gestures, and failure degradation
items.supportsEn: The client caches the user-invocable catalog per ordinary Session, writes literal /name from the slash menu for Host pre-step interpretation, and folds skill.list failure into a silently missing menu group.

items.title: 默认关闭的第三方 Memory MCP 责任边界
items.supports: 三个示例只提供 opt-in overlay；Harness 管理 MCP transport/tool discovery，不负责 server 安装、数据库、模型/embedding、provider 数据与语义。README 分别说明 provider 存储，并要求人工验证跨 Session recall。
items.titleEn: Responsibility boundary of default-off third-party Memory MCP examples
items.supportsEn: The three examples are opt-in overlays only; Harness owns MCP transport and tool discovery, not server installation, databases, models or embeddings, provider data, or semantics. The README describes provider storage and requires manual cross-Session recall validation.

items.title: Memory MCP overlay 与 fixture discovery 测试边界
items.supports: 测试检查 row 字段、版本 pin 与明显密钥，再把真实命令替换为 keyless fixture 验证工具发现；它没有运行三个真实 memory provider。
items.titleEn: Memory MCP overlay and fixture-discovery test boundary
items.supportsEn: Tests check row fields, version pins, and obvious secrets, then replace each real command with a keyless fixture to prove tool discovery; none of the three real memory providers is executed.

items.title: SessionPersistence 权威事实与读取面
items.supports: Service Definition 将 SessionHeader 与连续 SessionEvent 定义为耐久事实，并区分 locate、create、append、prepare、load、inspect、readFrom、list 与 listSnapshots。
items.titleEn: SessionPersistence authority and read surfaces
items.supportsEn: The Service Definition makes SessionHeader plus contiguous SessionEvents durable facts and distinguishes locate, create, append, prepare, load, inspect, readFrom, list, and listSnapshots.

items.title: Session 持久化后端合同
items.supports: 后端提供读前缀、revision、可选 suffix seek、原子首次 materialization、耐久 append、repair、list 与 close；协调器拥有其余协议。
items.titleEn: Session persistence backend contract
items.supportsEn: A backend supplies prefix reads, revisions, optional suffix seeking, atomic first materialization, durable append, repair, listing, and close while the coordinator owns the rest of the protocol.

items.title: PersistenceCoordinator 状态与提交顺序
items.supports: 协调器按 Session ID 管理状态、promise chain 与 preparation，按 live Session 管理生命周期，并只在 appendBatch 耐久返回后推进 materialized、cursor 与 cache invalidation。
items.titleEn: PersistenceCoordinator state and commit order
items.supportsEn: The coordinator keys state, promise chains, and preparations by Session ID, lifecycle state by live Session, and advances materialized state, cursor, and cache invalidation only after durable appendBatch completion.

items.title: Prepare、Load、Inspect 与 ReadFrom 的分工
items.supports: prepare 预留精确未发布 Session，load 提交冷恢复，inspect 借用不变视图且不提交修复，readFrom 绕过 preparation cache 并保持非变更。
items.titleEn: Prepare, load, inspect, and readFrom roles
items.supportsEn: Prepare reserves the exact unpublished Session, load commits cold recovery, inspect borrows an immutable view without committing repair, and readFrom bypasses the preparation cache while remaining non-mutating.

items.title: 失败安全的 Session 写后队列
items.supports: 队列克隆事件、使用固定 deadline、共享并发 flush barrier；失败 batch 恢复到新事件之前，显式 flush 重试并排空到静止点。
items.titleEn: Failure-safe Session write-behind queue
items.supportsEn: The queue clones events, uses a fixed deadline, shares concurrent flush barriers, restores failed batches ahead of newer events, and uses explicit flush to retry and drain to quiescence.

items.title: JSONL 根目录与顺序介质边界
items.supports: JSONL 构造器一次解析 root、补齐程序化构造默认值、返回绝对 artifact path，并故意不实现 seek-capable loadStoredFrom。
items.titleEn: JSONL root and sequential-medium boundary
items.supportsEn: The JSONL constructor resolves its root once, normalizes programmatic-construction defaults, returns absolute artifact paths, and intentionally omits seek-capable loadStoredFrom.

items.title: JSONL Header、路径编码与 chunk packing
items.supports: 格式以专用 Session Header 开头，将未验证的 branded ID 注入式转义为安全路径段，并可把 delta run 无损打包为 storage rows。
items.titleEn: JSONL header, path encoding, and chunk packing
items.supportsEn: The format starts with a dedicated Session header, injectively escapes unvalidated branded IDs into safe path segments, and can losslessly pack delta runs into storage rows.

items.title: JSONL 完整行的尾部分类
items.supports: scanner 对完整换行记录的 JSON、storage shape 与 seq 做检查；异常后若没有遇到后续 turn/end，finish 返回异常前的 committedBytes，使完整异常行也进入可截断尾部。
items.titleEn: Tail classification of complete JSONL rows
items.supportsEn: The scanner checks JSON, storage shape, and sequence for complete newline-terminated records; if no later turn/end follows a defect, finish returns the pre-defect committedBytes, placing even a complete bad row in the truncatable suffix.

items.title: JSONL 读取、发布、回滚与 repair
items.supports: 读取器返回 byte-offset torn marker 与可恢复完整事件；首次写经 synced temp 与无覆盖发布，append 失败回滚长度，repair 先 truncate+fsync 再经正常 append 写 recovered events 和 closers。
items.titleEn: JSONL reads, publication, rollback, and repair
items.supportsEn: The reader returns a byte-offset torn marker plus recoverable complete events; first write uses a synced temp and no-clobber publication, failed append restores length, and repair truncates and syncs before normally appending recovered events and closers.

items.title: Session SQLite 严格 schema 与拒绝式版本策略
items.supports: 后端使用 schema version 15、application id、store identity、sessions 与 events STRICT tables；未知、外来或非空未版本化数据库拒绝而不迁移。
items.titleEn: Strict Session SQLite schema and refusal-based versioning
items.supportsEn: The backend uses schema version 15, an application id, store identity, and STRICT sessions and events tables; unknown, foreign, or nonempty unversioned databases are refused rather than migrated.

items.title: SQLite torn suffix 判定
items.supports: scanRows 将最后一个有效 turn/end 以内的坏 JSON 或 seq gap 视为 committed corruption，只把其后的第一个缺陷标记为可丢弃 torn tail。
items.titleEn: SQLite torn-suffix classification
items.supportsEn: scanRows treats bad JSON or a sequence gap through the last valid turn/end as committed corruption and marks only a later first defect as a discardable torn tail.

items.title: SQLite append 与 repair 事务
items.supports: 首次 materialization 和 batch append 在一个事务内；repair 在另一个事务中删除 torn suffix、插入 synthetic closers，并一次推进 revision。
items.titleEn: SQLite append and repair transactions
items.supportsEn: First materialization and batch append occur in one transaction; repair deletes the torn suffix, inserts synthetic closers, and advances the revision in another single transaction.

items.title: SQLite 真正的 suffix seek
items.supports: loadStoredFrom 以 session_id 与 seq >= fromSeq 直接查询并只扫描所选行；torn tail 只缩短返回视图，不触发修复。
items.titleEn: True SQLite suffix seeking
items.supportsEn: loadStoredFrom directly queries by session_id and seq >= fromSeq and scans only selected rows; a torn tail shortens the returned view without repair.

items.title: Session SQLite 直接构造默认值泄漏
items.supports: schema 将 journalMode 默认成 wal，但构造器只补齐 cache 与 batching 默认值，把仍可缺省的 journalMode 断言为 Required 后传给 openDb。
items.titleEn: Session SQLite direct-constructor default leak
items.supportsEn: The schema defaults journalMode to wal, but the constructor normalizes only cache and batching defaults and passes the still-optional journalMode onward via a Required cast.

items.title: Session SQLite 直接构造测试显式传 WAL
items.supports: 绕过 Schemastery 的直接构造测试验证 preparation cache 默认值，但显式传 journalMode: wal，因此未覆盖 journalMode 缺省。
items.titleEn: Session SQLite direct-construction test supplies WAL
items.supportsEn: The direct-construction test bypasses Schemastery to verify the preparation-cache default but explicitly supplies journalMode: wal, leaving omitted journalMode uncovered.

items.title: 通用 SQLite Storage 构造器默认值泄漏
items.supports: 配置 schema 承诺 WAL 默认值，但公开构造器把 optional journalMode 强制断言后直接传给异步 openDatabase。
items.titleEn: Generic SQLite Storage constructor default leak
items.supportsEn: The config schema promises a WAL default, but the public constructor force-casts the optional journalMode and passes it directly to asynchronous openDatabase.

items.title: 通用 SQLite open 路径解引用 journalMode
items.supports: openDatabase 解析数据库路径后进入 configureDatabase，后者无防护调用 journalMode.toUpperCase()。
items.titleEn: Generic SQLite open path dereferences journalMode
items.supportsEn: After resolving the database path, openDatabase enters configureDatabase, which calls journalMode.toUpperCase() without a fallback.

items.title: 通用 Storage backend seam
items.supports: StorageBackend 拥有一个 medium 与生命周期；KvUnit 只承诺单次调用原子耐久，把 opaque JSON、schema 和并发写排序留给调用方。
items.titleEn: Generic Storage backend seam
items.supportsEn: StorageBackend owns one medium and its lifecycle; KvUnit guarantees only per-call atomic durability while leaving opaque-JSON schemas and concurrent write ordering to callers.

items.title: Storage registry 的非拥有型注销
items.supports: registry disposer 仅在 identity 仍匹配时删除名称，明确不会 close backend；medium 生命周期属于 provider plugin。
items.titleEn: Non-owning Storage registry unregistration
items.supportsEn: The registry disposer removes a name only while identity still matches and explicitly does not close the backend; medium lifecycle belongs to the provider plugin.

items.title: Domain 的耐久先行写序
items.supports: Domain 以一个 promise chain 串行化写入，backend 成功后才更新内存并发送受控 changed notification；失败写不改变内存。
items.titleEn: Domain durability-first write ordering
items.supportsEn: Domain serializes writes through one promise chain, updates memory only after backend success, then emits a contained changed notification; failed writes leave memory untouched.

items.title: 通用 SQLite Storage 物理 schema
items.supports: 通用 backend 使用 physical user_version 1、units 与 unit_globals STRICT tables，并为每个 unit table 生成受验证的物理表名；其他 stamped version 拒绝而不迁移。
items.titleEn: Generic SQLite Storage physical schema
items.supportsEn: The generic backend uses physical user_version 1, STRICT units and unit_globals tables, and validated generated physical names for unit tables; other stamped versions are refused rather than migrated.

items.title: 通用 SQLite KV unit 原语
items.supports: 每个声明表预编译 upsert/delete/select，global slot 单独 upsert；每次 KV mutation 是一个同步 SQLite statement，经 Promise 合同结算。
items.titleEn: Generic SQLite KV unit primitives
items.supportsEn: Each declared table precompiles upsert, delete, and select statements with a separate global-slot upsert; each KV mutation is one synchronous SQLite statement settled through the Promise contract.

items.title: JSON KV 原子替换协议
items.supports: writer 在同目录创建 owner-only temp，写入并 fsync，rename 覆盖目标，再在 POSIX fsync 父目录；失败清理 temp 并传播错误。
items.titleEn: JSON KV atomic replacement protocol
items.supportsEn: The writer creates an owner-only same-directory temp, writes and fsyncs it, renames it over the target, then fsyncs the parent on POSIX; failures remove the temp and propagate.

items.title: JSON KV 失败后的内存回滚
items.supports: 每个 KV mutation 先修改 unit 内存，再发布整文件；publish 任意拒绝都会恢复旧内存，而 publish 的拒绝可能发生在 rename 之后的目录 fsync。
items.titleEn: JSON KV in-memory rollback after failure
items.supportsEn: Each KV mutation changes unit memory before publishing the whole file and restores old memory on any publish rejection, even though publication can reject during the directory fsync after rename.

items.title: JSON Storage 相对 root 缺口
items.supports: 配置要求显式 root，但 schema 接受相对 string，backend 原样保存，并在后续 openUnit 才执行 mkdir 与 join，因此 cwd 变化可重定向新 unit。
items.titleEn: JSON Storage relative-root gap
items.supportsEn: Configuration requires an explicit root, but the schema accepts a relative string, the backend stores it verbatim, and later openUnit calls mkdir and join, so a cwd change can redirect newly opened units.

items.title: Domain close 的单向失败状态
items.supports: close 首先置 disposing 并 drain chain；若 unit.close 拒绝，closed 与 onClosed 均不会到达，rejected disposal 被缓存，导致写拒绝、读仍可用且名称无法重开。
items.titleEn: One-way Domain close failure state
items.supportsEn: Close first sets disposing and drains the chain; if unit.close rejects, closed and onClosed are never reached and the rejected disposal is cached, leaving writes rejected, reads available, and the name unreopenable.

items.title: Attachment durability seam
items.supports: AttachmentStore 暴露 immutable binary reference；saveImage 必须在所属 Session event append 前完成验证与耐久提交，readImage 必须验证 bytes 与 reference。
items.titleEn: Attachment durability seam
items.supportsEn: AttachmentStore exposes immutable binary references; saveImage must validate and durably commit before the owning Session event is appended, and readImage must verify bytes against the reference.

items.title: 本地 Attachment 内容寻址发布
items.supports: local store 以 SHA-256 寻址，使用 private staging、synced file、exclusive hard-link publication 与目录 fsync，并在 dedup race 中重新读取和 hash 已有对象。
items.titleEn: Content-addressed local Attachment publication
items.supportsEn: The local store addresses by SHA-256, uses private staging, a synced file, exclusive hard-link publication, and directory fsync, and re-reads and hashes an existing object during deduplication races.

items.title: Attachment README 声称 read 完整 decode
items.supports: README 明确写道 write admission 与 reads 都会在接受 format 与 dimensions 前完整 decode raster。
items.titleEn: Attachment README claims full decode on read
items.supportsEn: The README explicitly says both write admission and reads fully decode the raster before accepting format and dimensions.

items.title: Attachment admission 与 read 实际分支
items.supports: admission 通过 detectImage，read 先验证 digest 再调用 probeImage，并对比 media type、bytes、width 与 height。
items.titleEn: Actual Attachment admission and read branches
items.supportsEn: Admission goes through detectImage, while read verifies the digest before calling probeImage and comparing media type, bytes, width, and height.

items.title: 完整 decode 与 Header probe 的实现差异
items.supports: probeImage 只读取 Sharp metadata；detectImage 检查 pixel limit 后调用 image.raw().toBuffer() 完整 decode。
items.titleEn: Implementation difference between full decode and header probe
items.supportsEn: probeImage reads only Sharp metadata, while detectImage checks the pixel limit and calls image.raw().toBuffer() for a full decode.

items.title: Attachment 无限期保留限制
items.supports: 已知限制明确说明对象无限期保留，reference-aware garbage collection 尚未实现。
items.titleEn: Indefinite Attachment retention limitation
items.supportsEn: Known limitations explicitly state that objects are retained indefinitely and reference-aware garbage collection is deferred.

items.title: Workspace Domain schema
items.supports: Workspace domain version 2 由一张 workspaces table 与 global state 组成；ID、path、title、Session ID 与 timestamp 的运行时 shape 基本都是 plain strings。
items.titleEn: Workspace Domain schema
items.supportsEn: Workspace domain version 2 consists of one workspaces table and global state; runtime shapes for ids, path, title, Session ids, and timestamps are largely plain strings.

items.title: Workspace 跨 record 不变量
items.supports: 启动验证拒绝重复 order ID、missing/orphan rows、重复 canonical path 与一个 Session 被多个 Workspace account。
items.titleEn: Cross-record Workspace invariants
items.supportsEn: Startup validation rejects repeated order IDs, missing or orphan rows, duplicate canonical paths, and a Session accounted by multiple Workspaces.

items.title: Workspace create-time title 遗留分支
items.supports: 公开 create(path, title?) 仍接收 raw optional title，但源码 TODO 说明最后一个 production caller 已删除并要求移除该参数。
items.titleEn: Stale Workspace create-time title branch
items.supportsEn: Public create(path, title?) still accepts an optional raw title, but a source TODO says its last production caller was deleted and calls for removing the parameter.

items.title: Workspace title setter 无语义校验
items.supports: setTitle 接受任意 string 并直接写入 record mutation，没有 nonblank、trim 或长度检查。
items.titleEn: Workspace title setter lacks semantic validation
items.supportsEn: setTitle accepts any string and writes it directly through the record mutation without nonblank, trimming, or length checks.

items.title: Workspace Header index 刷新路径
items.supports: startup replacement 会清空三张 Header/path map；runtime uncached lookup 只增量 index list 结果，cached hit 直接返回且没有 public full-refresh path。
items.titleEn: Workspace header-index refresh paths
items.supportsEn: Startup replacement clears all three header and path maps; an uncached runtime lookup only incrementally indexes list results, while a cached hit returns directly and no public full-refresh path exists.

items.title: Workspace README 的 refresh 表述
items.supports: README 声称外部 Session deletion 或 cwd damage 会在下次 refresh 或 restart 后被观察。
items.titleEn: Workspace README refresh statement
items.supportsEn: The README says external Session deletion or cwd damage is observed after the next refresh or restart.

items.title: Workspace 初始化顺序
items.supports: 初始化先 open Domain、恢复 pending mutation 与验证 state；未初始化时 list Header、完整替换 index 并 bootstrap，已初始化时启动路径完整替换 Header index。
items.titleEn: Workspace initialization order
items.supportsEn: Initialization opens the Domain, recovers a pending mutation, and validates state; an uninitialized registry lists headers, fully replaces the index, and bootstraps, while an initialized startup fully replaces the header index.

items.title: Workspace Header-only bootstrap
items.supports: bootstrap 按 canonical cwd 将 Header 分组，复用部分 record，写 Workspace rows 与 order，并把 initialized=true marker 放在最后写。
items.titleEn: Header-only Workspace bootstrap
items.supportsEn: Bootstrap groups headers by canonical cwd, reuses partial records, writes Workspace rows and order, and writes the initialized=true marker last.

items.title: Workspace 两次写 mutation 与恢复
items.supports: create/delete 在 record 与 order 可能分叉前写 durable pending marker，包含补偿分支；startup 只完成 marker 指定的 mutation，不猜测其他 divergence。
items.titleEn: Two-write Workspace mutation and recovery
items.supportsEn: Create and delete write a durable pending marker before record and order can diverge, include compensation paths, and startup completes only the named mutation rather than guessing other divergence.

items.title: Workspace 删除与所有权边界
items.supports: Workspace 删除只移除 registration、durable order entry 与 Session account；目录、用户文件、live Sessions 与 persisted logs 均不触碰。
items.titleEn: Workspace deletion and ownership boundary
items.supportsEn: Workspace deletion removes only registration, durable order entry, and Session accounting; it never touches the directory, user files, live Sessions, or persisted logs.

items.title: Plan 日志状态与进程内待选状态
items.supports: plan/mode 是 log-only、非 Surface、last-write-wins 的布尔事件；Controller 另以 Session 键控 WeakMap 保存待提交选择。
items.titleEn: Logged Plan state and process-local pending intent
items.supportsEn: plan/mode is a log-only, non-Surface, last-write-wins boolean event, while the controller separately keeps pending selections in a Session-keyed WeakMap.

items.title: Plan 的 pre-step 与 prompt 组装
items.supports: accepted pre-step 才提交 pending；append 失败保留选择且不阻断 Step；plan:policy 优先读取 pending target。
items.titleEn: Plan pre-Step and prompt assembly
items.supportsEn: Only an accepted pre-Step commits pending state; append failure retains it without blocking the Step, and plan:policy reads the pending target first.

items.title: Plan 双事件 projection
items.supports: plan projection 折叠 command/run 的 wanted target 与 plan/mode 的 committed active，导出 active/pending。
items.titleEn: Plan double-event projection
items.supportsEn: The plan projection folds command/run into a wanted target and plan/mode into committed active state, exposing active and pending.

items.title: Plan 命令与评审退出工具
items.supports: /plan、精确小写 off、可选 steer message，以及 exit_plan_mode 的 Markdown、评审、dismiss 与延迟退出规则。
items.titleEn: Plan command and reviewed exit tool
items.supportsEn: Defines /plan, exact lowercase off, optional steering text, and exit_plan_mode Markdown, review, dismissal, and delayed-exit rules.

items.title: Plan 选择的提交边界与叙述
items.supports: 空闲时立即提交，open Turn 中排队到 accepted pre-step；失败保留 pending，并仅在上一 request header 见过相反模式时叙述切换。
items.titleEn: Plan selection commit boundary and narration
items.supportsEn: Idle selections commit immediately; open-Turn selections wait for an accepted pre-Step, survive append failure, and narrate only when the last request header saw the opposite mode.

items.title: Plan 评审的人类交互所有权
items.supports: 带 Agent 的提问要求 registry 中精确 live runtime root；live-owned child 被拒，恢复为 root 的 lineage Session 可提问。
items.titleEn: Human-interaction ownership for Plan review
items.supportsEn: Agent-bound questions require the exact live runtime root; live-owned children are rejected, while a lineage Session later resumed as a root may ask.

items.title: Plan 真实 loop 与 retry 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 Plan 中写工具仍可执行、tool schema 稳定，且 same-Step retry 复用旧 assembly，模式到后续 Step 才生效。
items.titleEn: Plan real-loop and retry tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove a write tool still executes in Plan, schemas remain stable, and a same-Step retry reuses old assembly until a later Step applies the mode.

items.title: Plan Web 状态 chip
items.supports: Web 从 plan projection 计算有效目标，仅在目标为 Plan 时显示 chip，并通过 /plan off 退出。
items.titleEn: Plan Web status chip
items.supportsEn: The Web computes the effective target from the plan projection, renders the chip only for Plan, and exits through /plan off.

items.title: Plan 专用评审面板
items.supports: 专用面板渲染 Markdown 计划、approve、decline 与 discuss/cancel，并用 one-shot latch 防止重复提交。
items.titleEn: Dedicated Plan review panel
items.supportsEn: The dedicated panel renders the Markdown plan, approve, decline, and discuss/cancel actions with a one-shot submission latch.

items.title: Base profile 的 Plan policy
items.supports: 发布配置要求只做非变更探索、提交 decision-complete 计划、保持稳定工具目录，并禁止用 todo_write 代替 Plan。
items.titleEn: Shipped base-profile Plan policy
items.supportsEn: The shipped policy requires non-mutating exploration, a decision-complete plan, a stable tool catalog, and forbids substituting todo_write for Plan.

items.title: Plan 已记录的恢复与呈现限制
items.supports: README 明确记录最后 accepted pre-step 后的选择可能在进程退出时丢失、Fork/新 spawn 差异、live child 评审限制与 Web-only 专用 renderer。
items.titleEn: Documented Plan recovery and presentation constraints
items.supportsEn: The README records loss of a post-final-pre-Step selection on process exit, Fork versus spawn behavior, live-child review restrictions, and the Web-only specialized renderer.

items.title: Goal identity、revision、phase 与 projection 类型
items.supports: GoalRef 是 revision CAS identity；四种 durable phase 与 process-local activation 分离，浏览器 projection 明确不含 activation。
items.titleEn: Goal identity, revision, phase, and projection types
items.supportsEn: GoalRef is the revision CAS identity; four durable phases are separate from process-local activation, which the browser projection deliberately omits.

items.title: Goal 严格状态 fold
items.supports: 严格 fold 校验 create/transition/clear，并只在匹配当前 active revision 的顺序 goal-sourced user/message 上增加 roundsStarted。
items.titleEn: Strict Goal state fold
items.supportsEn: The strict fold validates create, transitions, and clear, and advances roundsStarted only for the sequential goal-sourced user message matching the current active revision.

items.title: GoalService 生命周期 mutation
items.supports: get/disarm/create/edit/pause/resume/complete/block/clear 的 phase、revision、capacity 与 activation 规则。
items.titleEn: GoalService lifecycle mutations
items.supportsEn: Defines phase, revision, capacity, and activation rules for get, disarm, create, edit, pause, resume, complete, block, and clear.

items.title: Goal CAS、cache 与 commit 顺序
items.supports: 要求精确 live Agent 和当前 GoalRef；冷 cache 默认 disarmed，goal/change append 与 sync 完成后才发 goal/changed。
items.titleEn: Goal CAS, cache, and commit ordering
items.supportsEn: Requires the exact live Agent and current GoalRef; cold caches start disarmed, and goal/changed emits only after goal/change append and cache synchronization.

items.title: Goal 轻量 last-wins projection
items.supports: 浏览器 projection 仅处理 goal/change，clear 变 null，其它事件保持同一 reference；它不会随 admitted goal-round message 更新 roundsStarted。
items.titleEn: Lightweight last-wins Goal projection
items.supportsEn: The browser projection handles only goal/change, maps clear to null, and preserves the same reference for other events, so admitted goal-round messages do not refresh roundsStarted.

items.title: Goal projection fail-soft 与 same-reference 测试
items.supports: 测试固定 non-goal 与 malformed goal-shaped event 的 same-reference 快速路径，避免 projection drive 被异常拆除。
items.titleEn: Goal projection fail-soft and same-reference tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin the same-reference fast path for non-goal and malformed goal-shaped events so projection driving remains fail-soft.

items.title: 模型 Goal tool 的执行 authority
items.supports: 要求精确 live/running/current-initiator Agent 与 open Turn；direct-human 必须是 root 的 user source，自动终态只接受匹配当前 Goal round。
items.titleEn: Execution authority for model Goal tools
items.supportsEn: Requires an exact live, running, current-initiator Agent in an open Turn; direct-human authority needs a root user source, while autonomous terminal actions require the matching current Goal round.

items.title: get_goal、create_goal 与 update_goal
items.supports: 定义三种模型工具、direct-human/action 权限、blocked round 下限，以及自动终态通过 deferContext 注入收尾指令。
items.titleEn: get_goal, create_goal, and update_goal
items.supportsEn: Defines the three model tools, direct-human and action authority, the blocked-round threshold, and autonomous terminal wrap-up through deferContext.

items.title: Goal 自动终态收尾测试
items.supports: 测试断言自动 complete 增加一条 closing context 但 concludesTurn 为 undefined；direct-human mutation 不增加该 context。
items.titleEn: Autonomous Goal terminal wrap-up test
items.supportsEn: Tests require autonomous complete to add one closing context while concludesTurn stays undefined; a direct-human mutation adds no such context.

items.title: Same-session Goal round driver
items.supports: 每 Agent 单 attempt/coalesced run、checkpoint barrier、竞争输入、reservation 双重校验、错误 disarm/block/pause 与 teardown quiescence 的完整控制流。
items.titleEn: Same-session Goal round driver
items.supportsEn: Full control flow for one attempt and coalesced run per Agent, checkpoint barriers, competing input, double reservation validation, error disarm/block/pause, and teardown quiescence.

items.title: Goal round cap 与 fail-closed 测试
items.supports: 测试要求只接纳 1..N、cap 后 durable block；driver 热加载需 disarm，provider/error/max-token 和 prompt rejection 都停止自动续跑。
items.titleEn: Goal round-cap and fail-closed tests
items.supportsEn: Tests admit exactly rounds 1 through N and durably block at the cap; hot-load disarms, while provider, error, max-token, and prompt rejection paths stop continuation.

items.title: Goal 逐轮 durability barrier 测试
items.supports: 创建或上一轮 checkpoint 失败会 disarm 且不多发请求；成功时必须在 round 1 与 round 2 之间观察 flush。
items.titleEn: Per-round Goal durability-barrier tests
items.supportsEn: A creation or prior-round checkpoint failure disarms without extra dispatch, while success requires an observed flush between rounds one and two.

items.title: /goal 命令语法与状态操作
items.supports: /goal 提供 show/create/edit/pause/resume/clear，直接调用 GoalService 并返回文本，不提供 complete、block 或每命令 round cap。
items.titleEn: /goal command grammar and state operations
items.supportsEn: /goal provides show, create, edit, pause, resume, and clear by calling GoalService directly and returning text; it exposes no complete, block, or per-command round cap.

items.title: Goal command-input projection
items.supports: Web 从耐久 /goal command/run 构建独立可见的 command-input Chat Node，不创建 model message。
items.titleEn: Goal command-input projection
items.supportsEn: The Web builds a separate visible command-input Chat Node from durable /goal command/run events without creating a model message.

items.title: Goal command-input 气泡 renderer
items.supports: 专用 renderer 将 /goal 输入显示为右对齐 bubble，且不附带普通消息操作。
items.titleEn: Goal command-input bubble renderer
items.supportsEn: The dedicated renderer displays /goal input as a right-aligned bubble without ordinary message actions.

items.title: GoalBar phase action 与 single-flight
items.supports: GoalBar 隐藏 absent/complete，按 phase 提供 pause 或 resume、edit、clear；同步 ref 防重复点击，clear 后先本地隐藏。
items.titleEn: GoalBar phase actions and single-flight
items.supportsEn: GoalBar hides absent and complete goals, offers phase-dependent pause or resume plus edit and clear, fences duplicate clicks synchronously, and locally suppresses a cleared id.

items.title: GoalBar Remote mutation wiring
items.supports: 每个 UI verb 在调用时从当前 goal projection 读取最新 CAS ref，再执行 edit/pause/resume/clear Remote。
items.titleEn: GoalBar Remote mutation wiring
items.supportsEn: Every UI verb reads the latest CAS ref from the current goal projection at call time before invoking edit, pause, resume, or clear Remote.

items.title: Goal Host API mutation contract
items.supports: 公开 façade 只有 create/edit/pause/resume/complete/clear；读侧由 goal projection 提供，mutation 只返回 ref 或 cleared。
items.titleEn: Goal Host API mutation contract
items.supportsEn: The public façade exposes only create, edit, pause, resume, complete, and clear; reads use the goal projection and mutations return only ref or cleared acknowledgements.

items.title: Host API 的 Agent 冷恢复与 subagent fence
items.supports: resolver 复用 live Agent、按 identity 合并冷 resume，并对 live-owned 或持久 subagent identity 返回 agent-busy fence。
items.titleEn: Host API Agent cold resume and subagent fence
items.supportsEn: The resolver reuses live Agents, coalesces cold resume per identity, and applies an agent-busy fence to live-owned or persisted subagent identities.

items.title: Goal service resolution 与 wire error mapping
items.supports: Host 按 Agent preset 解析 Session-specific GoalService；GoalError 统一映射为 wire internal，稳定 domain code 放在 details.goalCode。
items.titleEn: Goal service resolution and wire error mapping
items.supportsEn: The Host resolves the Session-specific GoalService through the Agent preset and maps GoalError to wire internal with the stable domain code under details.goalCode.

items.title: tool-goal README 的旧 concludeTurn 表述
items.supports: README 声称自动 complete/blocked 调用 concludeTurn，与当前 deferContext 源码及测试不一致。
items.titleEn: Stale concludeTurn claim in the tool-goal README
items.supportsEn: The README says autonomous complete and blocked call concludeTurn, contradicting the current deferContext source and tests.

items.title: ui-goal README 的旧 inbox/context 架构
items.supports: README 的 Model Experience 仍称 Remote mutation 写 agent/inbox/spliced 并排队 goal context，同时也记录 projection 不含 activation。
items.titleEn: Stale inbox/context architecture in the ui-goal README
items.supportsEn: The Model Experience section still says Remote mutations write agent/inbox/spliced and queue Goal context, while also documenting that the projection omits activation.

items.title: command-goal README 的旧 status-widget 限制
items.supports: README 仍称没有 continuous status widget，但当前 Web 已有 projection-driven GoalBar。
items.titleEn: Stale status-widget limitation in the command-goal README
items.supportsEn: The README still says there is no continuous status widget, although the current Web ships a projection-driven GoalBar.

items.title: Todo whole-value tool 与 projection
items.supports: todo_write 要求完整清单，规范化 content、校验重复/状态/并行 active 策略，append todo/write；projection last-wins 并在 turn/start 清空。
items.titleEn: Todo whole-value tool and projection
items.supportsEn: todo_write requires the complete list, normalizes content, validates duplicates, statuses, and parallel-active policy, appends todo/write, and registers a last-wins projection cleared at turn/start.

items.title: Todo 写入、替换与验证测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖成功写入与 counts、trim、完整替换、parallel policy、空白/重复/未知字段/enum 拒绝及非 Agent caller。
items.titleEn: Todo write, replacement, and validation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover successful writes and counts, trimming, whole replacement, parallel policy, rejection of blanks, duplicates, unknown fields and enums, and non-Agent callers.

items.title: Base profile 的 Todo 并行策略
items.supports: 发布的 base profile 挂载 tool-todo 并显式设置 allowParallelInProgress: true。
items.titleEn: Shipped base-profile Todo parallel policy
items.supportsEn: The shipped base profile mounts tool-todo with allowParallelInProgress explicitly set to true.

items.title: Todo durable invariant 的覆盖边界
items.supports: companion 校验 array、trimmed unique content 与 status enum，故意不重验 active count；它没有比较 item own keys。
items.titleEn: Coverage boundary of the Todo durable invariant
items.supportsEn: The companion validates the array, trimmed unique content, and status enum, deliberately omits active-count policy, and does not compare item own keys.

items.title: Todo standing projection 测试
items.supports: 测试证明首次写前为 null、最新 whole list 胜出、turn/end 保留、下一 turn/start 清空，并覆盖卸载时 key 消失。
items.titleEn: Todo standing-projection tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove null before first write, latest whole-list wins, turn/end retention, clearing at the next turn/start, and key removal on unload.

items.title: TodoPanel 当前清单视图
items.supports: Web 从 todos projection 渲染可折叠清单、状态计数和全部 item；空清单不显示。
items.titleEn: TodoPanel current-list view
items.supportsEn: The Web renders a collapsible list, status counts, and all items from the todos projection and hides an empty list.

items.title: todo_write 历史 tool row
items.supports: tool row 从原始 call args 构建 done/total、首个 active 与额外 active 数摘要，并为 malformed/rejected args 保留 fallback。
items.titleEn: Historical todo_write tool row
items.supportsEn: The tool row derives done/total, first-active, and extra-active summaries from raw call arguments with fallback for malformed or rejected input.

items.title: Tool 并发分类 fail-closed 规则
items.supports: 只有 isConcurrencySafe 返回严格 true 才是 parallel；缺失、异常、隐藏、未知或无效定义均为 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Fail-closed tool concurrency classification
items.supportsEn: Only an exact true from isConcurrencySafe yields parallel execution; omission, exceptions, hidden, unknown, or invalid definitions are exclusive.

items.title: Exclusive tool ordering barrier
items.supports: Agent loop 按模型顺序分类 tool calls；exclusive 只形成单调用 group 并 await 完成，parallel group 遇 exclusive 重分类需先排空。
items.titleEn: Exclusive tool ordering barrier
items.supportsEn: The Agent loop classifies calls in model order; an exclusive call forms a one-call group that is awaited, while a parallel group must drain before an exclusive reclassification.

items.title: 子进程执行世界与生命周期 seam
items.supports: 定义统一环境清洗，以及 executable、普通进程、PTY、树级终止、输出读取和 service disposal 合同。
items.titleEn: Subprocess execution-world and lifecycle seam
items.supportsEn: Defines the shared environment scrub and the contracts for executables, ordinary processes, PTYs, tree-scoped termination, output reads, and service disposal.

items.title: Standard 一次性 Shell 与 Job 组合
items.supports: Standard 按平台选择 tool-bash 或 tool-pwsh，并将模型 Job controls 置于 Agent preset、registry 留在 Host。
items.titleEn: Standard one-shot shell and Job composition
items.supportsEn: Standard selects tool-bash or tool-pwsh by platform and places model Job controls in the Agent preset while the registry remains on the Host.

items.title: Minimal 隔离持久 Shell 组合
items.supports: Minimal 只组合持久 Bash 与编辑器，使用隔离 Terminal service、Bash backend 和 persistent wrapper，不暴露原始 Terminal tools。
items.titleEn: Minimal isolated persistent-shell composition
items.supportsEn: Minimal composes only persistent Bash and an editor through an isolated Terminal service, Bash backend, and persistent wrapper, without raw Terminal tools.

items.title: 显式子进程启动、输出与句柄合同
items.supports: Spawn spec 明确 argv/cwd/stdio/grace/signal/env；done 仅 spawn failure reject，collected output 用独立 byte offset，terminate 与 wait 以进程树为边界。
items.titleEn: Explicit subprocess spawn, output, and handle contract
items.supportsEn: The spawn spec explicitly carries argv, cwd, stdio, grace, signal, and env; done rejects only on spawn failure, collected output uses independent byte offsets, and terminate/wait are tree-scoped.

items.title: 共享 ambient 环境清洗
items.supports: 子进程基线按名称移除 credential-shaped 与全部 DSH_* 变量，显式 env overlay 在后续 provider 层恢复有意传递的值。
items.titleEn: Shared ambient environment scrub
items.supportsEn: The child baseline removes credential-shaped names and every DSH_* variable; a later explicit provider overlay can restore deliberately forwarded values.

items.title: 逐执行受管 DSH 环境注册表
items.supports: Registry 校验 contributor/key ownership，每次收集 built-ins 与可用贡献值，排序冻结，并从 persistence seam 提供可选 JSONL 位置。
items.titleEn: Per-execution managed DSH environment registry
items.supportsEn: The registry validates contributor and key ownership, collects built-ins plus current contributions per call, sorts and freezes them, and exposes an optional JSONL location through the persistence seam.

items.title: 有界尾部收集与可信 Spill 协议
items.supports: 本地 collector 保留精确 byte tail，使用私有目录和 exclusive 0600 spill；超过完整性上限删除，offset read 显示 lossy，seal 失败停止发布路径。
items.titleEn: Bounded tail collector and trustworthy spill protocol
items.supportsEn: The local collector retains an exact byte tail, uses a private directory and exclusive mode-0600 spill, deletes it beyond the completeness cap, exposes lossy offset reads, and suppresses paths after seal failure.

items.title: 一次性 Shell executor 结果合同
items.supports: run 只有 infrastructure failure reject；非零、timeout、abort 是结果事实；start 无 timeout，输出递增消费，底层 composition teardown 回收后台进程。
items.titleEn: One-shot Shell executor result contract
items.supportsEn: run rejects only for infrastructure failure; nonzero, timeout, and abort are result facts; start has no timeout, output is incrementally consumed, and substrate composition teardown reaps background processes.

items.title: Bash 前后台所有权移交
items.supports: 工具先解析审批、目录与 managed env；后台在 signal precheck 后由 jobs.start 原子 preflight/spawn 并发布 ID，前台则把 tool signal 交给 executor。
items.titleEn: Bash foreground/background ownership handoff
items.supportsEn: The tool first resolves approval, directory, and managed env; background atomically preflights and spawns through jobs.start after a signal check, while foreground passes the tool signal to the executor.

items.title: 后台 Shell outcome 映射
items.supports: 被 signal kill 的进程映射为 killed；其他退出（包括非零）映射为 completed 并携带 exit code；TODO 记录无约束 spawn failure 仍可能别名为 kill。
items.titleEn: Background Shell outcome mapping
items.supportsEn: Signal-killed processes map to killed; every other exit, including nonzero, maps to completed with an exit-code detail; a TODO records that an unconfined spawn failure can still alias a kill.

items.title: 本地 Job 预检、分配与注册
items.supports: Job Registry 在 producer run 前验证 scoped controller、字段、exact live owner 和每 owner 活跃上限；成功后才运行 producer、分配 kind-N 并注册 record。
items.titleEn: Local Job preflight, allocation, and registration
items.supportsEn: Before producer run, the Job Registry validates a scoped controller, fields, exact live owner, and per-owner active cap; only then does it run the producer, mint kind-N, and register the record.

items.title: Scoped Job 访问与 first-wins settlement
items.supports: Owner 访问与 listener/observer 路由按 Session/scope 隔离；settle first-wins，并依次提交 record、释放 waiters、更新 observer、再通知 completion listener。
items.titleEn: Scoped Job access and first-wins settlement
items.supportsEn: Owner access and listener/observer routing are isolated by Session and scope; settlement is first-wins and commits the record, releases waiters, updates observers, then invokes completion listeners.

items.title: Job 输出、列表与取消工具
items.supports: 三个工具提供可选有界 wait、消费式 output、可见列表和 cancellation request；wait timeout 留下 live Job，kill snapshot 不消费输出。
items.titleEn: Job output, list, and cancellation tools
items.supportsEn: The three tools provide optionally bounded waits, consuming output, visible listing, and cancellation requests; wait timeout leaves the Job alive and the kill snapshot does not consume output.

items.title: Job 完成投递与唤醒预算
items.supports: 未报告完成按 owner busy/idle 选择 inject 或 followup；默认 consecutive wake cap 为 3，只有 claim 的 user source 重置 exact-Agent budget。
items.titleEn: Job completion delivery and wake budget
items.supportsEn: Unreported completion chooses inject or followup from owner busy/idle state; the default consecutive wake cap is three, and only a claimed user source resets the exact-Agent budget.

items.title: Exact-owner Job teardown 与取消失败边界
items.supports: Owner/service disposal 请求取消并等待所有 Job settle；cancel 抛错会 force-fail 并报告可能 orphan，返回但不 settle 的 cancel 可能阻塞 teardown。
items.titleEn: Exact-owner Job teardown and cancellation failure boundary
items.supportsEn: Owner/service disposal requests cancellation and awaits every Job; a throwing cancel force-fails and reports possible orphaning, while a cancel that returns without settling may block teardown.

items.title: 只读 Web Job 镜像与重启语义
items.supports: Web 从 Host mirror 渲染只读 live/settled rows；进程重启清空列表而 transcript 保留启动卡，unowned Job 对所有 Session 可见。
items.titleEn: Read-only Web Job mirror and restart semantics
items.supportsEn: The Web renders read-only live and settled rows from a Host mirror; restart empties the list while the transcript retains start cards, and unowned Jobs are visible to every Session.

items.title: Exact-Agent PTY 发布、所有权与关闭
items.supports: Terminal service 预留 name/spawn，backend 成功后复查 exact live owner 再发布；每 Session 一个 active send，所有操作做 owner fence，close 静止后才删除且失败可重试。
items.titleEn: Exact-Agent PTY publication, ownership, and close
items.supportsEn: The Terminal service reserves name/spawn, rechecks the exact live owner before publication, allows one active send per session, fences every operation by owner, and deletes only after quiescent, retryable close.

items.title: PTY readiness 推断、中断与关闭静止
items.supports: Readiness 组合 session exit、受控 prompt+foreground group、exact stdin wait 与 silence inference；取消发真实 SIGINT，close 等 terminate 与 completion。
items.titleEn: PTY readiness inference, interrupt, and close quiescence
items.supportsEn: Readiness combines session exit, a controlled prompt plus foreground group, exact stdin wait, and silence inference; cancellation sends real SIGINT and close awaits termination plus completion.

items.title: 六个 owner-scoped Terminal 工具与后台发送
items.supports: 定义 open/send/read/signal/close/list；每次要求 Agent，background send 通过 pty-send Job 接管 exclusive operation、取消与 bounded output。
items.titleEn: Six owner-scoped Terminal tools and background send
items.supportsEn: Defines open, send, read, signal, close, and list; every call requires an Agent, and background send hands an exclusive operation, cancellation, and bounded output to a pty-send Job.

items.title: Persistent Bash marker 协议与逐 owner 串行化
items.supports: Wrapper 用随机 markers、scrollback 和每 owner promise queue 定界命令；timeout/abort/send failure/shell exit reset PTY，非零 exit 作为 marker 结果。
items.titleEn: Persistent Bash marker protocol and per-owner serialization
items.supportsEn: The wrapper uses random markers, scrollback, and a per-owner promise queue to delimit commands; timeout, abort, send failure, or shell exit resets the PTY, while nonzero exit is a marker result.

items.title: 本地进程树信号与平台静止边界
items.supports: POSIX 使用 detached process group 做 TERM→KILL 并持续探测 group liveness；Windows 通过 taskkill /T /F 请求树级终止，但 waitForExit 只以 direct-child exit 为可观察代理。
items.titleEn: Local process-tree signalling and quiescence
items.supportsEn: POSIX uses a detached process group for TERM-to-KILL and continues probing group liveness; Windows requests tree termination through taskkill /T /F, while waitForExit uses direct-child exit as its observable proxy.

items.title: 身份围栏保护的 PTY 信号与清理
items.supports: PTY 拒绝对顶层 shell 直接 SIGKILL，用 PID+start identity 捕获后代，并以 descendants-shell-descendants 的 TERM/KILL 顺序验证静止，survivor 使 cleanup 失败。
items.titleEn: Identity-fenced PTY signalling and cleanup
items.supportsEn: The PTY rejects direct SIGKILL to the top-level shell, tracks descendants by PID plus start identity, and verifies quiescence through descendants-shell-descendants TERM/KILL cleanup, failing if survivors remain.

items.title: 远端 E2B 子进程与 Terminal provider
items.supports: E2B 作为 SubprocessRuntime provider 实现远端 executable lookup、普通 process handle、Terminal allocation、publication fence 与 disposal cleanup，上层 consumer 不需要专用工具包。
items.titleEn: Remote E2B subprocess and Terminal provider
items.supportsEn: E2B implements SubprocessRuntime with remote executable lookup, ordinary process handles, Terminal allocation, publication fences, and disposal cleanup, without requiring consumer-specific tools.

items.title: 受管环境列表遗漏内建变量
items.supports: 源码 TODO 明确 list() 只枚举 contributor declarations，不包含 registry-owned built-ins，不能被诊断/UI 当作完整环境目录。
items.titleEn: Managed-environment list built-in omission
items.supportsEn: A source TODO states that list() enumerates contributor declarations but omits registry-owned built-ins, so diagnostics/UI cannot treat it as an exhaustive environment catalog.

items.title: PowerShell README 中过时的 inject 名称
items.supports: README 声明 tool-pwsh 的 inject 是 tools/bash/systemPrompt/bashEnv。
items.titleEn: Stale PowerShell inject names in README
items.supportsEn: The README declares the tool-pwsh inject list as tools/bash/systemPrompt/bashEnv.

items.title: 当前 PowerShell inject 声明
items.supports: 当前生产源码实际声明 tools/shell/systemPrompt/shellEnv，直接证明 README 列表漂移。
items.titleEn: Current PowerShell inject declaration
items.supportsEn: Current production source declares tools/shell/systemPrompt/shellEnv, directly demonstrating drift in the README list.

items.title: PowerShell 原始 Session cwd 解析
items.supports: PowerShell 默认直接使用 session.header.cwd 并以它解析相对 workdir，没有 Bash 的 policy-root 优先与 canonicalPath 步骤。
items.titleEn: PowerShell raw Session-cwd resolution
items.supportsEn: PowerShell defaults directly to session.header.cwd and resolves relative workdir against it, without Bash's policy-root preference and canonicalPath step.

items.title: Bash canonical policy-root workdir 解析
items.supports: Bash 优先使用 sandbox policy workspace root，否则 canonicalize Session cwd，并以该 identity 解析相对 workdir。
items.titleEn: Bash canonical policy-root workdir resolution
items.supportsEn: Bash prefers the sandbox-policy workspace root, otherwise canonicalizes the Session cwd, and resolves a relative workdir against that identity.

items.title: Assistant message 提交后的工具调度入口
items.supports: Loop 先追加完整 assistant/message，再抽取其中全部 tool-call blocks 并调用 executeToolCalls；没有调用时直接完成该 Step。
items.titleEn: Tool scheduling entry after assistant-message commit
