items.supportsEn: The loop appends the complete assistant/message before extracting every tool-call block and invoking executeToolCalls; a step completes directly when no calls exist.

items.title: 按实时分类逐组推进
items.supports: 调度器按模型顺序读取下一调用的实时 execution mode：parallel 取得剩余 suffix，exclusive 只形成 singleton；每组完成后才推进 consumed 游标。
items.titleEn: Group progression from live classification
items.supportsEn: In model order, the scheduler reads the next call's live execution mode: parallel takes the remaining suffix, exclusive forms a singleton, and the consumed cursor advances only after the group finishes.

items.title: 有界 rolling pool 与有序提交游标
items.supports: runGroup 只并发 dispatch，按 maxParallelToolCalls 补位；settled slot 只能由连续 committed 游标按模型顺序 finalize、追加结果与接受 context。
items.titleEn: Bounded rolling pool and ordered commit cursor
items.supportsEn: runGroup overlaps dispatch only and replenishes up to maxParallelToolCalls; settled slots are finalized, appended, and have context accepted only through a contiguous model-order commit cursor.

items.title: 并发安全是不可见于模型的严格 opt-in 元数据
items.supports: ToolDefinition 的 isConcurrencySafe 是纯同步分类器；仅 true opt in，且该 metadata 不发送给模型。声明者负责不修改 parent-owned state 并使共享状态竞态可交换或 fail closed。
items.titleEn: Concurrency safety is strict opt-in host metadata
items.supportsEn: ToolDefinition.isConcurrencySafe is a pure synchronous classifier; only true opts in and the metadata is not sent to the model. Authors must avoid parent-owned mutation and make shared-state races commute or fail closed.

items.title: 实时 definition 上的 fail-closed 分类
items.supports: executionMode 从调用者可见的当前 tool definition 分类；缺失、未知、隐藏、抛错或非严格 true 都返回 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Fail-closed classification on the live definition
items.supportsEn: executionMode classifies through the currently visible tool definition; missing, unknown, hidden, throwing, or non-exact-true classifiers all return exclusive.

items.title: defineTool 的参数验证分类包装
items.supports: defineTool 先用同一参数 schema 验证调用；只有合法参数才进入 typed isConcurrencySafe，非法参数直接分类为 false。
items.titleEn: Argument-validating classifier wrapper in defineTool
items.supportsEn: defineTool validates with the same parameter schema before invoking the typed isConcurrencySafe callback; invalid arguments classify as false.

items.title: Unary classifier 的保守安全约定
items.supports: 设计只允许分类器查看当前调用参数；scheduler 不比较 sibling 或证明资源兼容性，依赖关系型安全条件的调用必须保持 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Conservative safety contract of the unary classifier
items.supportsEn: The classifier sees only the current call's arguments; the scheduler neither compares siblings nor proves resource compatibility, so calls whose safety is relational must remain exclusive.

items.title: 并行 group、exclusive barrier 与实时替换测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖并行 siblings、parallel-exclusive-parallel 三组、barrier 后 definition 替换，以及 result observer 将待启动调用重分类为 exclusive。
items.titleEn: Parallel groups, exclusive barriers, and live replacement tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover parallel siblings, parallel-exclusive-parallel grouping, definition replacement after a barrier, and a result observer reclassifying an unstarted call as exclusive.

items.title: Native rolling-pool cap 测试
items.supports: 测试验证非法 cap 拒绝、默认值、cap=2 动态补位、cap=1 全串行，以及 factory-created Agents 共用配置上限。
items.titleEn: Native rolling-pool cap tests
items.supportsEn: Tests verify invalid-cap rejection, the default, rolling replenishment at cap two, full serialization at cap one, and the shared configured limit for factory-created agents.

items.title: Scheduler-only staged ToolRuntime view
items.supports: 私有 symbol-keyed scheduler view 将完整工具管线拆为 prepare、dispatch、finalize 与 finish，使 policy 保持有序而仅重叠 body；普通调用仍使用 execute。
items.titleEn: Scheduler-only staged ToolRuntime view
items.supportsEn: A private symbol-keyed scheduler view splits the full pipeline into prepare, dispatch, finalize, and finish so policy stays ordered while only bodies overlap; ordinary callers still use execute.

items.title: 有序 prepare、approval 与 guards
items.supports: prepare 创建 execution，处理 pre-dispatch cancel，依次等待 pre-execute、approval 与 monotonic guards，再返回 dispatch、post-result 或 final-result。
items.titleEn: Ordered prepare, approval, and guards
items.supportsEn: Prepare creates the execution, handles pre-dispatch cancellation, awaits pre-execute, approval, and monotonic guards, then returns dispatch, post-result, or final-result.

items.title: 可并发的 around-dispatch 与 tool body
items.supports: dispatch 融合 caller/wrapper signals，等待已启动 body 静止，通过 tools/execute wrapper 调用 body，并把 deferred contexts 合入规范化结果。
items.titleEn: Concurrent around-dispatch and tool body stage
items.supportsEn: Dispatch fuses caller and wrapper signals, awaits any started body to quiescence, invokes it through tools/execute wrappers, and merges deferred contexts into the normalized result.

items.title: 有序 post、finalization 与 result notification
items.supports: finalize 等待 post-execute，再执行 definition-owned content finalization、物化最终快照并同步分派 tools/result；observer 返回的 Promise 只被观察错误而不被等待。
items.titleEn: Ordered post, finalization, and result notification
items.supportsEn: Finalize awaits post-execute, applies definition-owned content finalization, materializes the final snapshot, and synchronously dispatches tools/result; promises returned by observers are error-observed but not awaited.

items.title: Tool call/result 的 durable seq 配对
items.supports: 每个 started call 在 prepare 前先追加原始 argument string 的 tool/call 并保存 seq；tool/result 通过 sourceEventSeqs 精确引用该 call。
items.titleEn: Durable sequence pairing for tool calls and results
items.supportsEn: Each started call appends tool/call with the original argument string before prepare and retains its sequence; tool/result cites that exact call through sourceEventSeqs.

items.title: 乱序 settle 下的模型顺序结果测试
items.supports: 测试先释放第二个并行调用，确认第一个完成前没有任何 result；最终 durable results 与 deriveMessages 仍按 C1、C2 排列。
items.titleEn: Model-order result tests under out-of-order settlement
items.supportsEn: Tests release the second parallel call first and confirm no result appears before the first completes; durable results and deriveMessages still end in C1, C2 order.

items.title: Queued call 的实时重分类测试
items.supports: 测试证明 exclusive barrier 内的 registry replacement 和同步 result observer replacement 都会影响未启动调用；当前 pool 先排空，再运行新的 exclusive definition。
items.titleEn: Live reclassification tests for queued calls
items.supportsEn: Tests show that registry replacement inside an exclusive barrier and synchronous result-observer replacement both affect unstarted calls; the current pool drains before the new exclusive definition runs.

items.title: 非 await 的 tools/result observer
items.supports: 结果 observer 在 final snapshot 后同步被调用；其返回 Promise 仅附加 rejection logger，不成为 scheduler 可等待的 barrier。
items.titleEn: Non-awaited tools/result observers
items.supportsEn: Result observers are invoked synchronously after the final snapshot; returned promises receive only a rejection logger and do not become scheduler-awaited barriers.

items.title: 取消后的 stop-replenish 与 started-call drain
items.supports: pool 在补位与有序 commit 间反复检查 abort；取消后停止启动新调用、等待 in-flight settlement、提交已启动 calls，并为 group 内未启动 calls 追加合成结果。
items.titleEn: Stop-replenish and started-call drain after abort
items.supportsEn: The pool rechecks abort between replenishment and ordered commits; after cancellation it starts no new calls, drains in-flight work, commits started calls, and appends synthetic results for unstarted calls in the group.

items.title: 未启动调用的合成 call/result 对
items.supports: 取消跳过的模型调用仍追加 tool/call 与带 ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH 结构化错误的 tool/result，保持 replay 配对闭合。
items.titleEn: Synthetic call/result pair for unstarted calls
items.supportsEn: A model call skipped by cancellation still receives tool/call plus a tool/result carrying structured ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH, keeping replay pairing closed.

items.title: Native scheduler 取消语义测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 group 前取消、prepare 中取消、运行中停止补位并合成未启动结果，以及取消后不跨入后续 exclusive barrier。
items.titleEn: Native scheduler cancellation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover cancellation before a group, during prepare, while stopping replenishment and synthesizing unstarted results, and prevention of crossing into a later exclusive barrier.

items.title: 取消后保留有序 additional contexts 的测试
items.supports: 测试证明已启动调用的 contexts 按 C1、C2 停驻 next-step inbox，取消结束时不写 user/message，并在下一次 wake 后按序进入日志。
items.titleEn: Test for retaining ordered additional contexts after cancellation
items.supportsEn: The test shows contexts from started calls remain in the next-step inbox as C1, C2, are not logged as user/message when cancellation ends the turn, and enter the log in order on the next wake.

items.title: 批次完成后的 Agent Step 决策
items.supports: Agent 等待整个 executeToolCalls 批次后才依据聚合的 concluded 决定 Step completed；否则继续下一 Step。
items.titleEn: Agent-step decision after the complete call batch
items.supportsEn: The agent awaits the entire executeToolCalls batch before using the aggregated concluded flag to complete the step; otherwise it advances to another step.

items.title: 内部 scheduler failure 的 quiescence 边界
items.supports: 内部失败停止新 dispatch，Promise.allSettled 等待所有已启动 dispatch 后抛出首个 scheduler error；该路径不伪造无法归因的 tool results。
items.titleEn: Quiescence boundary for internal scheduler failures
items.supportsEn: An internal failure stops new dispatch, Promise.allSettled drains every started dispatch, and the first scheduler error is rethrown; this path does not fabricate unattributable tool results.

items.title: Scheduler invariant failure drain 测试
items.supports: 测试注入 scheduler 内部 rejection，确认不再启动第三个 body、Turn 不会提前结束、已启动 sibling 被排空，最终以首个 error 关闭。
items.titleEn: Scheduler-invariant failure drain test
items.supportsEn: The test injects an internal scheduler rejection and confirms no third body starts, the turn does not end early, the started sibling drains, and the first error closes the turn.

items.title: Native parallel cap 的动态配置边界
items.supports: AgentLoop 在配置 schema 中以共享默认值 10 解析 maxParallelToolCalls，并通过 Settings getter 让已提交变更从下一 group 生效。
items.titleEn: Dynamic configuration boundary for the native parallel cap
items.supportsEn: AgentLoop resolves maxParallelToolCalls with the shared default of 10 and reads committed Settings changes through a getter beginning with the next group.

items.title: Code Mode 的独立 per-run scheduler
items.supports: 每个 run_code 创建自己的 abort controller、pending/commit queues、in-flight set 与单一 driver lane；只有 dispatch/body 并行，exclusive barrier 持续到 ordered commit，settle/log work 在 run 结束前 drain。
items.titleEn: Independent per-run scheduler for Code Mode
items.supportsEn: Each run_code creates its own abort controller, pending and commit queues, in-flight set, and single driver lane; only dispatch/body overlaps, an exclusive barrier lasts through ordered commit, and settlement/log work drains before the run ends.

items.title: Code binding 的 staged dispatch 与 durable events
items.supports: 每个 nested binding 生成确定性 subCallId，通过同一 staged ToolRuntime 运行，先追加 code-dispatch-start；有序 commit 后 defer contexts、返回程序值，并异步塑形和追加 code-dispatch。
items.titleEn: Staged dispatch and durable events for Code bindings
items.supportsEn: Each nested binding gets a deterministic subCallId and runs through the same staged ToolRuntime, appending code-dispatch-start first; ordered commit defers contexts, returns the program value, and asynchronously shapes and appends code-dispatch.

items.title: Code Mode 的取消、commit 与 log drain
items.supports: outer run settle 后先 abort；run-scoped drain 放弃 queued-unstarted entries、等待 live pool 和有序 commit lane，并排空 logWork；commit 按 submission order finalize、转发 contexts，再启动非阻塞 settle-log side work。
items.titleEn: Cancellation, commit, and log drain in Code Mode
items.supportsEn: After the outer run settles it aborts; the run-scoped drain abandons queued-unstarted entries, awaits the live pool and ordered commit lane, and empties logWork; commit finalizes in submission order, forwards contexts, then starts non-blocking settle-log side work.

items.title: Code Mode pool、barrier 与 drain 测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖并行 overlap、exclusive barrier、maxParallelSubCalls cap、有序 prepare、barrier-through-post 以及 run settlement 等待进行中的 commit。
items.titleEn: Code Mode pool, barrier, and drain tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover parallel overlap, exclusive barriers, the maxParallelSubCalls cap, ordered prepare, barriers through post-execute, and run settlement waiting for an in-progress commit.

items.title: 名为 out-of-order 的 Code Mode 顺序测试 fixture
items.supports: 测试断言 post 与 contexts 依 submission order，但 gate.release() 明确按 FIFO 释放 A，随后 releaseAll；因此 fixture 实际没有制造 B 先于 A 完成。
items.titleEn: The Code Mode ordering fixture labeled out-of-order
items.supportsEn: The test asserts submission-ordered post and contexts, but gate.release() explicitly releases A FIFO before releaseAll, so the fixture does not actually make B complete before A.

items.title: Agent-loop README 的当前并发语义
items.supports: README 准确说明 exclusive barriers、bounded rolling pool、仅 body overlap、有序 policy/results/context，以及取消和 scheduler failure 的 drain。
items.titleEn: Current concurrency semantics in the agent-loop README
items.supportsEn: The README accurately describes exclusive barriers, the bounded rolling pool, body-only overlap, ordered policy/results/context, and draining on cancellation or scheduler failure.

items.title: Tools README 的 Native 与 Code Mode 并发说明
items.supports: README 描述 Code Mode 独立 per-run pool、默认 cap 10、exclusive barrier、有序 contexts 与 settlement drain，并与 Native scheduler 的相同分类原则区分。
items.titleEn: Native and Code Mode concurrency in the tools README
items.supportsEn: The README describes Code Mode's independent per-run pool, default cap of ten, exclusive barriers, ordered contexts, and settlement drain while distinguishing it from the native scheduler under the same classification principle.

items.title: Implemented note 中已过时的取消与 Code Mode 描述
items.supports: 旧 note 仍称未启动调用没有 audit event、Code Mode queue 保持串行；当前源码已经使用 synthetic call/result 与 parallel per-run scheduler。
items.titleEn: Stale cancellation and Code Mode claims in the implemented note
items.supportsEn: The older note still says unstarted calls have no audit event and the Code Mode queue remains serial; current source instead uses synthetic call/result pairs and a parallel per-run scheduler.

items.title: 进程文件副作用约束的沙箱合同
items.supports: 源码把三种 mode 定义为文件副作用策略，并要求 provider 按调用接收完整 policy、返回精确包装 argv、enforcement 与诊断规则；不可用时必须 fail closed。
items.titleEn: Sandbox contract for process file-effect confinement
items.supportsEn: The source defines the three modes as file-effect policy and requires the provider to accept a complete per-call policy, return exact wrapped argv plus enforcement and diagnostic rules, and fail closed when unavailable.

items.title: 沙箱官方边界与带内诊断限制
items.supports: README 明确把策略范围限制为文件副作用，排除网络、进程、系统调用、设备与凭据，并记录 stderr denial/runner attribution 的带内限制。
items.titleEn: Official sandbox boundary and in-band diagnostic limits
items.supportsEn: The README explicitly limits the policy to file effects, excludes network, process, syscall, device, and credential restrictions, and records the in-band limits of stderr denial and runner attribution.

items.title: 发布基线的沙箱与审批默认值
items.supports: Base bundle 安装 local sandbox 与共享 policy，缺省把 mode 设为 workspace-write；approval 随之为 ask，并发布 read-only、workspace-write 与 danger-full-access presets。
items.titleEn: Shipped sandbox and approval defaults
items.supportsEn: The base bundle installs the local sandbox and shared policy, defaults the mode to workspace-write, derives ask approval for it, and ships read-only, workspace-write, and danger-full-access presets.

items.title: 共享沙箱策略的逐调用解析
items.supports: SandboxPolicyService 自身默认 read-only；每次 resolve 都按显式 mode、Session 最后 override、部署默认的顺序选 mode，并优先以 Session cwd 作为 workspace root。
items.titleEn: Per-call resolution of shared sandbox policy
items.supportsEn: SandboxPolicyService itself defaults to read-only; each resolve selects explicit mode, then the session's last override, then deployment default, and prefers session cwd as the workspace root.

items.title: 可写根的规范化与推导
items.supports: canonicalPath 尽力使用 native realpath；writableRoots 在 read-only 下为空，在 workspace-write 下规范化、去重 workspace root、/tmp 与 os.tmpdir()。
items.titleEn: Canonicalization and derivation of writable roots
items.supportsEn: canonicalPath best-effort uses native realpath; writableRoots is empty for read-only and canonicalizes and deduplicates the workspace root, /tmp, and os.tmpdir() for workspace-write.

items.title: Session 沙箱模式事件与 fold
items.supports: sandbox/mode 是 log-only Session event；effectiveSandboxMode 反向寻找最后一次写入，setSandboxMode 的唯一动作是追加该事件。
items.titleEn: Session sandbox-mode event and fold
items.supportsEn: sandbox/mode is a log-only session event; effectiveSandboxMode scans backward for the latest value, and setSandboxMode only appends that event.

items.title: 严格单调且执行前完成的升级审批
items.supports: 升级表只允许严格更宽的目标；参数必须成对且理由非空，审批在执行前携带取消 signal，只有 allowed-once 返回本次调用的更宽 mode。
items.titleEn: Strictly monotonic pre-execution escalation approval
items.supportsEn: The escalation table permits only strictly wider targets; arguments must be paired with a nonblank reason, approval carries cancellation before execution, and only allowed-once returns a wider mode for this call.

items.title: 本地平台 runner 链与诊断方言
items.supports: 源码定义 Linux bwrap→Landlock、macOS Seatbelt、Windows ACL 链，分别标注 full/partial enforcement、denial signatures 与 runner-failure rules。
items.titleEn: Local platform runner chains and diagnostic dialects
items.supportsEn: The source defines Linux bwrap-to-Landlock, macOS Seatbelt, and Windows ACL chains with their full or partial enforcement, denial signatures, and runner-failure rules.

items.title: Bwrap、Landlock 与 Seatbelt profile
items.supports: Bwrap 把根只读 bind 并在 workspace mode 使用独立 /tmp；Landlock grant host /tmp 与 workspace；Seatbelt 默认 allow、拒绝文件写后再放行共享 writable roots。
items.titleEn: Bwrap, Landlock, and Seatbelt profiles
items.supportsEn: Bwrap read-only binds the root and gives workspace mode an isolated /tmp; Landlock grants host /tmp and workspace; Seatbelt allows by default, denies file writes, then permits the shared writable roots.

items.title: Runner 选择、缓存与关闭失败
items.supports: provider 生命周期内缓存一次 chain verdict；单候选不 probe，多候选按序 probe，空链或全部 unusable 返回结构化 unavailable，而不是原 argv。
items.titleEn: Runner selection, caching, and fail-closed behavior
items.supportsEn: The provider caches one chain verdict for its lifetime; a sole candidate is unprobed, multiple candidates are probed in order, and an empty or wholly unusable chain becomes structured unavailable rather than original argv.

items.title: 自定义 runner 的验证与包装
items.supports: 构造器验证 runnerCommand 与 failure signatures 必须成对；配置的 runner 跳过平台选择，用 bwrap-shaped profile 包装并由 operator 声明 full enforcement。
items.titleEn: Custom-runner validation and wrapping
items.supportsEn: Construction requires runnerCommand and failure signatures together; a configured runner bypasses platform selection, wraps with a bwrap-shaped profile, and is treated as the operator's assertion of full enforcement.

items.title: 一次性 Bash 的沙箱消费路径
items.supports: Executor 将 exact ['bash','-c',command] 交给 provider，并直接运行返回 argv；foreground/background 分别保留 mode、enforcement、denial 与 runner-failure 结果。
items.titleEn: Sandbox consumption path for one-shot Bash
items.supportsEn: The executor gives the provider exact ['bash','-c',command] and runs the returned argv directly; foreground and background paths retain mode, enforcement, denial, and runner-failure outcomes.

items.title: 沙箱拒绝与 runner failure 分类器
items.supports: spawn attribution 要求可用 workdir 与精确 runner path/syscall；settled runner failure 按 exit gate、信息行排除和 fatal stderr 匹配，denial 仅在非零退出时按签名匹配。
items.titleEn: Sandbox denial and runner-failure classifiers
items.supportsEn: Spawn attribution requires a usable workdir and exact runner path or syscall; settled runner failure uses exit gates, informational-line exclusions, and fatal stderr matches, while denial matches signatures only on nonzero exit.

items.title: Windows ACL 的 partial 能力与清理边界
items.supports: 官方边界记录 Everyone 与 hard-link 旁路、standing workspace ACE、可撤销的 per-Session temp capability，以及崩溃或 cleanup failure 后的惰性残留。
items.titleEn: Partial Windows ACL capability and cleanup boundary
items.supportsEn: The official boundary records Everyone and hard-link bypasses, standing workspace ACEs, revocable per-session temp capabilities, and inert residue after crashes or cleanup failures.

items.title: Filesystem 的身份、观察、guard 与错误类型
items.supports: 类型定义把 target/version 设为 opaque identity，区分 present/absent observation，定义 guarded create/replace intent，并列出含 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED 的结构化 FsErrorCode。
items.titleEn: Filesystem identity, observation, guard, and error types
items.supportsEn: The types make target and version opaque identities, distinguish present and absent observations, define guarded create and replace intents, and list structured FsErrorCode including FS_SANDBOX_DENIED.

items.title: Filesystem provider 与事件 seam
items.supports: FileSystem 声明路径、读取、列表与原子 mutation API；fs write/edit intent 是 single-slot waterfall，observed 是同步 emit，sandboxMode 可选暴露 mutation confinement。
items.titleEn: Filesystem provider and event seam
items.supportsEn: FileSystem declares path, read, list, and atomic-mutation APIs; fs write and edit intents are single-slot waterfalls, observed is synchronous emission, and sandboxMode optionally exposes mutation confinement.

items.title: 本地 Filesystem 的 cwd 与 canonical target
items.supports: LocalFileSystem 明确说明 cwd 只是相对路径默认而非 containment，provider 以 canonical targetKey 做锁与 I/O 身份，并用平台路径语义实现 contains。
items.titleEn: Local filesystem cwd and canonical target
items.supportsEn: LocalFileSystem states that cwd is only a relative-path default, not containment; it uses canonical targetKey for lock and I/O identity and platform path semantics for contains.

items.title: 存在与缺失目标的 realpath 身份
items.supports: 存在目标使用自身 realpath；缺失目标向上寻找最近存在祖先、规范化后拼回缺失 suffix，使 symlink alias 在创建前后保持目标身份。
items.titleEn: Realpath identity for present and missing targets
items.supportsEn: Present targets use their own realpath; missing targets walk to the nearest existing ancestor, canonicalize it, and append the missing suffix so symlink aliases preserve identity across creation.

items.title: 本地文本、字节与流式读取语义
items.supports: whole text 读取完整文件并做 UTF-8/NUL 检查；raw-byte path 强制 maxBytes；stream path 跨 chunk 解码并仅在前 8192 bytes 做 NUL sample，且传播取消。
items.titleEn: Local text, byte, and streaming read semantics
items.supportsEn: Whole-text reads the complete file with UTF-8 and NUL checks; raw-byte reads enforce maxBytes; streaming decodes across chunks, samples only the first 8192 bytes for NUL, and propagates cancellation.

items.title: 本地逐目标 mutation 锁与 guard
items.supports: 同一 provider 以 targetKey FIFO 锁串行 mutation；write/edit 在锁内 probe、验证 create/replace/version guard，再调用 atomic writer 并返回新版本。
items.titleEn: Local per-target mutation lock and guards
items.supportsEn: One provider serializes mutations by targetKey with a FIFO lock; write and edit probe and validate create, replace, or version guards under that lock before atomic writing and returning a new version.

items.title: 本地原子 staging 与 publication
items.supports: 写入使用 0700 sibling staging directory、0600 exclusive file 与 sync；commit 前检查取消，然后以 hard-link no-replace、Windows ReplaceFile 或 rename 发布，commit 后清理为 best effort。
items.titleEn: Local atomic staging and publication
items.supportsEn: Writes use a 0700 sibling staging directory, a 0600 exclusive file, and sync; cancellation is checked before commit, then publication uses hard-link no-replace, Windows ReplaceFile, or rename, with post-commit cleanup best effort.

items.title: 本地 Filesystem 的并发与清理限制
items.supports: README 明确 mutation lock 仅限进程内、guarded create 才有跨进程 no-replace，replacement 仍可竞态，且 commit 后 staging 清理失败会留下 residue。
items.titleEn: Local filesystem concurrency and cleanup limits
items.supportsEn: The README states that mutation locks are process-local, only guarded create has cross-process no-replace, replacement can still race, and failed post-commit staging cleanup leaves residue.

items.title: 仅约束 mutation 的进程内 Filesystem 围栏
items.supports: SandboxedFileSystem 原样继承读取，只在 write/edit 前按每调用 policy 检查；read-only 拒绝、workspace-write fresh resolve 后校验 writable roots、full 直接通过，并明确接受剩余 TOCTOU。
items.titleEn: In-process filesystem fence for mutations only
items.supportsEn: SandboxedFileSystem inherits reads unchanged and checks only write and edit against per-call policy; read-only denies, workspace-write fresh-resolves and checks writable roots, full passes through, and residual TOCTOU is explicitly accepted.

items.title: Separator-aware containment 与文件身份 fallback
items.supports: containment 先做 separator-aware lexical comparison；拼写不同时沿现存祖先比较 dev/inode，保守处理缺失 root，并支持 Windows case/alias 语义。
items.titleEn: Separator-aware containment with filesystem-identity fallback
items.supportsEn: Containment first performs separator-aware lexical comparison; when spellings differ it walks existing ancestors comparing device and inode, treats missing roots conservatively, and supports Windows case and alias semantics.

items.title: Filesystem 围栏 mode 与逃逸测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 read-only mutation denial/read allowance、workspace 与 temp writes、absolute/.. 与 symlink escapes、fresh target、full mode、逐调用 override 和结构化 denial。
items.titleEn: Filesystem-fence mode and escape tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover read-only mutation denial and reads, workspace and temp writes, absolute, parent, and symlink escapes, fresh targets, full mode, per-call overrides, and structured denial.

items.title: Filesystem 工具的 Session cwd 解析
items.supports: 工具从调用 Agent 的 Session header 取 cwd；遇到 parent traversal 时重新 canonicalize，并让 sandbox policy root 在 mutation resolve 时优先。
items.titleEn: Session-cwd resolution for filesystem tools
items.supportsEn: Tools take cwd from the calling agent's session header, recanonicalize when parent traversal is involved, and let the sandbox policy root take precedence for mutation resolution.

items.title: Read 工具的 bounded window 与 present observation
items.supports: read 做一次 stat 取得类型、size 与 version，按 size 选择 whole/stream，构造 bounded window，并仅在成功后 emit present observation。
items.titleEn: Bounded window and present observation in the read tool
items.supportsEn: Read performs one stat for type, size, and version, selects whole or streaming I/O by size, builds a bounded window, and emits a present observation only after success.

items.title: Read 目标解析与 absent observation
items.supports: 共享 helper 从 Session cwd resolve、stat 目标；确认缺失时先 emit absent observation 再抛 FS_NOT_FOUND，并拒绝非普通文件。
items.titleEn: Read-target resolution and absent observation
items.supportsEn: The shared helper resolves from session cwd and stats the target; confirmed absence emits an absent observation before FS_NOT_FOUND, and non-regular files are rejected.

items.title: Write 工具的 policy、intent 与 observation 控制流
items.supports: write 在 I/O 前解析 policy 与目标，取得 single-slot intent，调用 provider mutation，映射 denial/error，并在成功后记录返回 version 的 present observation。
items.titleEn: Write-tool policy, intent, and observation flow
items.supportsEn: Write resolves policy and target before I/O, obtains the single-slot intent, invokes provider mutation, maps denials and errors, and records a present observation with the returned version after success.

items.title: Edit 工具的 policy、guard 与 observation 控制流
items.supports: edit 在 I/O 前解析 policy 与目标，在 try 内取得 version intent 并调用 provider atomic edit；失败统一映射，成功后刷新 present observation。
items.titleEn: Edit-tool policy, guard, and observation flow
items.supportsEn: Edit resolves policy and target before I/O, obtains its version intent inside the try and calls provider atomic edit; failures are mapped consistently and success refreshes the present observation.

items.title: Filesystem mutation 的条件升级接口
items.supports: Controller 仅在 ctx.fs 暴露 sandboxMode 时发布升级字段并要求 shared policy；每次 mutation 解析 standing/approved policy，并把 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED 映射为共享 marker 与 hint。
items.titleEn: Conditional escalation interface for filesystem mutations
items.supportsEn: The controller advertises escalation fields only when ctx.fs exposes sandboxMode and then requires shared policy; each mutation resolves standing or approved policy and maps FS_SANDBOX_DENIED to the shared marker and hint.

items.title: 按 Session owner 隔离的 observation 状态机
items.supports: plugin 用 WeakMap<owner,Map<target,observation>> 保存易失状态；unseen/absent/present 决定 create 或 version guard，dispose 重置状态，三个 listener 占据 intent slots 并同步记录 observed。
items.titleEn: Observation state machine isolated by session owner
items.supportsEn: The plugin stores ephemeral state in WeakMap<owner, Map<target, observation>>; unseen, absent, and present determine create or version guards, disposal resets state, and three listeners occupy intent slots and synchronously record observations.

items.title: Observation gate 的 first-wins 与可卸载语义
items.supports: README 定义三种 fs event 决策，说明 intent slot 按注册顺序 first-wins；移除 plugin 后工具会回落到 bare provider 的 unconditional write/edit。
items.titleEn: First-wins and removable semantics of the observation gate
items.supportsEn: The README defines the three fs event decisions, states that intent slots are first-wins by registration order, and says removing the plugin falls back to unconditional write and edit on the bare provider.

items.title: Observation 决策、owner 隔离与 disposal 测试
items.supports: 测试固定 unseen/absent/present write/edit 结果、成功 mutation 后版本刷新、无 owner、多个 owner、first-wins，以及 dispose 后状态与 listeners 清空。
items.titleEn: Observation decision, owner-isolation, and disposal tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin unseen, absent, and present write and edit outcomes, version refresh after successful mutation, no-owner behavior, multiple owners, first-wins, and state and listener removal on disposal.

items.title: Observation policy 的已知保证边界
items.supports: 官方限制说明状态不随 resume 持久化、无 Session actor 无法满足 policy、直接 ctx.fs read 不记录，以及 window read 只授权同版本而不证明完整阅读。
items.titleEn: Known guarantee boundaries of observation policy
items.supportsEn: Official limits state that state does not persist across resume, actors without sessions cannot satisfy policy, direct ctx.fs reads do not record, and a windowed read authorizes by version without proving complete viewing.

items.title: Permission preset 的默认 bundle 与启动校验
items.supports: service 默认提供 workspace-write+ask 与 danger-full-access+never，要求 shell 和 approval，并只用 ctx.shell.sandboxMode 验证存在 confining shell；新 Session 会被 pin 初始权限。
items.titleEn: Permission-preset defaults and startup validation
items.supportsEn: The service defaults to workspace-write plus ask and danger-full-access plus never, requires shell and approval, validates confinement only through ctx.shell.sandboxMode, and pins initial permission for new sessions.

items.title: Permission preset 的三事件写入路径
items.supports: 切换时先按需追加 permission/preset，再通过 canonical setters 更新 sandbox/mode 与 approval/policy；新 Session 也补齐缺失的三个 durable facts。
items.titleEn: Three-event write path for permission presets
items.supportsEn: A switch conditionally appends permission/preset, then updates sandbox/mode and approval/policy through canonical setters; new sessions also receive any missing durable facts.

items.title: 发布基线的 Filesystem policy 与工具层
items.supports: Base bundle 同时装配 tool-fs、tool-fs-search 与 fs-observation-policy，使模型 mutation 在默认组合中经过 observation gate。
items.titleEn: Shipped filesystem policy and tool layers
items.supportsEn: The base bundle composes tool-fs, tool-fs-search, and fs-observation-policy together, so model mutations pass through the observation gate in the default composition.

items.title: 发布基线的沙箱化 Filesystem provider
items.supports: Base bundle 的 provider 行明确安装 @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox，而不是 bare local filesystem。
items.titleEn: Shipped sandboxed filesystem provider
items.supportsEn: The base bundle's provider row explicitly installs @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox rather than the bare local filesystem.

items.title: Persistent Terminal 的 mode fence 与 confined spawn
items.supports: owner-scoped listener 在 PTY open/creation 期间拒绝不同 sandbox/mode；spawn 按 Session 解析 policy、包装 argv、使用 policy root，并在 initialize failure 时 await close cleanup。
items.titleEn: Persistent-terminal mode fence and confined spawn
items.supportsEn: An owner-scoped listener rejects a different sandbox/mode while PTYs are open or being created; spawn resolves session policy, wraps argv, uses its root, and awaits close cleanup on initialization failure.

items.title: 单 Context 的 E2B execution-world owner
items.supports: E2BRuntime 创建并共享一个 sandbox handle，校验 API key、absolute Linux cwd 与 timeout，准备 0700 runtime root，用随机 HOME 隔离 SDK login shell，并在 bootstrap failure/dispose 时 kill。
items.titleEn: E2B execution-world owner for one context
items.supportsEn: E2BRuntime creates and shares one sandbox handle, validates API key, absolute Linux cwd, and timeout, prepares a 0700 runtime root, isolates the SDK login shell with randomized HOME, and kills on bootstrap failure or disposal.

items.title: E2B Filesystem 的远端 identity、读取与 mutation
items.supports: E2B provider 以 POSIX cwd 与远端 GNU realpath 建立 target identity，提供 whole/stream/bounded byte reads，并以 canonical target 的 host-process lock 包裹 guarded write/edit。
items.titleEn: Remote identity, reads, and mutations in E2B filesystem
items.supportsEn: The E2B provider builds target identity from POSIX cwd and remote GNU realpath, supplies whole, streaming, and bounded-byte reads, and wraps guarded write and edit with a host-process lock keyed by canonical target.

items.title: E2B 原子 publication 与取消 commit point
items.supports: 远端写入创建随机 0700 sibling staging、上传带 version metadata 的文件并保留 mode；commit 用无 signal 的 ln -T 或 rename，之后 best-effort 清理。
items.titleEn: E2B atomic publication and cancellation commit point
items.supportsEn: Remote writes create a random 0700 sibling staging directory, upload a version-tagged file while preserving mode, commit with ln -T or rename without a signal, and clean up best effort afterward.

items.title: E2B 远端 executable、进程与 Terminal seam
items.supports: provider 在 shared sandbox 内解析 absolute/bare executable，spawn 受管 process handle，并以 owner runtimeRoot 分配 process/terminal state；terminal setup 有取消与 disposal publication fence。
items.titleEn: E2B remote executable, process, and terminal seam
items.supportsEn: The provider resolves absolute or bare executables inside the shared sandbox, spawns managed process handles, allocates process and terminal state under the owner's runtimeRoot, and fences terminal setup against cancellation and disposal.

items.title: E2B 进程组身份、TERM→KILL 与静止探测
items.supports: 远端 wrapper 用 setsid 并发布实际 PGID；termination 对负 PGID 发 TERM、超时后 KILL 与 SDK kill，再以 ps 排除 zombie/dead entries 后确认 group quiescence。
items.titleEn: E2B process-group identity, TERM-to-KILL, and quiescence probing
items.supportsEn: The remote wrapper uses setsid and publishes the actual PGID; termination signals the negative PGID with TERM, escalates to KILL and SDK kill, then confirms group quiescence through ps while excluding zombie and dead entries.

items.title: E2B Filesystem 的同步、锁与 reopen 限制
items.supports: README 明确没有 host 同步，mutation coordination 仅限 host process，replacement 可与外部写入竞态，且 canonical path 到 stream open 之间仍有 reopen race。
items.titleEn: E2B filesystem synchronization, lock, and reopen limits
items.supportsEn: The README explicitly has no host synchronization, limits mutation coordination to the host process, allows replacement races with external writers, and records a reopen race between canonical path resolution and stream opening.

items.title: Headless E2B 的 same-world 组合
items.supports: 示例禁用 local subprocess/fs，同时插入 E2B owner、remote subprocess/fs 与 full sandbox policy，并注释要求 cwd、policy root 与 Bash/PTY workdir 指向同一远端目录。
items.titleEn: Same-world composition for headless E2B
items.supportsEn: The example disables local subprocess and fs, inserts the E2B owner plus remote subprocess and fs with full sandbox policy, and documents that cwd, policy root, and Bash or PTY workdir must name the same remote directory.

items.title: Glob 与 Grep 的 subprocess execution-world 假设
items.supports: 搜索工具通过 ctx.subprocess 运行 packaged ripgrep，刻意不注入 ctx.fs；返回路径只有在 subprocess workdir 与 filesystem root 共址时才能被 follow-up read，且运行时不验证这一点。
items.titleEn: Subprocess execution-world assumption of glob and grep
items.supportsEn: Search tools run packaged ripgrep through ctx.subprocess and deliberately do not inject ctx.fs; returned paths are follow-up readable only when subprocess workdir and filesystem root are co-located, and that is not runtime validated.

items.title: Filesystem README 的错误码遗漏
items.supports: README 的 stable FsErrorCode 枚举列出多种错误但遗漏源码类型已定义的 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED，形成具体文档漂移。
items.titleEn: Missing error code in the filesystem README
items.supportsEn: The README's stable FsErrorCode enumeration lists many errors but omits FS_SANDBOX_DENIED, which the source type defines, creating concrete documentation drift.

items.title: Sandbox README 的 backend 与 consumer 漂移
items.supports: README 的实现摘要只列 Linux/macOS local backends，consumer 只列 Bash；当前生产代码还包含 Windows ACL 与 filesystem sandbox consumer。
items.titleEn: Backend and consumer drift in the sandbox README
items.supportsEn: The README implementation summary lists only Linux and macOS local backends and only Bash as a consumer, while current production code also contains Windows ACL and the filesystem sandbox consumer.

items.title: 本地沙箱 profile、选择与 fail-closed 测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖三种 profile 方言、custom runner、Linux fallback、单候选与多候选 probe、verdict cache、unavailable、partial Landlock、Seatbelt 与 Windows ACL chain。
items.titleEn: Local sandbox profile, selection, and fail-closed tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover the three profile dialects, custom runners, Linux fallback, sole and multiple candidate probing, verdict caching, unavailable behavior, partial Landlock, Seatbelt, and the Windows ACL chain.

items.title: 执行身份与冻结参数
items.supports: ToolRuntime 在策略前生成 token、解析 rootCallId，并对可无损 JSON 化的参数做脱离快照与深冻结。
items.titleEn: Execution identity and frozen arguments
items.supportsEn: ToolRuntime mints the token, resolves rootCallId, and losslessly snapshots and deep-freezes arguments before policy.

items.title: Pre 决策的封闭权限
items.supports: pre-execute 只能允许、拒绝或询问；参数重写被明确排除。
items.titleEn: Closed pre-execute decision authority
items.supportsEn: Pre-execute may only allow, deny, or ask; argument rewriting is explicitly excluded.

items.title: 审批与 guard 的实际顺序
items.supports: 准备阶段依次检查取消、运行 pre waterfall、解析 ask、运行单调 guard，并在最终取消检查后才分派。
items.titleEn: Actual approval and guard order
items.supportsEn: Preparation checks cancellation, runs the pre waterfall, resolves ask, applies monotonic guards, and dispatches only after a final cancellation check.

items.title: 单调 guard 合同
items.supports: guard 只能返回拒绝原因或不表态，没有允许结果；运行时遇到第一条拒绝即短路。
items.titleEn: Monotonic guard contract
items.supportsEn: A guard returns a denial reason or abstains and has no allow result; runtime stops at the first denial.

items.title: 全局与 scoped guard 注册表
items.supports: guard 可按全局或 Agent scope 注册；执行时先查全局，再从远到近遍历 scope 链并取第一条拒绝。
items.titleEn: Global and scoped guard registry
items.supportsEn: Guards register globally or per Agent scope; execution checks global first, then the scope chain farthest-first, taking the first denial.

items.title: 审批 ID 与封闭结果词表
items.supports: 每次请求使用品牌化 ID；结果仅允许 allowed-once、rejected、cancelled 与 unavailable。
items.titleEn: Approval identity and closed outcomes
items.supportsEn: Each request uses a branded id and may settle only as allowed-once, rejected, cancelled, or unavailable.

items.title: 回答器 waterfall 的 fail-closed 决策
items.supports: never 在分派前拒绝；无回答器、异常或非法结果变为 unavailable；取消胜出后丢弃迟到答案。
items.titleEn: Fail-closed answerer waterfall
items.supportsEn: Never rejects before dispatch; absent, throwing, or rogue answerers become unavailable, and cancellation discards late answers.

items.title: ToolRuntime 的 ask 结果映射
items.supports: 缺少审批服务或 Agent 时拒绝；只有 allowed-once 放行，其余三种结果映射为不同拒绝原因。
items.titleEn: ToolRuntime ask outcome mapping
items.supportsEn: Missing approval or Agent identity denies; only allowed-once proceeds, while the other outcomes map to distinct denial reasons.

items.title: 审批审计与策略事件
items.supports: approval/asked 与 approval/decided 以同一 ID 配对；approval/policy 是 log-only 的 Session 覆盖事件。
items.titleEn: Approval audit and policy events
items.supportsEn: approval/asked and approval/decided pair by id, while approval/policy is a log-only Session override event.

items.title: 不复制参数的审批请求
items.supports: 请求携带 Agent、工具名、可选 callId、理由和 signal；参数通过既有工具调用关联而不重复存储。
items.titleEn: Approval request without duplicated arguments
items.supportsEn: A request carries Agent, tool name, optional callId, reason, and signal; arguments remain linked through the existing tool call.

items.title: Turn 内的审批审计事务
items.supports: request 要求开放 turn，先写 asked，再等待决策并写 matching decided；任一提交失败都会拒绝调用。
items.titleEn: Turn-enclosed approval audit transaction
items.supportsEn: Request requires an open turn, appends asked, awaits the decision, and appends matching decided; commit failures reject the call.

items.title: 审批流的重放 invariant
items.supports: invariant 重放并检查开放 turn、未匹配请求、重复 ID、孤立 decision 与封闭词表；turn 结束时不会强制清空未匹配 asked。
items.titleEn: Replay invariants for approval events
items.supportsEn: The invariant replays and checks open turns, pending asks, duplicate ids, orphan decisions, and closed vocabularies without requiring unmatched asks to clear at turn end.

items.title: 策略竞态与工具体取消
items.supports: 准备阶段多次重查 caller 取消；已启动工具体达到静止点后才把成功结果转为 aborted。
items.titleEn: Policy races and tool-body cancellation
items.supportsEn: Preparation rechecks caller cancellation, while a started body reaches quiescence before an otherwise successful result becomes aborted.

items.title: 可配置权限预设与加载期校验
items.supports: 预设把 sandbox 与 approval 打包；custom 保留为派生值，非约束 shell、无效默认值和不匹配默认组合会加载失败。
items.titleEn: Configurable permission presets and load-time checks
items.supportsEn: Presets bundle sandbox and approval; custom is derived-only, and non-confining shells or unresolved defaults fail at load.

items.title: 从真实 knob 派生当前预设
items.supports: 仍匹配的最后选择优先，其次是表中第一个匹配项，否则派生 custom。
items.titleEn: Deriving the current preset from real knobs
items.supportsEn: A still-matching last selection wins, then the first table match, otherwise the service derives custom.

items.title: 预设的统一写入路径
items.supports: 选择变更时先记录 permission/preset，再仅写入实际变化的 sandbox 与 approval knob；净零选择不写事件。
items.titleEn: Canonical preset write path
items.supportsEn: A changed selection records permission/preset first and writes only changed sandbox and approval knobs; a no-op writes nothing.

items.title: 新 Session 权限固定
items.supports: 全新 Session 在同步 session/created 发布期间固定三项事实；seed、resume 或部分初始化 Session 保留有效状态，只补缺失事实。
items.titleEn: Initial Session permission pinning
items.supportsEn: Fresh Sessions pin all three facts during synchronous session-created publication; seeded, resumed, or partial Sessions preserve effective state and fill only missing facts.

items.title: 权限 projection 与命令面
items.supports: 服务注册 permissions projection，并以 /permission 作为报告与切换当前 Session 预设的统一命令。
items.titleEn: Permissions projection and command surface
items.supportsEn: The service registers the permissions projection and uses /permission as the canonical report and current-Session switch command.

items.title: 发布的三档权限组合
items.supports: base bundle 组合 read-only+ask、workspace-write+ask 与 danger-full-access+never，并由环境变量决定部署默认值。
items.titleEn: Three shipped permission combinations
items.supportsEn: The base bundle composes read-only+ask, workspace-write+ask, and danger-full-access+never, with an environment-derived deployment default.

items.title: 严格扩权阶梯与参数配对
items.supports: read-only 只能升到 workspace-write/full，workspace-write 只能升到 full；权限与理由字段必须成对且理由非空。
items.titleEn: Strict escalation ladder and argument pairing
items.supportsEn: Read-only may widen to workspace-write/full and workspace-write only to full; permission and justification must be paired and nonblank.

items.title: 单次扩权的 fail-closed 流程
items.supports: 运行时先检查严格更宽，再检查审批服务与 Agent，只有 allowed-once 返回仅供本调用使用的目标模式。
items.titleEn: Fail-closed one-call escalation flow
items.supportsEn: Runtime checks strict widening, approval availability, and Agent identity; only allowed-once returns the target mode for this call.

items.title: 沙箱策略解析优先级
items.supports: 已批准的显式模式优先于 Session 日志覆盖值，后者优先于部署默认值；Session cwd 决定 workspace root。
items.titleEn: Sandbox policy resolution precedence
items.supportsEn: An approved explicit mode outranks the Session log override, which outranks the deployment default; Session cwd supplies the workspace root.

items.title: Bash 扩权与启动顺序
items.supports: Bash 解析常驻策略、在任何进程启动前完成单次审批并标记模式，同时在无沙箱能力的组合中拒绝扩权字段。
items.titleEn: Bash escalation and process-start order
items.supportsEn: Bash resolves standing policy, completes one-call approval before any process starts, stamps the mode, and rejects escalation in non-sandboxed compositions.

items.title: PowerShell 扩权与启动顺序
items.supports: PowerShell 在无沙箱能力时拒绝扩权字段；在执行路径中校验参数、解析常驻策略、等待单次审批并标记模式，之后才提交后台 starter 或运行前台进程。
items.titleEn: PowerShell escalation and process-start order
items.supportsEn: PowerShell rejects escalation without sandbox capability; its execution path validates arguments, resolves standing policy, awaits one-call approval, stamps the mode, and only then commits a background starter or runs a foreground process.

items.title: 文件系统扩权 controller
items.supports: 共享 controller 负责能力公布、参数配对、逐调用策略、审批与单次模式，并把沙箱拒绝映射为结构化重试提示。
items.titleEn: Filesystem escalation controller
items.supportsEn: The shared controller owns capability advertisement, pairing, per-call policy, approval and one-call mode, and maps sandbox denial to a structured retry hint.

items.title: 委派 child 的权限固定
items.supports: child 只继承 parent 显式沙箱覆盖，不继承部署默认或单次授权；其审批策略固定为 never，并在 fork seed 后写入自身日志。
items.titleEn: Delegated child permission pinning
items.supportsEn: A child inherits only the parent's explicit sandbox override, not deployment defaults or one-shot grants; approval is pinned to never after fork seed.

items.title: Web 审批 wire 合同
items.supports: 审批是带稳定 rpcId 的 server request；客户端仅能回传 allowed-once/rejected，并精确回显 Session 与 approval ID。
items.titleEn: Web approval wire contract
items.supportsEn: Approval is a server request with stable rpcId; clients may return only allowed-once/rejected while echoing exact Session and approval ids.

items.title: Host 审批 pending registry
items.supports: proxy 将请求与未决定、未认领且 callId 匹配的审计事件配对；abort 与 teardown 取消，断线不删除 pending 项。
items.titleEn: Host approval pending registry
items.supportsEn: The proxy pairs requests with undecided, unclaimed, callId-matching audit events; abort and teardown cancel, while disconnect does not remove pending entries.

items.title: 重连时重放 pending 审批
items.supports: 新 mux 订阅会以同一稳定 rpcId 重放仍未结算的审批请求。
items.titleEn: Pending approval replay on reconnect
items.supportsEn: A new mux subscription replays every unsettled approval request with the same stable rpcId.

items.title: 审批响应的精确关联
items.supports: 响应按 rpcId 路由，并校验 payload、Session 与 approval ID；首次合法响应结算，迟到 ID 返回 not-pending。
items.titleEn: Exact approval-response correlation
items.supportsEn: Responses route by rpcId and validate payload, Session, and approval ids; the first valid response settles and late ids are not-pending.

items.title: 一次性审批面板
items.supports: 面板从配对 root call 解析可选 shell 命令，展示理由，并用单次 latch 处理允许/拒绝与传输失败重试。
items.titleEn: One-shot approval panel
items.supportsEn: The panel derives an optional shell command from the paired root call, shows the reason, and uses a one-shot latch with retry after response failure.

items.title: 未来 Session 默认预设写入
items.supports: Settings controller 用 expected revision 更新 defaultPreset，该值明确只供随后创建的 Session 使用。
items.titleEn: Future-Session default preset write
items.supportsEn: The Settings controller updates defaultPreset with an expected revision, explicitly for subsequently created Sessions.

items.title: Composer 权限选择器与风险确认
items.supports: 选择器过滤 custom、提交 /permission，并仅对机器 key danger-full-access 弹出需勾选的风险确认。
items.titleEn: Composer permission selector and risk confirmation
items.supportsEn: The selector filters custom, submits /permission, and shows checkbox-gated risk confirmation only for the danger-full-access machine key.

items.title: 权限命令弹窗装饰
items.supports: 命令弹窗从 projection 构建选项，只对 FULL_ACCESS_PRESET 附加确认，并最终执行 /permission。
items.titleEn: Permission command popup decoration
items.supportsEn: The command popup builds options from the projection, attaches confirmation only to FULL_ACCESS_PRESET, and executes /permission.

items.title: 默认权限 Settings 风险确认
items.supports: 未来 Session 默认值 UI 同样只对 FULL_ACCESS_PRESET 触发确认，确认后调用选择写入。
items.titleEn: Default-permission Settings risk confirmation
items.supportsEn: The future-Session default UI likewise gates confirmation only for FULL_ACCESS_PRESET before invoking the settings write.

items.title: 浏览器请求信任围栏及其边界
items.supports: Host、Fetch Metadata 与 Origin 检查防御 DNS rebinding/跨站请求；源码明确说明这不是身份认证层。
items.titleEn: Browser request trust fence and boundary
items.supportsEn: Host, Fetch Metadata, and Origin checks defend DNS rebinding and cross-site requests; the source explicitly says this is not authentication.

items.title: ACP 单次机器回答器
items.supports: ACP 只认领自己拥有且带 callId 的 Agent 请求，只提供 allow-once/reject-once，并把未知非允许结果收敛为拒绝。
items.titleEn: ACP one-shot machine answerer
items.supportsEn: ACP claims only owned Agent requests with callId, offers allow-once/reject-once, and collapses unknown non-allow outcomes to rejection.

items.title: ToolRuntime 审批负向测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 pre 拒绝、缺少审批 seam、全部 ask 结果、取消、无 Agent 与非法回答。
items.titleEn: ToolRuntime approval negative-path tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover pre denial, missing approval seam, ask outcomes, cancellation, Agent-less calls, and rogue answers.

items.title: 单调 scoped guard 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 prepended allow 无法绕过 owner guard，并覆盖全局组合、scope 隔离、处置与在线注册行为。
items.titleEn: Monotonic scoped-guard tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove a prepended allow cannot bypass an owner guard and cover global composition, scope isolation, disposal, and live registration.

items.title: ApprovalService 行为与策略测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖开放 turn、审计事件对、回答器异常、取消、新 ID、never 不可绕过、Session 覆盖与模型 context。
items.titleEn: ApprovalService behavior and policy tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover open turns, audit pairing, answerer failures, cancellation, fresh ids, unbypassable never, Session overrides, and model context.

items.title: 权限预设与 Session 固定测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 fold、custom、同 bundle 身份、写入、配置失败、新 Session 默认、seed/resume 保留与 HMR 补齐。
items.titleEn: Permission preset and Session-pinning tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover folds, custom, shared-bundle identity, writes, configuration failures, new-Session defaults, seed/resume preservation, and HMR catch-up.

items.title: 沙箱扩权 fail-closed 测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖参数配对、严格扩权、审计理由、服务/Agent 缺失，以及所有非授权结果。
items.titleEn: Sandbox escalation fail-closed tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover argument pairing, strict widening, audit reasons, missing service/Agent, and every non-grant outcome.

items.title: Web 审批 registry 与恢复测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖往返、稳定 ID 重放、畸形/外来/迟到响应、abort、teardown、并行配对与无审计事件分派。
items.titleEn: Web approval registry and recovery tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover round trip, stable-id replay, malformed/foreign/late responses, abort, teardown, parallel pairing, and unaudited delegation.

items.title: 权限 README 的标识符漂移
items.supports: README 仍把持久事件写作 permissionPresets/preset，并把命令写作 /permissionPresets。
items.titleEn: Permission README identifier drift
items.supportsEn: The README still names the durable event permissionPresets/preset and the command /permissionPresets.

items.title: API proxy README 的审批能力漂移
items.supports: README 仍声称 pending interaction 表只处理 question，且没有 approval 项。
items.titleEn: API proxy README approval-capability drift
items.supportsEn: The README still says the pending interaction table handles questions only and has no approval entries.

items.title: Web provider 的执行时确定性选择
items.supports: Web seam 分离 search/fetch registry，拒绝重复 ID，并按显式配置或唯一可用 provider 在调用时选择；歧义和不可用均结构化失败。
items.titleEn: Deterministic execution-time Web provider selection
items.supportsEn: The Web seam separates search and fetch registries, rejects duplicate ids, and selects at call time by explicit configuration or exactly one usable provider; ambiguity and unavailability fail structurally.

items.title: 归一化 Web 请求与结果词汇
items.supports: Search 输出可选内容与引用来源；fetch 输出最终 URL、状态、封闭 HTML/text 正文联合与截断标志；非 2xx 作为结果。
items.titleEn: Normalized Web request and result vocabulary
items.supportsEn: Search returns optional content and citeable sources; fetch returns final URL, status, a closed HTML/text body union, and truncation, with non-2xx represented as a result.

items.title: Web 工具注册与 provider 可用性解耦
items.supports: tool-web 拥有 schema、开关、上限和超时；启用工具即使 provider 不可用仍保持可见，并在执行时结构化失败。
items.titleEn: Web tool registration decoupled from provider availability
items.supportsEn: tool-web owns schemas, enablement, limits, and timeouts; an enabled tool remains visible when its provider is unavailable and fails structurally at execution.

items.title: 发布组合只启用 DeepSeek Search
items.supports: Base 固定 deepseek-official search，挂载 DeepSeek provider，以 60 秒暴露 web_search，并因缺少 SSRF 保护关闭 fetch 且不挂载 fetch provider。
items.titleEn: Shipped composition enables DeepSeek Search only
items.supportsEn: Base pins deepseek-official search, mounts its provider, exposes web_search with 60 seconds, and disables fetch with no fetch provider because SSRF protection is deferred.

items.title: HTTP fetch URL 与内容类型策略
items.supports: 可选 fetcher 仅接受 HTTP(S)、禁止内嵌凭证、限制 URL、只允许同源重定向语义并归类/解码支持的文本类型；明确延后 SSRF 阻断。
items.titleEn: HTTP fetch URL and content policy
items.supportsEn: The optional fetcher accepts only HTTP(S), rejects embedded credentials, bounds URLs, defines same-origin redirect semantics, and classifies/decodes supported text while explicitly deferring SSRF blocking.

items.title: 匿名、有界、同源的 HTTP fetch
items.supports: Fetcher 不带 cookie 或环境凭证，统一取消与超时，手工处理同源重定向，拒绝不支持内容，并返回状态及解码正文。
items.titleEn: Anonymous bounded same-origin HTTP fetch
items.supportsEn: The fetcher carries no cookies or ambient credentials, unifies cancellation and timeout, handles same-origin redirects manually, rejects unsupported content, and returns status plus decoded body.

items.title: Fetch 字节上限与截断语义
items.supports: 声明长度超限会拒绝；流超过上限时只保留有界前缀并标记截断；完成读取后组合精确字节数组。
items.titleEn: Fetch byte caps and truncation semantics
items.supportsEn: An oversized declared length rejects; a stream crossing the cap retains only a bounded prefix and marks truncation; completed chunks are assembled into exact bytes.

items.title: DeepSeek Search 的 provider-private wire
items.supports: Search 使用独立 Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint、原生 web_search server tool 与 secret-free 辅助请求结构，不经过 ctx.llm。
items.titleEn: Provider-private DeepSeek Search wire
items.supportsEn: Search uses a separate Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint, native web_search server tool, and secret-free auxiliary request shape without going through ctx.llm.

items.title: DeepSeek 原生搜索结果归一化
items.supports: Adapter 要求 web_search_tool_result，按 URL 连接 citation excerpt、去重来源，并把最终数量截断留给 Web seam。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek native-search result normalization
items.supportsEn: The adapter requires web_search_tool_result, joins citation excerpts by URL, deduplicates sources, and leaves final result-count truncation to the Web seam.

items.title: DeepSeek Search 请求、取消与凭证解析
items.supports: 每次搜索快照配置，dispatch 前记录请求，拒绝 redirect，发送兼容认证 header，区分取消/HTTP/解析错误，并按操作解析凭证。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek Search request, cancellation, and credential resolution
items.supportsEn: Each search snapshots config, records before dispatch, rejects redirects, sends compatible auth headers, distinguishes cancellation/HTTP/parse failures, and resolves credentials per operation.

items.title: Search Settings 的逐操作投影与日志挂接
items.supports: Provider 从当前 Settings section 与 credential/environment seam 解析下一操作，并把 secret-free 请求追加到当前 initiator Session。
items.titleEn: Per-operation Search settings projection and logging
items.supportsEn: The provider resolves the next operation from the current Settings section plus credential/environment seams and appends the secret-free request to the current initiator Session.

items.title: 封闭、按扩展名路由的 LSP seam
items.supports: LSP 只暴露四种归一化操作，原子校验并保留 provider ID 与扩展名集合，按最终扩展名确定路由且无 JSON-RPC 逃生口。
items.titleEn: Closed extension-routed LSP seam
items.supportsEn: LSP exposes only four normalized operations, atomically validates and reserves provider ids plus extension sets, routes by final extension, and offers no JSON-RPC escape hatch.

items.title: 模型可见 LSP 精确导航工具
items.supports: 单一只读 lsp 工具使用四操作 enum、从 1 开始的 UTF-16 position、Session workspace、结果上限与 60 秒 timeout，并建议普通导航优先 search/read。
items.titleEn: Model-facing precision LSP navigation tool
items.supportsEn: One read-only lsp tool uses a four-operation enum, one-based UTF-16 positions, the Session workspace, result caps, and a 60-second timeout while recommending search/read for ordinary navigation.

items.title: LSP stdio 的全有或全无激活
items.supports: 插件先验证全部 server 配置并解析全部 executable，之后才注册 provider；冲突回滚，teardown 先移除路由再并行结算所有进程。
items.titleEn: All-or-nothing LSP stdio activation
items.supportsEn: The plugin validates every server and resolves every executable before provider registration; conflicts roll back, and teardown removes routes before settling every process.

items.title: 每 workspace 的 LSP 进程池与串行查询
items.supports: 每个 canonical workspace 懒创建一个 server，并串行 source-read/open/query/close；transport failure 可替换一次，dispose drain lookup、queue 与 instance。
items.titleEn: Per-workspace LSP process pool and serialized queries
items.supportsEn: Each canonical workspace lazily owns one server and serializes source-read/open/query/close; one transport replacement is allowed, and disposal drains lookups, queues, and instances.

items.title: LSP workspace containment 与有界源码读取
items.supports: Workspace 和 source 均经 ctx.fs 规范化；source 必须被 workspace 包含，并以完整 UTF-8 文本和显式字节上限读取。
items.titleEn: LSP workspace containment and bounded source reads
items.supportsEn: Workspace and source are canonicalized through ctx.fs; the source must be contained by the workspace and is read as complete UTF-8 text under an explicit byte cap.

items.title: 可选 E2B 组合中的 LSP
items.supports: 示例显式挂载 lsp、stdio provider、固定 TypeScript server command/extension map 与 tool-lsp，证明该能力依赖可选部署组合。
items.titleEn: LSP in the optional E2B composition
items.supportsEn: The example explicitly mounts lsp, its stdio provider, a pinned TypeScript server command/extension map, and tool-lsp, showing that availability depends on optional composition.

items.title: 一 server 一实例的 MCP 配置与 namespace
items.supports: MCP client 支持 stdio/Streamable HTTP；每实例连接一个 server，以受限且唯一的 serverName 生成公开工具 namespace。
items.titleEn: One-server MCP configuration and namespace
items.supportsEn: The MCP client supports stdio and Streamable HTTP; each instance connects one server and derives its public tool namespace from a constrained unique serverName.

items.title: MCP 初始发现与激活策略
items.supports: 插件先保留 namespace，再启动 supervisor，并等待首次连接与工具同步；failOnStartupError 决定失败是否拒绝整个 activation。
items.titleEn: MCP initial discovery and activation policy
items.supportsEn: The plugin reserves its namespace, starts the supervisor, and awaits first connection plus tool sync; failOnStartupError decides whether failure rejects activation.

items.title: 确定性的 MCP 公开工具名
items.supports: 公开名称由 serverName/rawName 纯函数生成；非法字符或长度变化会附加由身份确定的 hash 后缀，使不同 wire identity 的归一化碰撞极不可能。
items.titleEn: Deterministic MCP public tool names
items.supportsEn: Public names are pure functions of serverName/rawName; character or length normalization adds an identity-derived hash suffix, making collisions between distinct wire identities extremely unlikely.

items.title: MCP 工具代际的两阶段同步
items.supports: 先完整抓取并构建下一代而不改 registry；成功后 dispose 旧代再注册新代；冲突回滚部分新代到零。
items.titleEn: Two-phase MCP tool-generation synchronization
items.supportsEn: The bridge fully fetches and builds the next generation without registry mutation, then disposes old and registers new; a conflict rolls the partial new generation back to zero.

items.title: MCP canonical result 与有损 Native projection
items.supports: Bridge 保留完整 JSON content/structuredContent，拒绝 task-required 与 isError；Native 渲染连接文本并把 image/audio/resource 替成丢弃占位符。
items.titleEn: MCP canonical result and lossy Native projection
items.supportsEn: The bridge preserves full JSON content/structuredContent, rejects task-required and isError results, while Native rendering joins text and replaces image/audio/resource with discarded-content placeholders.

items.title: MCP 同步串行化与有界重连预算
items.supports: 所有 generation 的 sync 串行；连接丢失后按指数退避重连，稳定窗口重置预算，耗尽后注销工具；故障期不提前删除最后有效代。
items.titleEn: Serialized MCP sync and bounded reconnect budget
items.supportsEn: Syncs across all generations serialize; loss triggers exponential backoff, a stability window resets the budget, exhaustion unregisters tools, and the last good generation is not removed early during an outage.

items.title: MCP client generation 的连接、close 与 dispose
items.supports: 每次尝试创建新 Client/transport，connect 后同步；无法在 barrier 内 close 会停止重连以避免进程重叠；dispose drain attempt 与 sync 后注销。
items.titleEn: MCP client-generation connect, close, and disposal
items.supportsEn: Each attempt creates a fresh Client/transport and syncs after connect; failure to close within the barrier stops reconnect to avoid overlap, while disposal drains attempts and syncs before unregistering.

items.title: MCP transport 绕过 subprocess spawn seam
items.supports: Stdio 共享 scrubbedParentEnv 定义但由 MCP SDK 自己 spawn；Streamable HTTP 也由 SDK transport 按配置 URL/header 建立。
items.titleEn: MCP transport bypasses the subprocess spawn seam
items.supportsEn: Stdio shares the scrubbedParentEnv definition but the MCP SDK performs the spawn; Streamable HTTP is likewise constructed by the SDK from configured URL and headers.

items.title: MCP bridge 的已知限制
items.supports: README 明确只桥接 Tools，startup timeout 继承 SDK，HTTP recovery 不同，Native 非文本有损且不支持的 output schema 不执行约束。
items.titleEn: Known MCP bridge limitations
items.supportsEn: The README states that only Tools are bridged, startup timeout comes from the SDK, HTTP recovery differs, Native non-text is lossy, and unsupported output schemas are not enforced.

items.title: MCP memory 示例默认关闭
items.supports: 三个第三方 MCP memory 配置仅为默认关闭的互操作示例；默认组合没有 server，安装、运行与 provider 行为由 operator/第三方拥有。
items.titleEn: MCP memory examples are default-off
items.supportsEn: The three third-party MCP memory configurations are default-off interoperability examples; no server ships by default, and installation, operation, and provider behavior remain external responsibilities.

items.title: Skill summary、candidate、definition 与调用策略
items.supports: Skill 类型分离路由摘要、带 rank/locator 的 candidate 与完整正文，并独立表达 model/user invocation 和三种 resource base。
items.titleEn: Skill summaries, candidates, definitions, and invocation policy
items.supportsEn: Skill types separate routing summaries, ranked/provider-located candidates, and full bodies while independently expressing model/user invocation and three resource-base kinds.

items.title: Canonical Skill wrapper 与受信正文
items.supports: 显式用户调用带 durable source；统一 skill_content wrapper 转义 framing metadata，却因正文是受信本地内容而逐字嵌入 instruction body。
items.titleEn: Canonical Skill wrapper and trusted body
items.supportsEn: Explicit user invocation carries a durable source; the shared skill_content wrapper escapes framing metadata but embeds the instruction body verbatim because it is trusted local content.

items.title: 分层 Skill registry 与 runtime contribution
items.supports: 注册落入调用 context 的 global/scoped layer；近层同名直接覆盖，rank 只决定单层 winner；provider 和 runtime skill 都随 effect 生命周期撤销。
items.titleEn: Layered Skill registry and runtime contributions
items.supportsEn: Registrations enter the calling context's global/scoped layer; nearer same-name entries override outright, rank selects only within one layer, and providers/runtime skills are effect-scoped.

items.title: Skill catalog 收集、缓存与不完整观察
items.supports: Registry 按 cwd/scope/revision 收集并缓存完整目录，revision race 有界重试；provider failure/incomplete observation 不缓存，层按近端顺序覆盖。
items.titleEn: Skill catalog collection, caching, and incomplete observations
items.supportsEn: The registry collects and caches complete catalogs by cwd/scope/revision with a bounded revision-race retry; provider failures/incomplete observations are not cached, and nearer layers overwrite.

items.title: Filesystem Skill root、rank 与 provider 生命周期
items.supports: Provider 定义 project/custom/user/bundled rank，按 cwd 建根，观察 watcher 完整度，经 locator 加载正文并对模型文件 mutation 主动 invalidation。
items.titleEn: Filesystem Skill roots, ranks, and provider lifecycle
items.supportsEn: The provider defines project/custom/user/bundled ranks, builds roots by cwd, observes watcher completeness, loads bodies by locator, and actively invalidates on model-facing file mutations.

items.title: Skill 目录与正文的 filesystem/host 分流
items.supports: 普通 root 在 ctx.fs 存在时经该 seam 列举读取；trusted bundled root 可用 Node host FS；解析 frontmatter 并把非文本/缺失项作为不可用。
items.titleEn: Filesystem-versus-host routing for Skill directories and bodies
items.supportsEn: Ordinary roots use ctx.fs for listing and reads when present; trusted bundled roots may use Node host FS; frontmatter is parsed and missing/non-text entries are treated as unavailable.

items.title: Skill loader 的可见性与双重重新验证
items.supports: 模型工具按 Agent cwd/scope 先 list 检查 summary，再 get 并复查 loaded definition 的 modelInvocable，最后返回正文与 resource base。
items.titleEn: Skill loader visibility and double revalidation
items.supportsEn: The model tool lists by Agent cwd/scope and checks the summary, then gets and rechecks the loaded definition's modelInvocable policy before returning body and resource base.

items.title: 用户显式 Skill gesture 与 instructions 注入
items.supports: 只有直接 user source 的空白边界 /name token 会被扫描；loaded definition 必须 userInvocable，随后以统一 wrapper 作为最后的 instructions context 注入。
items.titleEn: Explicit user Skill gestures and instruction injection
items.supportsEn: Only whitespace-bounded /name tokens in direct user-source text are scanned; the loaded definition must be userInvocable and is then injected last as instructions using the shared wrapper.

items.title: 可见性匹配的耐久 Skill replacement catalog
items.supports: 插件按精确 tool identity 发布 name/description source entry；完整 digest 变化追加 whole-list replacement，空列表废止旧名，不完整 snapshot 不发布。
items.titleEn: Visibility-matched durable Skill replacement catalog
items.supportsEn: The plugin publishes name/description source entries only for its exact visible tool identity; complete digest changes append whole-list replacements, empty lists retire old names, and incomplete snapshots publish nothing.

items.title: Base 的 Skill service 与默认工具行
items.supports: Base 组合挂载 agent instructions、Skill registry、filesystem provider 与 tool-skill；badge 保持关闭。
items.titleEn: Base Skill service and default tool rows
items.supportsEn: The base composition mounts agent instructions, the Skill registry, filesystem provider, and tool-skill while leaving the badge disabled.

items.title: Standard preset 的 scoped Skill discovery 与 loader
items.supports: Standard preset 把 filesystem provider 和 tool-skill 注册到自身分层 registry 视图，同时合并部署级 global contribution。
items.titleEn: Scoped Skill discovery and loader in the Standard preset
items.supportsEn: The Standard preset registers filesystem discovery and tool-skill into its layered registry view while also merging deployment-global contributions.

items.title: Workflow 启动请求与 holder-owned run
items.supports: 请求包含脚本、metadata、args、provider/总量 override、parent 和 signal；live run 暴露永不 reject 的结果、取消与幂等处置。
items.titleEn: Workflow start request and holder-owned run
items.supportsEn: A request carries script, metadata, args, provider/total overrides, parent, and signal; a live run exposes a never-rejecting result, cancellation, and idempotent disposal.

items.title: WorkflowEngine 生命周期合同
items.supports: 无效请求在发布前抛出；live run 由持有者拥有，取消和处置有界，listener failure 被隔离，end 随结果恰好发出一次。
items.titleEn: WorkflowEngine lifecycle contract
items.supportsEn: Invalid requests throw before publication; the holder owns a live run, cancellation and disposal are bounded, listener failures are contained, and end follows result settlement exactly once.

items.title: Worker engine 的发布前验证与启动
items.supports: Engine 用同一 wrapper 做 parse check，解析 provider 和 run ceiling，创建 worker 后才发布 start，并把所有后续结果映射为 run settlement。
items.titleEn: Worker-engine pre-publication validation and start
items.supportsEn: The engine parse-checks the same wrapper, resolves provider and run ceiling, publishes start only after constructing the worker, and maps later outcomes into run settlement.

items.title: Workflow metadata 的全量验证与归一化副本
items.supports: 验证器收集未知/缺失/类型错误的字段和 phase，并仅从通过验证的字段构造不别名 caller 的 normalized copy。
items.titleEn: Complete workflow metadata validation and normalized copy
items.supportsEn: The validator collects unknown, missing, and mistyped fields and phases, then builds a normalized non-aliasing copy only from validated fields.

items.title: Fresh worker 的 scrubbed environment 与 structured clone
items.supports: 每个 run 创建新 Worker，清空 ambient env/execArgv，仅保留平台临时路径和开发加载所需 pin；init 通过 workerData clone。
items.titleEn: Fresh worker with scrubbed environment and structured clone
items.supportsEn: Each run creates a new Worker with ambient env and execArgv cleared, preserving only platform temp/development loader pins, while init crosses through workerData clone.

items.title: VM 不是安全边界的明示 trust premise
items.supports: 源码明确称 VM 可逃逸，仅提供 host-loop 隔离与终止；getter、proxy 和错误值渲染都可能执行脚本代码。
items.titleEn: Explicit trust premise that the VM is not a security boundary
items.supportsEn: The source calls the VM escapable and limits it to host-loop isolation and termination; getters, proxies, and thrown-value rendering may execute script code.

items.title: Workflow VM 的封闭 global surface
items.supports: 每个 realm 只注入 agent、parallel、pipeline、phase、log 与 args，并用相同 async wrapper 编译脚本。
items.titleEn: Closed global surface of the workflow VM
items.supportsEn: Each realm receives only agent, parallel, pipeline, phase, log, and args, and compiles the body in the same async wrapper.

items.title: Hook 边界取消与 never-reject drive
items.supports: 取消使排队 slot 与之后每个 hook 抛 CANCELLED；drive 在 initial VM timeout 后做 settle 检查并把所有失败归一为结果。
items.titleEn: Hook-boundary cancellation and never-reject drive
items.supportsEn: Cancellation rejects queued slots and makes every later hook throw CANCELLED; drive checks settlement around the initial VM timeout and normalizes every failure into a result.

items.title: agent() option 的封闭集合与 schema 验证
items.supports: Runtime 只接受 label/phase/schema/provider/model，明确拒绝 deferred/unknown option，并约束 object-rooted JSON Schema 子集。
items.titleEn: Closed agent() option set and schema validation
items.supportsEn: The runtime accepts only label, phase, schema, provider, and model, explicitly rejects deferred/unknown options, and constrains the object-rooted JSON Schema subset.

items.title: Host 到 Subagent seam 的 child bridge
items.supports: Host 在 admission gate 后用 parent、共享 signal、schema 和 provider/model override 启动 child，并在发布 handle 后把快照结果传回 worker。
items.titleEn: Host child bridge to the Subagent seam
items.supportsEn: After its admission gate, the host starts a child with parent, shared signal, schema, and provider/model overrides, then forwards a snapshotted result after publishing the handle.

items.title: agent() 结果、失败与处置语义
items.supports: 调用在 slot 内启动 child；completed 返回文本或 structured 值，普通失败/缺少 structured 值返回 null，基础设施 reject 为 fatal，并始终 dispose。
items.titleEn: agent() result, failure, and disposal semantics
items.supportsEn: Within a slot the call starts a child; completion returns text or structured data, ordinary failure/missing structured data returns null, infrastructure rejection is fatal, and disposal always runs.

items.title: Workflow worker 的部署上限
items.supports: 配置分离并发 child、每 run 总 child、每 combinator item、同步 slice 与 dispose grace；并发默认按 CPU 自动解析。
items.titleEn: Deployment limits of the workflow worker
items.supportsEn: Configuration separates concurrent children, total children per run, items per combinator, synchronous slice, and disposal grace; concurrency auto-resolves from CPU count.

items.title: FIFO concurrency slot 与预排队总量计数
items.supports: Slot 等待为 FIFO；agent 总量在 acquire 前计数并检查，取消会 reject waiter，acquire 后再次检查竞态。
items.titleEn: FIFO concurrency slots and pre-queue total counting
items.supportsEn: Slot waits are FIFO; total agents are counted and checked before acquisition, cancellation rejects waiters, and a post-acquire check closes races.

items.title: parallel barrier 与逐 item pipeline
items.supports: parallel 对全部 thunk 做 Promise.all；pipeline 让每个 item 独立穿过全部 stage，无跨 stage barrier；普通错误置 null，fatal 错误传播。
items.titleEn: parallel barrier and per-item pipeline
items.supportsEn: parallel applies Promise.all to all thunks; pipeline moves each item independently through every stage with no cross-stage barrier; ordinary errors become null and fatal errors propagate.

items.title: WorkflowError 的机器可路由 fatal taxonomy
items.supports: Parse、meta、参数、option/schema、cap、child infrastructure、JSON boundary 与取消均有 code；普通 child failure 不在 fatal 分类中。
items.titleEn: Machine-routable fatal WorkflowError taxonomy
items.supportsEn: Parse, meta, arguments, options/schema, caps, child infrastructure, JSON boundary, and cancellation have codes; ordinary child failure is outside the fatal taxonomy.

items.title: Combinator 中不可伪造的 fatality 分流
items.supports: parallel/pipeline 仅对 host realm 的 fatal WorkflowError 重新抛出，普通 script throw 才映射为单项 null。
items.titleEn: Unforgeable fatality routing inside combinators
items.supportsEn: parallel and pipeline rethrow only host-realm fatal WorkflowErrors, while ordinary script throws map to per-item null.

items.title: 无损 JSON materialization 边界
items.supports: 跨 realm copy 拒绝 JSON 无法无损表达的值、cycle、sparse array、exotic prototype 与 symbol key，并安全保留 __proto__ 数据键。
items.titleEn: Lossless JSON materialization boundary
items.supportsEn: Cross-realm copying rejects values JSON cannot preserve, cycles, sparse arrays, exotic prototypes, and symbol keys while safely retaining a __proto__ data key.

items.title: Child result 的 worker-boundary snapshot
items.supports: Host 把 output/structured/stopReason 快照成 JSON；无法无损跨界会作为 child infrastructure failure 返回。
items.titleEn: Worker-boundary snapshot of child results
items.supportsEn: The host snapshots output, structured data, and stop reason as JSON; inability to cross losslessly is returned as a child infrastructure failure.

items.title: Result 与 cancellation 的 first-wins settlement
items.supports: Host 在 cleanup 前原子 claim terminal；先到 result 保留，已接受 cancellation 会把竞态中的非取消结果改写为 cancelled。
items.titleEn: First-wins settlement between result and cancellation
items.supportsEn: The host atomically claims terminal ownership before cleanup; an earlier result stays, while an already accepted cancellation turns a racing non-cancel result into cancelled.

items.title: 每个 published child 的 exactly-once end ledger
items.supports: Host 用 live ledger 保证每个 forwarded agent-start 恰好一个 agent-end；worker 无法发言时合成 cancelled end。
items.titleEn: Exactly-once end ledger for every published child
items.supportsEn: A live host ledger guarantees exactly one agent-end for every forwarded agent-start and synthesizes a cancelled end when the worker can no longer speak.

items.title: Workflow dispose 的有界清理事务
items.supports: Memoized dispose 立即驱动 child cleanup，在同一 grace 内等待结果与 quiescence，随后无条件终止 worker 并做最后 sweep。
items.titleEn: Bounded cleanup transaction of workflow disposal
items.supportsEn: Memoized disposal immediately drives child cleanup, waits for result and quiescence within the same grace, then unconditionally terminates the worker and performs a final sweep.

items.title: Child disposal 去重与 quiescence
items.supports: 每个 child disposal 被 memoize；quiescence 同时等待 pending provider starts 和 published children，失败被记录并隔离。
items.titleEn: Deduplicated child disposal and quiescence
items.supportsEn: Each child disposal is memoized; quiescence waits for both pending provider starts and published children, with failures logged and contained.

items.title: 已接受 run 的 holder-bound dependency 生命周期
items.supports: Engine 返回前捕获 subagent handle；engine HMR 卸载后，既有 run 仍可启动与清理 child。
items.titleEn: Holder-bound dependency lifetime of an accepted run
items.supportsEn: The engine captures the subagent handle before returning, allowing an existing run to keep starting and cleaning children after engine HMR unload.

items.title: Observe-only workflow 事件词汇
items.supports: Seam 定义 start/phase/log/agent-start/agent-end/end；phase 无执行语义，事件不暴露控制 handle，end 不带 result value。
items.titleEn: Observe-only workflow event vocabulary
items.supportsEn: The seam defines start, phase, log, agent-start, agent-end, and end; phases have no execution semantics, events expose no control handle, and end omits the result value.

items.title: 模型可见 Workflow authoring contract
items.supports: Tool description 完整定义 meta、script、args、hook、failure 和 foreground 约束；prompt policy 要求显式大型编排请求，schema/renderer 由 consumer 拥有。
items.titleEn: Model-facing Workflow authoring contract
items.supportsEn: The tool description defines meta, script, args, hooks, failures, and foreground constraints; prompt policy requires explicit large orchestration, while the consumer owns schema and rendering.

items.title: Workflow 工具的执行、取消与 finally disposal
items.supports: 工具要求 calling Agent，启动 foreground run，桥接 abort，等待永不 reject 的结果，把非 completed 映射为 error，并在 finally 中 dispose。
items.titleEn: Workflow tool execution, cancellation, and finally disposal
items.supportsEn: The tool requires a calling Agent, starts a foreground run, bridges abort, awaits the never-reject result, maps non-completed outcomes to errors, and disposes in finally.

items.title: Root workflow 的耐久记录投影与降级
items.supports: Recorder 按 run 过滤 lifecycle，append failure 后停止该 run；execute 仅在 root transport 记录，并在 disposal/quiescence 后写 run-end。
items.titleEn: Durable root-workflow projection and degradation
items.supportsEn: The recorder filters lifecycle events by run and disables that run after append failure; execute records only root transport calls and writes run-end after disposal/quiescence.

items.title: 浏览器安全的 Workflow Session record 类型
items.supports: 四种 log-only event 记录 run identity/name、child sequence/label/phase/id、member outcome 和 terminal reason。
items.titleEn: Browser-safe Workflow Session record types
items.supportsEn: Four log-only events record run identity/name, child sequence/label/phase/id, member outcome, and terminal reason.

items.title: Workflow record 的冷加载与增量不变量
items.supports: Fold 拒绝无 start、重复 sequence/end、开放 member 上的 run-end 和 terminal 后更新，并同时用于已有 Session 与 live append。
items.titleEn: Cold-load and incremental Workflow-record invariants
items.supportsEn: The fold rejects missing starts, duplicate sequences/ends, run-end with open members, and post-terminal updates, and applies to both existing Sessions and live appends.

items.title: Ralph 的最小模型 schema 与显式使用策略
items.supports: Ralph 只暴露 objective/maxRounds，固定工具名与输出 envelope；system prompt 要求人类明确提出 Ralph/fresh-agent iteration。
items.titleEn: Ralph's minimal model schema and explicit-use policy
items.supportsEn: Ralph exposes only objective/maxRounds with a fixed tool name and output envelope; its system prompt requires an explicit human request for Ralph/fresh-agent iteration.

items.title: Ralph round cap 与 fresh-provider capability gate
