items.supports: 调用轮数必须为 ceiling 内的正 safe integer；provider 必须已注册、支持 structured output 且不继承 parent context。
items.titleEn: Ralph round cap and fresh-provider capability gate
items.supportsEn: The call round count must be a positive safe integer within the ceiling; the provider must be registered, support structured output, and not inherit parent context.

items.title: 构建时固定的 Ralph 状态机与 report 规则
items.supports: 固定脚本定义 report schema/status invariant、有界 handoff、逐轮 fresh agent，以及 complete/blocked/round-failed/budget-limited 转移。
items.titleEn: Build-time-fixed Ralph state machine and report rules
items.supportsEn: The fixed script defines report schema/status invariants, bounded handoff, one fresh agent per round, and complete/blocked/round-failed/budget-limited transitions.

items.title: Ralph 每轮 prompt 与 workspace memory
items.supports: 每轮只携带 immutable objective、轮次、workspace-as-truth 指令和前一份 bounded report，并明确无 parent conversation/previous child session。
items.titleEn: Ralph round prompt and workspace memory
items.supportsEn: Each round carries only the immutable objective, round index, workspace-as-truth instruction, and previous bounded report, explicitly without parent conversation or a previous child Session.

items.title: Ralph terminal result 的 consumer-side 再验证
items.supports: TypeScript 重新验证 exact key set、status、round 范围、各状态 report invariant 与 handoff size，拒绝畸形 engine boundary value。
items.titleEn: Consumer-side revalidation of Ralph terminal results
items.supportsEn: TypeScript revalidates exact keys, status, round range, status-specific report invariants, and handoff size, rejecting malformed engine-boundary values.

items.title: Ralph 对固定 Workflow 的执行映射
items.supports: Tool trim objective、解析上限和 provider，向 engine 传固定脚本/provider/maxTotalAgents，桥接取消，解析结果，并在 finally dispose。
items.titleEn: Ralph execution mapping onto a fixed Workflow
items.supportsEn: The tool trims the objective, resolves cap/provider, passes the fixed script/provider/maxTotalAgents to the engine, bridges cancellation, decodes the result, and disposes in finally.

items.title: Ralph 的有界、非认证式结果渲染
items.supports: Renderer 明说 worker reported completion/blocker 或达到轮限；maxResultChars 包括 envelope 与 truncation marker，round failure 保留最后 handoff。
items.titleEn: Bounded, non-certifying Ralph result rendering
items.supportsEn: The renderer says the worker reported completion/blocker or reached its limit; maxResultChars includes envelope and truncation marker, and round failure retains the last handoff.

items.title: Ralph terminal outcome 与 round-failure 语义
items.supports: Decoder 区分 complete、blocked、budget-limited 与 round-failed，限制 roundsStarted，并在 ordinary child failure 时保留上一份 continue report。
items.titleEn: Ralph terminal outcomes and round-failure semantics
items.supportsEn: The decoder distinguishes complete, blocked, budget-limited, and round-failed, bounds roundsStarted, and retains the previous continue report after an ordinary child failure.

items.title: Base 中的 Workflow 与 Ralph 发行组合
items.supports: Base 以 spawn 挂载 worker engine 与 workflow tool，并挂载使用 spawn、64 轮 ceiling 的 Ralph。
items.titleEn: Shipped Workflow and Ralph composition in Base
items.supportsEn: Base mounts the worker engine and workflow tool over spawn, plus Ralph over spawn with a 64-round ceiling.

items.title: Standard preset 的 per-Agent Workflow isolation
items.supports: Delegation group 隔离 workflowEngine，并在同一 entry-local realm 挂载 worker、generic tool 与 64 轮 Ralph。
items.titleEn: Per-Agent Workflow isolation in the Standard preset
items.supportsEn: The delegation group isolates workflowEngine and mounts the worker, generic tool, and 64-round Ralph in the same entry-local realm.

items.title: Web host plane 禁用 base Workflow rows
items.supports: Web overlay 禁用 base 的 subagent、workflow engine、workflow tool 与 Ralph rows，让 session preset 决定 Agent capability。
items.titleEn: Web host plane disables base Workflow rows
items.supportsEn: The Web overlay disables base subagent, workflow engine, workflow tool, and Ralph rows so session presets determine Agent capabilities.

items.title: 工具展示模式与子调用并发配置
items.supports: 工具运行时定义 native、code、both 三种展示模式；code 只暴露 run_code，并为每次程序设置默认 10 的嵌套调用并发上限。
items.titleEn: Tool presentation modes and sub-call concurrency
items.supportsEn: The tool runtime defines native, code, and both presentation modes; code exposes only run_code, with a default per-program nested-call cap of 10.

items.title: 按作用域选择并可撤销的 Code Mode
items.supports: 展示模式按最近作用域解析；agent 或 preset 可覆盖部署默认，dispose 会恢复原展示并卸载相应 prompt section。
items.titleEn: Scoped and disposable Code Mode selection
items.supportsEn: Presentation resolves from the nearest scope; an agent or preset can override the deployment default, and disposal restores the previous view and prompt sections.

items.title: Code Mode SDK 在每次 prompt assembly 时重建
items.supports: tools:sdk section 在渲染时从调用作用域的当前可见工具稳定重建，而非在 ToolRuntime 构造时冻结。
items.titleEn: The Code Mode SDK is rebuilt at every prompt assembly
items.supportsEn: The tools:sdk section is rebuilt at render time from the calling scope's currently visible tools in stable order rather than frozen when ToolRuntime is constructed.

items.title: run_code 是保留的展示 transport
items.supports: run_code 不进入普通可过滤注册层，而是在可见性解析后加入，因而不能被 agent restriction 移除或被 scoped tool shadow。
items.titleEn: run_code is reserved presentation transport
items.supportsEn: run_code stays outside ordinary filterable registration layers and is inserted after visibility resolution, so agent restrictions cannot remove it and scoped tools cannot shadow it.

items.title: wire schema 收缩与运行时语言校验
items.supports: native 发送可见原生工具，code 只发送 run_code，both 同时发送；非 native 模式在 prompt assembly 时要求存在受支持语言的 CodeRuntime。
items.titleEn: Wire-schema collapse and runtime-language validation
items.supportsEn: Native sends visible tools, code sends only run_code, and both sends both forms; non-native prompt assembly requires a CodeRuntime with a supported language.

items.title: 执行边界也强制 code collapse
items.supports: code 模式下模型直调只能命名 run_code；带 parent token 的嵌套调用可执行 agent 可见工具；生成 SDK 排除 run_code 自身，关闭递归 transport。
items.titleEn: The execution boundary also enforces code collapse
items.supportsEn: In code mode, model-direct calls may name only run_code; nested calls carrying a parent token may execute agent-visible tools, and the generated SDK excludes run_code itself to close recursive transport.

items.title: assembly 与执行分别读取 CodeRuntime
items.supports: CodeRuntime 在 prompt assembly 与 run_code 执行时分别动态读取，当前没有把语言绑定到单次请求；源码将第二后端出现时的语言热切换窗口列为延期工作。
items.titleEn: Assembly and execution read CodeRuntime separately
items.supportsEn: CodeRuntime is read dynamically at prompt assembly and again at run_code execution, without binding the language to one request; the source defers closing the hot-swap window until a second backend ships.

items.title: run_code 输入、输出与运行期入口
items.supports: run_code 要求 code 与非空 description，输出只有 logs 和可选 result；执行时解析 runtime，并把外层取消传入 run-scoped AbortController。
items.titleEn: run_code input, output, and runtime entry
items.supportsEn: run_code requires code and a non-empty description, returns only logs plus an optional result, resolves the runtime at execution, and forwards outer cancellation into a run-scoped AbortController.

items.title: 嵌套 dispatch 记录与模型历史分层
items.supports: 每个 Code Mode 子调用都记录为可重建的 nested dispatch，但只有 outer run_code 的 curated result 进入模型历史。
items.titleEn: Nested dispatch records and model history are layered
items.supportsEn: Every Code Mode sub-call is logged as a reconstructable nested dispatch, while only the outer run_code curated result enters model history.

items.title: 每次程序独立的嵌套调度器
items.supports: run_code 使用单一有序 lane 执行 start、prepare、commit，仅让标记为并发安全的 dispatch body 重叠；exclusive 调用形成覆盖 post-execute 的屏障，结束时排空日志工作。
items.titleEn: A per-program nested scheduler
items.supportsEn: run_code uses one ordered lane for start, prepare, and commit, overlaps only concurrency-safe dispatch bodies, holds exclusive barriers through post-execute, and drains logging work at settlement.

items.title: 嵌套调用身份、日志与上下文提交
items.supports: 每个嵌套调用获得确定性 subCallId、root/parent identity、同一 agent 与取消 signal；start/settle 事件带独立参数快照，结果在有序 commit 后向程序 resolve，并把 additionalContexts 与 concludesTurn 提交到外层。
items.titleEn: Nested-call identity, logging, and context commitment
items.supportsEn: Each nested call receives a deterministic subCallId, root/parent identity, the same agent and cancellation signal; start/settle events carry detached argument snapshots, results resolve after ordered commit, and additionalContexts plus concludesTurn are forwarded to the outer execution.

items.title: 绑定快照、递归排除与收敛
items.supports: 每次 run 从调用 agent 当前可见 schema 构造一个不含 run_code 的 null-prototype tools namespace；runtime 结束后先取消并排空全部嵌套调用，再把失败变为 CODE_RUN_FAILED 或返回 curated logs/result。
items.titleEn: Binding snapshot, recursion exclusion, and convergence
items.supportsEn: Each run builds a null-prototype tools namespace from the calling agent's currently visible schemas, excluding run_code; after runtime settlement it aborts and drains every nested call before converting failures to CODE_RUN_FAILED or returning curated logs/result.

items.title: 嵌套调用复用完整 ToolRuntime pipeline
items.supports: staged execution 依次执行 pre-execute、approval、monotonic guards、around-dispatch、真实工具 body、结果规范化与 post 阶段；取消和工具失败都物化为标准结果。
items.titleEn: Nested calls reuse the complete ToolRuntime pipeline
items.supportsEn: Staged execution runs pre-execute, approval, monotonic guards, around-dispatch, the real tool body, result normalization, and post stages; cancellation and tool failures materialize as standard results.

items.title: CodeRuntime 的 JSON 边界与失败分类
items.supports: 绑定参数和结果必须是 lossless JSON，且中间 binding resolution 没有 seam 级字节上限；run 失败分 exception、timeout、abort、worker-exit、invalid-output、output-limit，并作为 resolved result 的 error 字段返回。
items.titleEn: CodeRuntime JSON boundary and failure taxonomy
items.supportsEn: Binding arguments and results must be lossless JSON, with no seam-level byte cap on intermediate binding resolutions; run failures are exception, timeout, abort, worker-exit, invalid-output, or output-limit and return in a resolved result's error field.

items.title: language 与 isolation 只是描述符
items.supports: CodeRuntime 的 language 和 isolation 用于 presentation 与诊断，不构成安全声明；源码明确只有 TypeScript 有已发布后端。
items.titleEn: language and isolation are descriptors only
items.supportsEn: CodeRuntime language and isolation guide presentation and diagnostics rather than making a security claim; the source explicitly states that only TypeScript has a published backend.

items.title: worker-thread 是 containment 而非安全边界
items.supports: 每次运行使用 fresh worker，但模块注释明确模型代码具有与 bash 等价的信任，即使环境为空、堆和时间受限且可强制 terminate。
items.titleEn: worker-thread is containment, not a security boundary
items.supportsEn: Each run uses a fresh worker, but the module explicitly gives model code bash-equivalent trust despite an empty environment, heap and time bounds, and forced termination.

items.title: worker 默认预算与 dispose 语义
items.supports: 默认预算为 60 秒 busy time、600 秒 wall time、64 MiB 合并外层输出和 512 MiB old generation；dispose 会 abort 并等待所有 worker 退出，类型剥离失败不启动 worker。
items.titleEn: Worker defaults and disposal semantics
items.supportsEn: Defaults are 60 seconds busy time, 600 seconds wall time, 64 MiB combined outer output, and 512 MiB old generation; disposal aborts and awaits every worker, and type-strip failures spawn none.

items.title: fresh worker 与单一终局
items.supports: 每次执行创建 env={}、execArgv=[]、受 heap 限制的 worker；所有完成路径只允许一个结果获胜，并在 resolve 前 terminate worker、排空 stdout/stderr。
items.titleEn: Fresh worker and single terminal outcome
items.supportsEn: Every execution creates a worker with env={}, execArgv=[], and a heap limit; exactly one outcome wins, and the host terminates the worker and drains stdout/stderr before resolving.

items.title: hostile worker 消息、预算与取消
items.supports: Host 对 worker 消息做形状校验、own-property binding lookup 与 JSON 重验证；重复 ID、未知 binding、坏值、worker exit、busy/wall timeout 和 abort 都被收敛到受控结果。
items.titleEn: Hostile worker messages, budgets, and cancellation
items.supportsEn: The host shape-checks worker messages, uses own-property binding lookup, and revalidates JSON; duplicate IDs, unknown bindings, bad values, worker exit, busy/wall timeouts, and abort all converge to controlled results.

items.title: 程序只获得显式 namespace 与 console
items.supports: worker 构造 null-prototype binding namespaces，用消息端口桥接 async 调用，并把程序作为 strict AsyncFunction body 执行；注入参数只有声明的 namespaces、error classes 与 console。
items.titleEn: Programs receive only explicit namespaces and console
items.supportsEn: The worker builds null-prototype binding namespaces, bridges async calls over the message port, and executes the program as a strict AsyncFunction body whose injected parameters are only declared namespaces, error classes, and console.

items.title: 扁平、迭代的 worker JSON wire
items.supports: lossless JSON 被编码为扁平 token stream，并以迭代方式严格解码；深层值不依赖 JavaScript 调用栈，畸形或不完整输入返回 undefined。
items.titleEn: Flat, iterative worker JSON wire
items.supportsEn: Lossless JSON is encoded as a flat token stream and strictly decoded iteratively; deep values do not consume JavaScript call-stack depth, and malformed or incomplete inputs return undefined.

items.title: Headless bundle 挂载 CodeRuntime，但默认仍由 mode 控制
items.supports: Headless bundle 把 tools.mode 接到 DSH_TOOLS_MODE，并始终挂载 worker-thread CodeRuntime；未设置 mode 时 schema 默认仍是 native。
items.titleEn: The headless bundle mounts CodeRuntime while mode remains opt-in
items.supportsEn: The headless bundle maps tools.mode to DSH_TOOLS_MODE and mounts the worker-thread CodeRuntime; when mode is unset, the schema default remains native.

items.title: Web bundle 的临时进程级 Code Mode 开关
items.supports: Web bundle 同样通过 DSH_TOOLS_MODE 选择 native/code/both，并将该环境变量标记为 per-session UI 尚未完成前的临时进程级方案。
items.titleEn: The web bundle's temporary process-wide Code Mode switch
items.supportsEn: The web bundle also selects native/code/both through DSH_TOOLS_MODE and labels that environment variable a temporary process-wide seam until per-session UI selection exists.

items.title: 模型自修改工具是显式 opt-in overlay
items.supports: 高级 headless 示例额外挂载 CodeRuntime、Cordis Host runner 和 tool-cordis；基础 bundle 并不自动把模型自修改工具加入每个 agent。
items.titleEn: Model self-modification tools are an explicit opt-in overlay
items.supportsEn: The advanced headless example explicitly adds CodeRuntime, the Cordis host runner, and tool-cordis; the base bundle does not automatically add model self-modification tools to every agent.

items.title: 三个分层 inspect 工具
items.supports: tool-cordis 注册 provider list、schema-validated query 与 session-owned self inspection；精确 Package source 只有同时提供 pluginId 和 packageId 才返回。
items.titleEn: Three layered inspect tools
items.supportsEn: tool-cordis registers provider listing, schema-validated queries, and session-owned self inspection; exact Package source is returned only when both pluginId and packageId are supplied.

items.title: cordis_define 只记录不可变 Package
items.supports: cordis_define 为新 Plugin 或既有 Plugin 记录至少一个 Host/Client plain-JavaScript half，返回 pluginId/packageId，并明确不执行、不审批、不改变 currentPackageId。
items.titleEn: cordis_define only records an immutable Package
items.supportsEn: cordis_define records at least one plain-JavaScript Host/Client half for a new or existing Plugin, returns pluginId/packageId, and explicitly does not execute, request approval, or change currentPackageId.

items.title: run、stop 与 undefine 的模型契约
items.supports: cordis_run 返回 awaiting-approval、starting 或 running；stop 保留 definitions、grants 与 version pointers，undefine 则停止并永久删除整个 Plugin。
items.titleEn: Model contract for run, stop, and undefine
items.supportsEn: cordis_run returns awaiting-approval, starting, or running; stop retains definitions, grants, and version pointers, while undefine stops and permanently removes the entire Plugin.

items.title: 动态 Plugin 的生命周期、版本与信任说明
items.supports: 系统提示把动态 Plugin 定义为当前进程的临时扩展，明确不是安全边界；列出七工具流程、三种 identity、不可变版本、审批 grant，以及 update 失败不自动重启旧版本。
items.titleEn: Dynamic Plugin lifecycle, versions, and trust guidance
items.supportsEn: The system prompt defines dynamic Plugins as temporary current-process extensions and not a security boundary; it lists the seven-tool workflow, three identities, immutable versions, approval grants, and that a failed update does not automatically restart the old version.

items.title: @pluginId 只从用户消息注入 source-free context
items.supports: 显式引用只从 user-source 文本按严格 ID pattern 提取；注入当前 base/version 状态但要求随后精确 inspect source，丢失或跨 Session 的引用会明确报告不可用。
items.titleEn: @pluginId injects source-free context only from user messages
items.supportsEn: Explicit references are extracted only from user-source text with a strict ID pattern; injected context carries current base/version state but requires exact source inspection, and missing or cross-session references are reported unavailable.

items.title: Inspect query 的平台路由与取消
items.supports: Host query 本地校验输入/输出；Client query 发布带 agent identity 的请求，等待第一个同 Session 有效响应或 AbortSignal 取消，并清理 pending state。
items.titleEn: Inspect-query platform routing and cancellation
items.supportsEn: Host queries validate input/output locally; Client queries publish an agent-identified request, wait for the first valid same-session response or AbortSignal cancellation, and clean pending state.

items.title: Plugin、Package、Run 与 approval 的状态模型
items.supports: 一个 session-owned Plugin 保存不可变 Package map、per-package 与 future-version grants、current/next pointers、单个 active run、latest attempt；run 和 pending approval 都有独立 identity。
items.titleEn: Plugin, Package, Run, and approval state model
items.supportsEn: A session-owned Plugin stores an immutable Package map, per-package and future-version grants, current/next pointers, one active run, and the latest attempt; runs and pending approvals have independent identities.

items.title: define-time 校验与 Package 追加
items.supports: runner 校验 metadata、至少一个 half、双方语法与 new/existing ownership，然后 mint 新 packageId 并 append source；define 不启动 runtime。
items.titleEn: Define-time validation and Package append
items.supportsEn: The runner validates metadata, at least one half, both halves' syntax, and new/existing ownership, then mints a packageId and appends source; define does not start the runtime.

items.title: Host-only 快路径与 Client approval 状态机
items.supports: Host-only Package 直接 activate；带 Client half 的 Package 在没有 grant 时创建 approval request，在已有授权时进入 starting，并用 request/package/run identity 防止陈旧批准启动错误版本。
items.titleEn: Host-only fast path and Client approval state machine
items.supportsEn: Host-only Packages activate directly; Client-bearing Packages create an approval request without a grant or enter starting when authorized, while request/package/run identities prevent stale approval from starting the wrong version.

items.title: approval response 的 first-answer 与 exact-run 校验
items.supports: resolveRequestRun 只接受仍 pending 且指向 exact active pluginRunId 的响应，claim 后完成 activation、广播 resolution 并把结果 steer 回 Agent；未知、陈旧或重复响应返回 accepted:false。
items.titleEn: First-answer and exact-run checks for approval responses
items.supportsEn: resolveRequestRun accepts only a still-pending response naming the exact active pluginRunId, claims it, settles activation, broadcasts resolution, and steers the result; unknown, stale, or duplicate responses return accepted:false.

items.title: 浏览器按 Host→source→Client→settle 顺序激活
items.supports: 页面按 Plugin 串接激活：先启动 Host half，再获取 exact active run 的 Client source，加载 browser half，最后回答 approval 或 direct run；任一步失败都返回分阶段诊断。
items.titleEn: Browser activation follows Host to source to Client to settlement
items.supportsEn: The page orchestrates per Plugin: start the Host half, fetch Client source for the exact active run, load the browser half, then answer approval or direct run; failures return stage-specific diagnostics.

items.title: 更新先撤旧 run，成功后才提交 current pointer
items.supports: 新的 activation 先 await retract 旧 run，再启动 Host/Client；Client-bearing run 在 client-pending 停留，只有完整成功的 commitActivation 才设置 currentPackageId 并清空 next。失败只撤销自己拥有的新 run。
items.titleEn: Updates retract the old run before committing current on success
items.supportsEn: A new activation first awaits retraction of the old run, then starts Host/Client; a Client-bearing run stays client-pending, and only successful commitActivation sets currentPackageId and clears next. Failure retracts only the new run it owns.

items.title: 异步 activation 结果通过 steering 回到 Agent
items.supports: 页面侧最终成功、拒绝或技术失败会转成带 exact Plugin/Package/Run identity 的 steering context；失败文本包含 current/next pointers 与同 Plugin 修复建议。
items.titleEn: Asynchronous activation outcomes return through steering
items.supportsEn: Final page-side success, rejection, or technical failure becomes steering context with exact Plugin/Package/Run identity; failure text includes current/next pointers and same-Plugin repair guidance.

items.title: 停止到 quiescence 与 Session ownership
items.supports: retract 先移除 live run，再注销 handlers、await fiber.dispose 并发出 retract event；所有 action lookup 都要求 plugin.sessionId 等于 agent.id。
items.titleEn: Stop-to-quiescence and Session ownership
items.supportsEn: Retraction removes the live run, unregisters handlers, awaits fiber.dispose, and emits a retract event; action lookup requires plugin.sessionId to equal agent.id.

items.title: 动态 Host VM 的真实信任边界
items.supports: Host half 在 fresh node:vm realm 中运行并通过 traps 引导到 ctx services，但 host-realm helper 仍构成 escape route；模块明确声明这不是恶意代码安全边界。
items.titleEn: The real trust boundary of the dynamic Host VM
items.supportsEn: The Host half runs in a fresh node:vm realm and traps redirect work to ctx services, but host-realm helpers remain an escape route; the module explicitly says this is not a malicious-code security boundary.

items.title: define-time 语法预检与同步 VM timeout
items.supports: Host/Client source 在 define 时用相同 async wrapper compile-only 预检；Host evaluate 的 vmTimeoutMs 只限制同步部分，async body 会逃离该时间界限。
items.titleEn: Define-time syntax precheck and synchronous VM timeout
items.supportsEn: Host/Client source is compile-only prechecked at define time with the same async wrapper; Host evaluation's vmTimeoutMs bounds only the synchronous portion, while an async body escapes that limit.

items.title: 动态工具定义、JSON 归一化与执行旁路封闭
items.supports: harness.defineTool 验证 schema/render/execute 并用 JSON clone 物化跨 realm 输出；register 只接受 marker-tagged definition，ctx.tools.get 仅返回 schema view，不能取得 execute 直接绕过 ToolRuntime。
items.titleEn: Dynamic tool definition, JSON normalization, and bypass closure
items.supportsEn: harness.defineTool validates schema/render/execute and JSON-clones cross-realm outputs; register accepts only marker-tagged definitions, and ctx.tools.get returns a schema view rather than execute, preventing direct ToolRuntime bypass.

items.title: 动态 Host Context 是 capability façade
items.supports: Host half 只可使用 lifecycle-safe verbs、ctx.get 与声明的 injected services；framework internals、Context-valued service returns 和未声明 property access 被拒绝，apply 始终接收 façade。
items.titleEn: Dynamic Host Context is a capability facade
items.supportsEn: A Host half may use only lifecycle-safe verbs, ctx.get, and declared injected services; framework internals, Context-valued service returns, and undeclared property access are denied, and apply always receives the facade.

items.title: 浏览器 half 的 closure symbol surface
items.supports: Client source 在浏览器 new Function async body 中执行，参数显式注入 React、console、styles、host.call 与 teaching traps，并把 process/Buffer 设为 undefined；返回值必须是 Plugin。
items.titleEn: The browser half's closure symbol surface
items.supportsEn: Client source executes in a browser new Function async body whose parameters explicitly inject React, console, styles, host.call, and teaching traps while setting process/Buffer to undefined; the return must be a Plugin.

items.title: 浏览器 Context façade 与声明式 service gate
items.supports: Client half 的 ctx 同样只暴露 lifecycle verbs、optional get 与已声明 services；slots/theme 走专用 guard，赋值与 framework internals 被拒绝。
items.titleEn: Browser Context facade and declared-service gate
items.supportsEn: The Client half's ctx likewise exposes only lifecycle verbs, optional get, and declared services; slots/theme use specialized guards, while assignment and framework internals are denied.

items.title: 浏览器 package 操作按 Plugin 串行且可恢复
items.supports: Client runner 对每个 pluginId 串行 load/unload，替换旧 activation，retract 只移除 exact run，dispose 卸载全部；queue tail 吞掉单次失败以免后续操作永久卡住。
items.titleEn: Browser package operations serialize per Plugin and recover
items.supportsEn: The Client runner serializes load/unload per pluginId, replaces old activations, retracts only the exact run, and unloads all on disposal; its queue tail contains one failure so later operations do not wedge.

items.title: tool-cordis README 仍描述旧五工具与旧配置
items.supports: README 仍列出旧 cordis_inspect 五工具接口，并声称 runner 有 ackTimeoutMs；生产源码已拆成七工具，runner 当前配置只有 vmTimeoutMs。
items.titleEn: tool-cordis README still describes the old five-tool and config surface
items.supportsEn: The README still lists the old five-tool cordis_inspect surface and claims an ackTimeoutMs runner option; production source has seven tools and the current runner config has only vmTimeoutMs.

items.title: Code Mode 展示矩阵回归测试
items.supports: 测试固定 native/code/both 的 wire schema、SDK 与 code-only prompt rule，包含规则在普通工具指导之前出现的顺序。
items.titleEn: Code Mode presentation-matrix regression tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin native/code/both wire schemas, SDK presence, and the code-only prompt rule, including its order before ordinary tool guidance.

items.title: 嵌套调度、barrier、顺序与 drain 测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖并发安全调用重叠、exclusive barrier、并发 cap、pre/post 有序、run settlement drain、context commit 与 queued-unstarted abandon。
items.titleEn: Nested scheduler, barrier, ordering, and drain tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover concurrency-safe overlap, exclusive barriers, the cap, ordered pre/post stages, run-settlement drain, context commitment, and queued-unstarted abandonment.

items.title: 嵌套 policy、错误、取消与 quiescence 测试
items.supports: 测试固定工具错误向程序 reject、pre-execute deny、lossless JSON、context 保留、CODE_RUN_FAILED、外层取消，以及 runtime reject 后仍排空嵌套工作。
items.titleEn: Nested policy, error, cancellation, and quiescence tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin program-side rejection for tool errors, pre-execute denial, lossless JSON, context retention, CODE_RUN_FAILED, outer cancellation, and nested-work drain after runtime rejection.

items.title: worker failure budget 与隔离测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖语法/运行异常、空环境、无损输出、busy/wall timeout、abort、晚到 binding、OOM/worker exit 和合并输出上限。
items.titleEn: Worker failure-budget and isolation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover syntax/runtime exceptions, an empty environment, lossless output, busy/wall timeouts, abort, late bindings, OOM/worker exit, and the combined output cap.

items.title: hostile worker port 与双边 JSON 校验测试
items.supports: 测试注入未知 binding、重复 ID、垃圾消息、伪造 log/done 与 lossless JSON 违规，验证 Host 仍 fail closed 且不崩溃。
items.titleEn: Hostile worker-port and bidirectional JSON validation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests inject unknown bindings, duplicate IDs, junk messages, forged log/done messages, and lossless-JSON violations, verifying that the host fails closed without crashing.

items.title: 动态定义、ownership、approval 与异步失败测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 define-only、语法拒绝、跨 Session 隐藏、Host-only 快路径、Client approval/refusal、Client failure unwind 与更新失败。
items.titleEn: Dynamic definition, ownership, approval, and asynchronous-failure tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover define-only behavior, syntax rejection, cross-session hiding, the Host-only fast path, Client approval/refusal, Client-failure unwind, and failed updates.

items.title: 动态 Context escape 与 capability gate 测试
items.supports: 测试固定 ctx.root bypass、Context-returning service、未声明 service 和 live ToolDefinition.execute 访问均被拒绝，同时允许声明或 optional get 的合法路径。
items.titleEn: Dynamic Context escape and capability-gate tests
items.supportsEn: Tests pin rejection of ctx.root bypass, Context-returning services, undeclared services, and access to live ToolDefinition.execute while preserving declared and optional-get paths.

items.title: 版本指针与失败 ownership 测试
items.supports: 测试证明失败更新保留 currentPackageId 并清理 attempt 状态、pending approval 可取消撤销，以及附着页面失败不会停止既有 Host run。
items.titleEn: Version-pointer and failure-ownership tests
items.supportsEn: Tests show that failed updates preserve currentPackageId while cleaning attempt state, pending approval can be cancelled and retracted, and an attaching page's failure does not stop an existing Host run.

items.title: Client replace、串行、失败恢复与 dispose 测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖新 revision 替换、同 Plugin 操作串行、失败后 queue 继续、activation failure teardown、exact retract 和 runner disposal。
items.titleEn: Client replacement, serialization, failure recovery, and disposal tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover new-revision replacement, per-Plugin operation serialization, queue recovery after failure, activation-failure teardown, exact retraction, and runner disposal.

items.title: 统一消息身份、来源与冻结
items.supports: 消息具有稳定 ID、角色、精确内容和可扩展来源；既有消息深冻结，新消息分配 UUID。
items.titleEn: Unified message identity, source, and freezing
items.supportsEn: Messages carry stable IDs, roles, exact content, and extensible sources; existing messages are deep-frozen and new messages receive UUIDs.

items.title: 两类 Inbox 与 durable splice 事件
items.supports: 只定义 next-turn/next-step 两个目标；agent/inbox/spliced 记录坐标、完整插入消息和可选 canceled outcome。
items.titleEn: Two Inbox targets and the durable splice event
items.supportsEn: Only next-turn and next-step exist; agent/inbox/spliced records coordinates, complete inserted messages, and an optional canceled outcome.

items.title: Splice 的 commit-first 与身份不变量
items.supports: 坐标先归一化并验证，Session append 成功后才改 live projection；MessageId 在两列表间唯一。
items.titleEn: Commit-first splices and the identity invariant
items.supportsEn: Coordinates are normalized and validated before Session append; live state mutates only after success, and MessageId is unique across both lists.

items.title: Seed 后回放与 claim 顺序
items.supports: Inbox 只回放 seedLength 后的 splice；claim 先取全部 next-step，再按目标取一条 next-turn。
items.titleEn: Post-seed replay and claim order
items.supportsEn: Inbox replays only post-seed splices; claim takes every next-step item first and then one next-turn item when requested.

items.title: Follow-up、steer 与 inject 映射
items.supports: 统一 send 先插入再可选 wake；followup、steer、inject 分别映射为 next-turn+wake、next-step+wake、next-step+quiet。
items.titleEn: Follow-up, steer, and inject mapping
items.supportsEn: Unified send inserts before optional wake; followup, steer, and inject map to next-turn+wake, next-step+wake, and next-step+quiet.

items.title: Follow-up FIFO Turn 性质测试
items.supports: 同步 burst、逐条发送和混合 settle 都验证每条普通消息独占递增 Turn，顺序不变。
items.titleEn: Follow-up FIFO Turn property tests
items.supportsEn: Synchronous bursts, sequential sends, and mixed settlement verify one increasing Turn per ordinary message without reordering.

items.title: 输入重分类、driver wake 与 latch
items.supports: send 在 abort 后把 waking input 改投 next-turn；idle wake 预留 driver，活动中只在 maintenance/abort 情况 latch，并在退出时 replay。
items.titleEn: Input reclassification, driver wake, and latch
items.supportsEn: Send redirects post-abort waking input to next-turn; idle wake reserves a driver, active work latches only for maintenance/abort, and exit replays it.

items.title: Pre-step claim cutoff 与后到输入测试
items.supports: pre-step 中后到的 inject/steer 错过首请求并按序进入下一 Step；blocked batch 后的输入保留。
items.titleEn: Pre-step claim cutoff and late-input tests
items.supportsEn: Inject and steer arriving during pre-step miss the first request and enter the next Step in order; input after a blocked batch survives.

items.title: Turn/Step claim、准入与关闭机器
items.supports: Turn 先记录 start 再 claim；reject 产生 blocked 无 Step，empty enter 产生 completed 无 Step，pending next-step 继续同 Turn，其他 pending 开新 Turn。
items.titleEn: Turn/Step claim, admission, and closing machine
items.supportsEn: A Turn starts before claim; reject yields blocked with no Step, empty enter yields completed with no Step, next-step continues the Turn, and other pending work opens another Turn.

items.title: 工具结果与 additional context 的有序提交
items.supports: Finalized tool result 先按模型顺序写入，随后把该结果的 additionalContexts 逐条交给 next-step acceptor。
items.titleEn: Ordered tool-result and additional-context commit
items.supportsEn: Each finalized tool result is appended in model order, then its additionalContexts are passed one by one to the next-step acceptor.

items.title: 工具结果后的同 Turn continuation
items.supports: 工具未 concluded 时 Turn loop 继续后续 Step；已有 next-step 也阻止 concluded 立即关闭。
items.titleEn: Same-Turn continuation after tool results
items.supportsEn: An unconcluded tool outcome continues the Turn into a later Step, and existing next-step work prevents an immediate close even after conclusion.

items.title: Turn-stopping steering 回归测试
items.supports: 模型本来会结束时，turn-stopping listener 中的 steer 强制同 Turn 第二个模型 Step。
items.titleEn: Turn-stopping steering regression
items.supportsEn: When the model would otherwise stop, steer from a turn-stopping listener forces a second model Step in the same Turn.

items.title: Agent status、whenIdle、maintenance 与输入合同
items.supports: running 覆盖完整 driver drain，maintenance 对外仍 idle，whenIdle 跟随替换活动，三种输入的 wake/边界语义显式定义。
items.titleEn: Agent status, whenIdle, maintenance, and input contracts
items.supportsEn: Running spans the whole driver drain, maintenance remains externally idle, whenIdle follows replacement activity, and all three input boundaries are explicit.

items.title: Cancel 的 clear 与 abort 实现
items.supports: 默认 cancel 清空 Inbox 并清 wake latch，keepInbox 跳过清空；只有非 idle phase 接收 abort signal。
items.titleEn: Cancel clear and abort implementation
items.supportsEn: Default cancel clears the Inbox and wake latch, keepInbox skips clearing, and only a non-idle phase receives the abort signal.

items.title: Claimed work、keepInbox 与 latch 测试
items.supports: 测试证明已 claim 工作不恢复、pre-abort queue 会停放、post-abort waking send 会 replay，默认 cancel 清除 latch。
items.titleEn: Claimed work, keepInbox, and latch tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove claimed work is not restored, pre-abort queued work parks, post-abort waking sends replay, and default cancel clears the latch.

items.title: 默认取消丢弃 queued tail
items.supports: 运行中默认 cancel 使 Turn aborted，并丢弃尚未运行的 queued tail。
items.titleEn: Default cancellation drops the queued tail
items.supportsEn: Default cancel during a running Turn records an aborted ending and drops the queued tail before it runs.

items.title: Abort-to-idle wake latch 测试矩阵
items.supports: 覆盖 pre-abort parking、post-abort replay、latch 清除/移除和慢取消收敛。
items.titleEn: Abort-to-idle wake-latch test matrix
items.supportsEn: Covers pre-abort parking, post-abort replay, latch clearing/removal, and slow cancellation convergence.

items.title: 取消收敛 latch 决策与剩余缺口
items.supports: 记录 latch 的原因、只区分 post-abort wake 的设计，以及 final hasPending 后 sub-microtask gap 仍可能停放输入。
items.titleEn: Cancellation-convergence latch decision and remaining gap
items.supportsEn: Records why the latch exists, why it distinguishes post-abort wakes, and how the post-hasPending sub-microtask gap can still park input.

items.title: Consumed work 的联合事件折叠
items.supports: 单遍联合 step、claim、turn/end 与 canceled splice，区分 accounted Turn 与 dropped-unrun input。
items.titleEn: Joint event fold for consumed work
items.supportsEn: A single pass joins steps, claims, turn endings, and canceled splices to distinguish accounted Turns from dropped-unrun input.

items.title: Consumed-work 边界测试
items.supports: 覆盖无工作、失败/取消/blocked claim、empty rewrite、turn 外 claim、drop、replacement 与后续吸收。
items.titleEn: Consumed-work boundary tests
items.supportsEn: Covers no work, failed/cancelled/blocked claims, empty rewrites, out-of-Turn claims, drops, replacements, and later absorption.

items.title: 模型与工具副作用前的语义 checkpoint
items.supports: pre-step 与 llm/stream 边界 flush Session；flush 失败时不 dispatch 模型或顶层工具副作用。
items.titleEn: Semantic checkpoints before model and tool side effects
items.supportsEn: Pre-step and llm/stream boundaries flush the Session; flush failure prevents model or top-level tool side-effect dispatch.

items.title: 模型 dispatch 硬崩溃恢复测试
items.supports: 硬杀子进程后，恢复日志保留完整请求前缀并补 interrupted closing；工具 intent 缺结果时补 unknown outcome。
items.titleEn: Hard-crash recovery at model dispatch
items.supportsEn: After a hard child-process kill, recovery retains the complete request prefix with interrupted closers and repairs missing tool results as unknown outcomes.

items.title: JSONL fsync、write-behind 与 flush
items.supports: 首批与后续 batch 都 fsync，失败回滚；live event 用固定窗口合批，flush 与 teardown 会 drain。
items.titleEn: JSONL fsync, write-behind, and flush
items.supportsEn: Initial and later batches are fsynced with rollback on failure; live events use a fixed batching window while flush and teardown drain.

items.title: 持久化 Agent resume 路径
items.supports: resume 从 persistence prepare 后进入共享 setupAndPublish，并以 resume source 发布新的 Agent handle。
items.titleEn: Persisted Agent resume path
items.supportsEn: Resume prepares from persistence, rejoins shared setupAndPublish, and publishes a new Agent handle with resume source.

items.title: Inbox 的 seed ownership boundary
items.supports: 构造时明确跳过 seedLength 之前的事件，只把 Session 自己的 suffix splice 重建为 pending。
items.titleEn: Inbox seed-ownership boundary
items.supportsEn: Construction explicitly skips events before seedLength and reconstructs pending state only from the Session's own suffix splices.

items.title: Ordinary prompt admission 与模式路由
items.supports: Host 创建带来源的 message，queue 调 followup、steer 调 steer，并在同步 enqueue 成功后返回 accepted。
items.titleEn: Ordinary prompt admission and mode routing
items.supportsEn: The Host creates a sourced message, routes queue to followup and steer to steer, and returns accepted after synchronous enqueue succeeds.

items.title: Session prompt、queue mutation 与 cancel wire contract
items.supports: Contract 定义 queue/steer prompt、edit/remove/steer mutation，并声明 ordinary cancel 保留 pending work。
items.titleEn: Session prompt, queue mutation, and cancel wire contract
items.supportsEn: The contract defines queue/steer prompts, edit/remove/steer mutations, and ordinary cancellation that preserves pending work.

items.title: MessageId queue mutation 与 strict steer
items.supports: Host 重新定位 pending item，限制 text edit，strict steer 只接受 running next-turn item，并以同一消息 remove 后 steer；cancel 使用 keepInbox。
items.titleEn: MessageId queue mutation and strict steer
items.supportsEn: The Host relocates pending items, limits edits to text, accepts strict steer only for running next-turn items, removes then steers the same message, and cancels with keepInbox.

items.title: 两个 Inbox 列表的权威 Web projection
items.supports: Host 投影 next-turn 与 next-step，用 user source 区分 steering/context，并在同步 observer 中应用当前 splice 得 post-state。
items.titleEn: Authoritative Web projection of both Inbox lists
items.supportsEn: The Host projects next-turn and next-step, distinguishes steering/context by user source, and applies the current splice inside the synchronous observer to derive post-state.

items.title: Mux reconnect queue baseline
items.supports: 重连先为 Session 建立 subscription，再仅为仍有 pending 的 Agent 发送完整 queue baseline。
items.titleEn: Mux reconnect queue baseline
items.supportsEn: Reconnect establishes Session subscriptions and then sends a complete queue baseline only for Agents that still have pending work.

items.title: Client generation queue reset
items.supports: 客户端在 session/subscribed 上清旧 queue mirror，再接受同 stream 后续 snapshot，正确处理 Host 省略空 baseline。
items.titleEn: Client-generation queue reset
items.supportsEn: The client clears the old queue mirror on session/subscribed and then accepts the same stream's later snapshot, correctly handling an omitted empty baseline.

items.title: Queue snapshot mirror 与 durable handoff
items.supports: 客户端以完整 snapshot 替换 queue，并在同 MessageId 的 user/message 到达时退休一个 pending steering row。
items.titleEn: Queue snapshot mirror and durable handoff
items.supportsEn: The client replaces the queue from whole snapshots and retires one pending steering row when user/message with the same MessageId arrives.

items.title: Durable steering 历史分类
items.supports: Replay 通过 next-step 的非 canceled removal 记录 claimed identity，再仅把 user-source user/message 分类为 steering。
items.titleEn: Durable steering history classification
items.supportsEn: Replay records identities removed from next-step without cancellation and classifies only the later user-source user/message as steering.

items.title: QueueDock 过滤与逐项操作
items.supports: Dock 只显示 queued placement，并在 ordinary session 提供 text edit、remove 和仅 running 可用的 steer。
items.titleEn: QueueDock filtering and row actions
items.supportsEn: The Dock displays only queued placement and offers text edit, remove, and running-only steer for ordinary sessions.

items.title: Conversation tail 的 pending steering
items.supports: ChatView 在 running indicator 之后把全部 pending steering 渲染为独立 bubble。
items.titleEn: Pending steering at the conversation tail
items.supportsEn: ChatView renders every pending steering item as a separate bubble after the running indicator.

items.title: Busy Enter 的 queue/steer 决策
items.supports: 非 running 或无 steering transport 强制 queue；busy 状态按偏好选择，accelerated gesture 取相反值，并明确 direct steer 为 best effort。
items.titleEn: Busy-Enter queue/steer decision
items.supportsEn: Non-running or non-steer transports force queue; busy state follows the preference, accelerated gesture chooses the opposite, and direct steer is explicitly best-effort.

items.title: Enter 去重与 whole-queue steer gesture
items.supports: 重复 Enter 被抑制；空 draft 的 accelerated Enter 可把 still-pending queue 逐项 steer，否则按 policy 提交。
items.titleEn: Enter deduplication and whole-queue steer gesture
items.supportsEn: Repeated Enter is suppressed; accelerated Enter on an empty draft steers every still-pending queued row, otherwise submission follows policy.

items.title: Continuable child 的 start/followup/interrupt/report seam
items.supports: Start 以 initial Inbox acceptance 为边界；later followup 是下一 FIFO Turn；interrupt 保留 pending；report 由 exact child 发给 direct parent。
items.titleEn: Continuable-child start/followup/interrupt/report seam
items.supportsEn: Start ends at initial Inbox acceptance; later followup is the next FIFO Turn; interrupt preserves pending work; report flows from the exact child to its direct parent.

items.title: Activation 是 residency epoch
items.supports: Activation 明确不是 request/result/cancel/task，可执行多个 FIFO Turn；manager 管 residency，Agent Inbox 管唯一 Turn queue。
items.titleEn: Activation as a residency epoch
items.supportsEn: An Activation is explicitly not a request, result, cancellation, or task; it can execute many FIFO Turns while the Agent Inbox remains the sole Turn queue.

items.title: Activation running/waiting/settled 推导
items.supports: 状态从 Agent 活动和 owned-child set 推导，不引入第二个独立执行状态机。
items.titleEn: Derived Activation running/waiting/settled states
items.supportsEn: State is derived from Agent activity and the owned-child set rather than introducing a second execution state machine.

items.title: Resident、disposal race 与 cold-resume delivery
items.supports: 每 child 锁串行化 followup；resident 直接 submit，absent cold-resume，已开始 disposal 的 delivery 等释放后重试。
items.titleEn: Resident, disposal-race, and cold-resume delivery
items.supportsEn: A per-child lock serializes followup: resident children submit directly, absent children cold-resume, and delivery racing disposal waits for release then retries.

items.title: Continuable child 冷恢复与 lineage 授权
items.supports: 冷恢复 inspect persistence，先验证 durable direct parent，再仅折叠 seed suffix descriptor，materialize 后 submit。
items.titleEn: Continuable-child cold resume and lineage authorization
items.supportsEn: Cold resume inspects persistence, authorizes the durable direct parent first, folds only the post-seed descriptor, materializes, and then submits.

items.title: Child follow-up 的同步 admission fence
items.supports: 在 no-await 段检查 signal/drain/disposal/lineage，先登记 accepted ID，再同步调用 child Agent.followup 并标 announced。
items.titleEn: Synchronous admission fence for child follow-up
items.supportsEn: A no-await span checks signal, drain, disposal, and lineage; it records the accepted ID before synchronously calling child Agent.followup and marking announced.

items.title: Continuable child interrupt 语义
items.supports: Interrupt 授权 live target 后调用 cancel keepInbox 并立即返回；claimed 不恢复，pending/descendants 保留，absent 为 no-op。
items.titleEn: Continuable-child interrupt semantics
items.supportsEn: Interrupt authorizes the live target, calls cancel with keepInbox, and returns immediately; claimed work is not restored, pending work and descendants remain, and absence is a no-op.

items.title: Exact-child report 与父调度
items.supports: 只有 exact resident child 可报告；direct parent 从 lineage 解析；wakeup 用 followup，quiet 用 inject，报告不结束 child。
items.titleEn: Exact-child reporting and parent scheduling
items.supportsEn: Only the exact resident child may report; direct parent comes from lineage; wakeup uses followup, quiet uses inject, and reporting does not end the child.

items.title: Settlement notice 的时序与路由
items.supports: 通知在释放父 ownership 前投递；closing parent inject、idle followup、busy steer；失败丢弃且最终 flush best effort。
items.titleEn: Settlement-notice ordering and routing
items.supportsEn: Notice delivery precedes parent-ownership release; closing parents receive inject, idle parents followup, busy parents steer; failures drop and final flush is best-effort.

items.title: Subagent prompt 与 interrupt receipt contract
items.supports: Prompt receipt 是 accepted MessageId，后续执行独立；interrupt receipt 只确认 cancel signal，保留 pending，absent/idle 也 accepted。
items.titleEn: Subagent prompt and interrupt receipt contract
items.supportsEn: Prompt receipt is an accepted MessageId with independent later execution; interrupt receipt acknowledges only the cancel signal, preserves pending work, and accepts absent/idle targets.

items.title: Subagent Host prompt 与 offline-parent interrupt
items.supports: Child prompt 要求 live parent 并调用 continuation followup；interrupt 不查 parent/catalog/persistence，而由 live Activation 授权 durable address。
items.titleEn: Subagent Host prompt and offline-parent interrupt
items.supportsEn: Child prompt requires a live parent and calls continuation followup; interrupt performs no parent/catalog/persistence lookup and lets the live Activation authorize the durable address.

items.title: Client ordinary/child prompt 与 cancel 路由
items.supports: Ordinary session 透传 queue/steer；one-shot child 只读；continuable child text-only 且忽略 mode；cancel 分派到 session.cancel 或 subagent.interrupt。
items.titleEn: Client ordinary/child prompt and cancel routing
items.supportsEn: Ordinary sessions pass queue/steer through; one-shot children are read-only; continuable children are text-only and ignore mode; cancel routes to session.cancel or subagent.interrupt.

items.title: Running child 的独立 Send 与 Stop
items.supports: Ordinary running session 的主按钮变 Stop；continuable child 保留 Send 为主按钮并单独提供 Stop，因此可继续排后续消息。
items.titleEn: Independent Send and Stop for a running child
items.supportsEn: A running ordinary session makes Stop primary, while a continuable child retains Send as primary and exposes Stop separately so follow-ups can queue.

items.title: Parent offline 时的 child composer
items.supports: One-shot child 永远只读；parent offline 的 continuable child 在 running 时保留默认 composer 以暴露 Stop，停止后切换只读。
items.titleEn: Child composer while the parent is offline
items.supportsEn: One-shot children are always read-only; a parent-offline continuable child keeps the default composer while running to expose Stop, then becomes read-only after stopping.

items.title: send_message 与 interrupt_agent 模型合同
items.supports: send_message 用 exact caller 走 child followup，明确不能 redirect 当前 Turn且不返回 child reply；interrupt 只请求取消并保留 queue。
items.titleEn: Model contract for send_message and interrupt_agent
items.supportsEn: send_message uses the exact caller for child followup, cannot redirect the current Turn, and returns no child reply; interrupt only requests cancellation and preserves the queue.

items.title: Queue wire 注释的 durability 漂移
items.supports: 同一文件把完整 pending message 放入 queue frame，却声称它到 claim 才 durable且没有 durable Session event，与 Inbox splice 实现冲突。
items.titleEn: Durability drift in queue wire comments
items.supportsEn: The file carries complete pending messages in queue frames yet says they become durable only at claim and have no durable Session event, contradicting the Inbox splice implementation.

items.title: ApiProxy README 的 next-step projection 漂移
items.supports: README 声称 next-step steering 不进入 Web projection，而当前 queueItems 与 ChatView 明确投影并呈现它。
items.titleEn: ApiProxy README drift on next-step projection
items.supportsEn: The README says next-step steering stays outside Web projection, while current queueItems and ChatView explicitly project and render it.

items.title: Subagent capability 与 provider seam
items.supports: Provider 显式声明四项启动能力、父对话继承属性、one-shot start 与可选 prepareContinuable；不同 child 可并发且 continuable 生命周期由 manager 而非 provider 拥有。
items.titleEn: Subagent capabilities and provider seam
items.supportsEn: Providers explicitly declare four start capabilities, parent-history inheritance, one-shot start, and optional prepareContinuable; distinct children may overlap and the manager, not the provider, owns continuable lifecycles.

items.title: Base bundle 的多 Agent 装配
items.supports: Base 注册 subagent service、spawn/fork provider、控制/列表工具和 report setup，并将 spawn 配为 continuable、fork 配为 one-shot。
items.titleEn: Base-bundle multi-agent composition
items.supportsEn: Base registers the subagent service, spawn/fork providers, control/list tools, and report setup, binding spawn to continuable and fork to one-shot.

items.title: Web host plane 与 Agent plane 的 subagent 分界
items.supports: Web 保留跨 Session 的 registry/backend 在 host plane，并禁用 base 的模型控制/委派工具以交给 Session preset。
items.titleEn: Subagent boundary between Web host and Agent planes
items.supportsEn: Web retains the cross-Session registry/backends on the host plane and disables base model-facing delegation/control tools so Session presets can choose them.

items.title: 委派工具的三条执行路线
items.supports: run_in_background 与 backgroundMode 选择 foreground one-shot、Job-backed one-shot 或 continuable background；三者返回值和提交点不同。
items.titleEn: Three delegation-tool execution routes
items.supportsEn: run_in_background and backgroundMode select foreground one-shot, Job-backed one-shot, or continuable background execution with distinct return values and commit points.

items.title: Continuable child 的启动事务
items.supports: Manager 预留 ID、快照 descriptor/policy、准备 seed、materialize child，并仅在初始消息被 inbox 接受后返回 childId/messageId；之前失败完全回滚。
items.titleEn: Continuable-child start transaction
items.supportsEn: The manager reserves identity, snapshots descriptor and policy, prepares the seed, materializes the child, and returns childId/messageId only at inbox acceptance; earlier failure rolls back completely.

items.title: Inbox acceptance 提交点测试
items.supports: 测试证明 startContinuable 返回的 messageId 就是已接受 inbox 消息；acceptance 已记录为 splice，但此时尚未 claim 成 user/message，模型请求也尚未发出。
items.titleEn: Inbox-acceptance commit-point test
items.supportsEn: The test proves startContinuable returns the accepted inbox message ID after its splice is recorded but before it is claimed into a user/message event or any model request is sent.

items.title: Inbox splice 先于 live 更新耐久提交
items.supports: Inbox splice 先 append durable agent/inbox/spliced，成功后才更新 live inbox 并发布 inserted 通知。
items.titleEn: Durable Inbox splice precedes live updates
items.supportsEn: Inbox splice first appends durable agent/inbox/spliced, then updates the live inbox and publishes inserted notifications only after append succeeds.

items.title: In-process spawn provider
items.supports: Spawn 支持全部四项能力、不会 seed 父对话，同时实现 one-shot start 与 fresh continuable preparation。
items.titleEn: In-process spawn provider
items.supportsEn: Spawn supports all four capabilities, does not seed parent history, and implements both one-shot start and fresh continuable preparation.

items.title: In-process fork provider 与 continuable 注释
items.supports: Fork 只复制到最后 turn/end 的平衡前缀、支持全部四项能力并实现 prepareContinuable；源码注释同时称没有 shipped continuable caller。
items.titleEn: In-process fork provider and continuable note
items.supportsEn: Fork copies only the balanced prefix through the last turn/end, supports all four capabilities, and implements prepareContinuable while its source comment says no shipped caller uses it.

items.title: ACP 外部 provider 边界
items.supports: ACP child 在外部进程启动、声明零 start capability、无父对话，并使用配置的 cwd override 或父 Session cwd 运行 one-shot。
items.titleEn: ACP external-provider boundary
items.supportsEn: An ACP child starts out of process, advertises zero start capabilities and no parent history, and runs one-shot with either a configured cwd override or the parent Session cwd.

items.title: 独立 SDK runtime provider
items.supports: SDK provider 启动自带 composition/model/tools 的完整外部 runtime，声明零父级可强制能力且不继承父对话。
items.titleEn: Independent SDK-runtime provider
items.supportsEn: The SDK provider starts a complete external runtime with its own composition, model, and tools, advertises no parent-enforced capabilities, and inherits no parent conversation.

items.title: 固定 Codex one-shot provider
items.supports: Codex provider 固定名称、零 start capability、无父对话；它要求父 Session cwd 并通过 subprocess service 启动每个 run。
items.titleEn: Fixed Codex one-shot provider
items.supportsEn: The Codex provider has a fixed name, zero start capabilities, and no parent history; it requires the parent Session cwd and starts each run through the subprocess service.

items.title: 固定 Claude Code one-shot provider
items.supports: Claude Code provider 声明零能力、无父对话，解析 CLI executable，并在父 workspace 中通过共享 subprocess owner 执行 one-shot run。
items.titleEn: Fixed Claude Code one-shot provider
items.supportsEn: The Claude Code provider advertises zero capabilities and no parent history, resolves the CLI executable, and runs a one-shot child in the parent workspace under the shared subprocess owner.

items.title: Standard preset 的完整 delegation 配置
items.supports: Standard preset 挂载控制/列表工具，把 spawn 与 fork 都配成 continuable，并将 Codex/Claude Code 工具行设为 disabled；文件中未装载对应外部 provider。
items.titleEn: Complete delegation configuration in the Standard preset
items.supportsEn: The Standard preset mounts control/list tools, configures both spawn and fork as continuable, keeps Codex/Claude Code tool rows disabled, and does not load their external providers.

items.title: Fork 排除 open Turn 的集成测试
items.supports: 测试让父级第二 Turn 悬挂并在期间 fork，验证 child 只 seed 第一个完整 Turn 且自己的 Turn 正常完成。
items.titleEn: Fork exclusion of the open Turn test
items.supportsEn: The test hangs the parent's second Turn, forks during it, and proves the child seeds only the first complete Turn before completing its own.

items.title: Child 加入父级 exact preset generation
items.supports: composeFrom 绑定父级已存在的 standing composition，同享相同 plugin instance、工具与 prompt section，不重新读取 preset roster。
items.titleEn: Child joins the parent's exact preset generation
items.supportsEn: composeFrom binds to the parent's existing standing composition, sharing the same plugin instances, tools, and prompt sections without rereading the preset roster.

items.title: Child options 与 durable lineage
items.supports: Child 默认继承 provider/model/maxTokens；持久 header 记录 cwd、parentSession、origin、delegationDepth，存在 seed 时记录非零 seedLength，并记录父级当前 live composed preset 的 ID。
items.titleEn: Child options and durable lineage
items.supportsEn: Children default to parent provider/model/maxTokens; the durable header records cwd, parentSession, origin, delegationDepth, a nonzero seedLength when present, and the ID of the parent's current live composed preset.

items.title: Child-scoped composition
items.supports: 每个 in-process child 先加入父 preset，再注入固定 delegation context，并在 child scope 叠加 persona 与工具限制。
items.titleEn: Child-scoped composition
items.supportsEn: Each in-process child first joins the parent preset, then receives fixed delegation context plus child-scoped persona and tool restrictions.

items.title: 委派策略的捕获与持久化
items.supports: 对应 service 存在时，委派捕获父 Session 显式 sandbox override，并把 approval 钉为 never；只有已定义的 override 才写入 child log。
items.titleEn: Delegated-policy capture and persistence
items.supportsEn: When the corresponding service exists, delegation captures the parent's explicit Session sandbox override and pins approval to never; only defined overrides are appended to the child log.

items.title: 委派工具配置与默认深度
items.supports: 工具实例配置 provider、toolName、backgroundMode、Agent options、persona/filter 与 maxDepth；loader 默认深度为 3，并允许 provider-managed。
items.titleEn: Delegation-tool configuration and default depth
items.supportsEn: A tool instance configures provider, toolName, backgroundMode, Agent options, persona/filter, and maxDepth; the loader defaults depth to 3 and permits provider-managed.

items.title: 单调 delegation depth
items.supports: 有效 depth 是持久 header 与 runtime option 的较大值；cap 必须是非负安全整数，防止恢复 child 将自己降回顶层。
items.titleEn: Monotonic delegation depth
items.supportsEn: Effective depth is the maximum of the durable header and runtime option; caps must be nonnegative safe integers so a resumed child cannot lower itself to top-level.

items.title: send_message 与 interrupt_agent
items.supports: send_message 以 exact caller Agent 作为 direct-parent authority 并只返回 messageId；interrupt_agent 以 exact ancestor authority 请求取消且立即返回。
items.titleEn: send_message and interrupt_agent
items.supportsEn: send_message uses the exact calling Agent as direct-parent authority and returns only messageId; interrupt_agent requests cancellation under exact-ancestor authority and returns immediately.

items.title: Provider dispatch 前的验证边界
items.supports: Service 在 provider.start 前验证 provider 存在、能力、深度、schema 与 descriptor；startup reject 不发布 lifecycle，continuable capability 由 prepareContinuable 方法存在性决定。
items.titleEn: Validation boundary before provider dispatch
items.supportsEn: Before provider.start, the service validates provider presence, capabilities, depth, schema, and descriptor; startup rejection publishes no lifecycle, and prepareContinuable method presence is the continuation capability.

items.title: In-process one-shot driver
items.supports: Driver 在未发布 setup 中应用 policy/composition 并安装 descriptor append hook；descriptor event 在发布后首个进入的 pre-step 追加，随后只提交一个 prompt、等待 idle，并以幂等 dispose 释放 handle。
items.titleEn: In-process one-shot driver
items.supportsEn: During unpublished setup, the driver applies policy and composition and installs the descriptor-append hook; the event appends at the first entered pre-step after publication, followed by one prompt, idle wait, and idempotent handle disposal.

items.title: One-shot result 的 suffix 与 stop reason
items.supports: 结果只读 child-owned suffix，保留最后输出并从实际 Turn end 映射 stop reason；请求 schema 但 completed 时无 capture 会改判 error。
items.titleEn: One-shot result suffix and stop reason
items.supportsEn: Results read only the child-owned suffix, preserve final output, and map the actual Turn end; a completed schema request without a capture is reclassified as error.

items.title: One-shot background Job settlement
items.supports: Completed 才输出 final text，aborted 映射 killed，其余 reason 映射 failed；无论结果如何都会 dispose，双重失败保留两项 detail。
items.titleEn: One-shot background Job settlement
items.supportsEn: Only completed emits final text, aborted maps to killed, and other reasons map to failed; disposal always runs and preserves both details when result and cleanup fail.

items.title: Canonical child assistant output
items.supports: 统一规则选择最后一条非空 assistant message，否则使用累计 text delta；选择与 stop reason 无关。
items.titleEn: Canonical child assistant output
items.supportsEn: The canonical rule selects the last non-empty assistant message, otherwise accumulated text deltas, independently of stop reason.

items.title: Child structured output 的两阶段提交
items.supports: Child scope 安装 schema tool、prompt 与 guard；值先 staged，只有 authoritative tool result（以及 Code Mode 外层结果）成功后才提交。
items.titleEn: Two-phase commit for child structured output
items.supportsEn: The child scope installs a schema tool, prompt, and guard; values stage first and commit only after the authoritative tool result and any Code Mode outer result succeed.

items.title: Continuable Activation 数据模型
items.supports: Activation 状态由 Agent quiescence 与 owned children 推导；每个 epoch 持有 exact handle、ancestry、accepted IDs、所有权集合与 memoized disposal。
items.titleEn: Continuable Activation data model
items.supportsEn: Activation state derives from Agent quiescence and owned children; each epoch holds the exact handle, ancestry, accepted IDs, ownership set, and memoized disposal.

items.title: Parent ownership 与 acceptance gap
items.supports: Continuation-managed parent 在 child 运行前 acquire ownership；accepted IDs 在同步 inbox send 前登记，阻止父/child 在 admission 微任务窗口提前 settle。
items.titleEn: Parent ownership and the acceptance gap
items.supportsEn: A continuation-managed parent acquires ownership before the child runs, and accepted IDs register before synchronous inbox send so neither parent nor child settles during the admission microtask gap.

items.title: One-shot 与 Activation epoch lifecycle
items.supports: Listener failure 被逐个隔离；one-shot run 与每个 continuable residency epoch 都生成配对 start/end，cold resume 使用新的 runId 并只统计 epoch suffix。
items.titleEn: One-shot and Activation-epoch lifecycle
items.supportsEn: Listener failures are individually contained; one-shot runs and each continuable residency epoch emit paired start/end edges, with a new runId and epoch-only suffix on cold resume.

items.title: Continuable follow-up 路由
items.supports: 同一 child 的消息通过锁线性化：resident 时 enqueue/wake，absent 时 cold resume；caller signal 只作用到 inbox acceptance。
items.titleEn: Continuable follow-up routing
items.supportsEn: Per-child locking linearizes messages: resident children enqueue or wake, absent children cold-resume, and the caller signal owns work only until inbox acceptance.

items.title: Provider-independent cold resume
items.supports: Cold resume inspect 持久 Session、先验证 exact direct parent、只 fold child suffix descriptor，再直接 materialize/resume；不调用原 provider。
items.titleEn: Provider-independent cold resume
items.supportsEn: Cold resume inspects persistence, first authorizes the exact direct parent, folds only the child-suffix descriptor, and materializes/resumes directly without invoking the original provider.

items.title: Versioned durable subagent descriptor
items.supports: Model-hidden v2 descriptor 区分 one-shot/continuable；continuable 保存恢复 composition，但有意省略 subagentDepth、outputSchema 与 maxTokens。
items.titleEn: Versioned durable subagent descriptor
items.supportsEn: The model-hidden v2 descriptor distinguishes one-shot and continuable children and stores resumable composition while deliberately omitting subagentDepth, outputSchema, and maxTokens.

items.title: Continuable child-scoped report 工具
items.supports: Report tool/prompt 只安装到 continuable in-process child scope；只发送 selected content 给 direct parent，不结束 Turn，并有事务化注册/清理。
items.titleEn: Continuable child-scoped report tool
items.supportsEn: The report tool and prompt install only in continuable in-process child scopes, send selected content only to the direct parent without ending the Turn, and register/clean up transactionally.

items.title: Report authority 与 parent scheduling
items.supports: 只有 exact resident child 可报告；recipient 从 durable direct parent 解析，wakeup 用 followup、quiet 用 inject，报告本身不改变 Activation lifetime。
items.titleEn: Report authority and parent scheduling
items.supportsEn: Only the exact resident child may report; the recipient resolves from durable direct-parent lineage, wakeup uses followup, quiet uses inject, and reporting does not change Activation lifetime.

items.title: Continuable settlement notice
items.supports: 每个已公布 ID 的 child 都尝试独立于 report 投递 stop summary 与 closing output；parent 不 live 时静默跳过，投递失败时记录并丢弃，均不阻塞 teardown。
items.titleEn: Continuable settlement notice
items.supportsEn: Every child whose ID was announced attempts to send a stop summary and closing output independently of report; an absent parent is silently skipped, while delivery failure is logged and dropped without blocking teardown.

items.title: Durable child/descendant enumeration
items.supports: Listing 合并 live 与 persistence corpus，通过 projection 分类，并把单 child read/fold damage 降级成 diagnostic，而不读取 Activation/provider state。
items.titleEn: Durable child and descendant enumeration
items.supportsEn: Listing merges live and persistent corpora, classifies through projections, and degrades per-child read/fold damage to diagnostics without consulting Activation/provider state.

items.title: Listing 冷读并发上限
items.supports: 本地持久化的 read-only cold inspection 以常量 4 限制并发。
items.titleEn: Listing cold-read concurrency limit
items.supportsEn: Read-only cold inspection of local persistence is bounded by the constant four.

items.title: list_agents 状态与过滤
items.supports: 模型状态 running/idle/ready 来自 live registry；ready 表示 storage-only resumable，one-shot 被过滤，descendant depth 限定 follow-up/interrupt 选择。
items.titleEn: list_agents states and filtering
items.supportsEn: Model statuses running/idle/ready derive from the live registry; ready means storage-only resumable, one-shot rows are filtered, and descendant depth constrains follow-up versus interrupt.

items.title: 委派工具的并发安全与并行提示
items.supports: 工具声明 concurrency-safe，因为 children 不改父 Session；continuable prompt 鼓励同一 assistant message 启动独立委派。
items.titleEn: Delegation-tool concurrency safety and parallel guidance
items.supportsEn: The tool declares concurrency safety because children do not mutate the parent Session, and continuable guidance encourages independent starts in one assistant message.

items.title: Per-child linearization lock
items.supports: ChildLock 按 durable child ID 串行 operation，并吸收一个 critical section 的 rejection，避免污染后续调用。
items.titleEn: Per-child linearization lock
items.supportsEn: ChildLock serializes operations by durable child ID and absorbs one critical section's rejection so later callers remain independent.

items.title: Current-Turn interrupt 语义
items.supports: 对 live target，Interrupt 在 exact parent/ancestor 授权后执行 keepInbox cancel 并立即返回；Activation、未认领消息与 descendants 保留。Absent target 是 no-op，lookup 前只检查 ancestor caller liveness。
items.titleEn: Current-Turn interrupt semantics
items.supportsEn: For a live target, interrupt authorizes the exact parent or ancestor, requests keepInbox cancellation, and returns immediately while preserving the Activation, unclaimed messages, and descendants. An absent target is a no-op; only ancestor-caller liveness is checked before lookup.

items.title: 后台 Job 的 owner capacity
items.supports: Job start 按 owner 统计 active task，并在达到已配置的 per-owner 上限时拒绝新 Job。
items.titleEn: Per-owner background Job capacity
items.supportsEn: Job start counts active tasks by owner and rejects a new Job when the configured per-owner limit has been reached.

items.title: 外部 run 的失败归一化与幂等 teardown
items.supports: 发布后 attempt rejection 被归一化为 aborted/error result 并保留 partial output；Subprocess run handle 的 dispose memoize teardown 并等待实际退出。
items.titleEn: External-run failure normalization and idempotent teardown
items.supportsEn: Post-publication attempt rejection normalizes to aborted/error with partial output, and the subprocess run handle memoizes teardown and awaits actual exit.

items.title: Manager 与 scoped forest drain
items.supports: Drain 在首个 await 前封 admission，等待 materialization 边界，按 roots 销毁 forest；scoped drain 同步打开全部取消事务并在所有分支后聚合失败。
items.titleEn: Manager and scoped-forest drain
items.supportsEn: Drain closes admission before its first await, waits for materialization boundaries, disposes the forest by roots, and scoped drain opens every cancellation transaction synchronously before aggregating failures.

items.title: Activation top-down cancel 与 child-first release
items.supports: Disposal 先安装 admission cutoff，再同步 top-down cancel、并行 child disposal、等待 idle/flush，最后 child-first 释放 handle、通知 parent 并 release ownership。
items.titleEn: Activation top-down cancellation and child-first release
items.supportsEn: Disposal installs the admission cutoff, synchronously cancels top-down, disposes children, awaits idle/flush, then releases handles child-first, notifies the parent, and releases ownership.

items.title: Continuable descriptor 的 between-Turn seed
items.supports: Continuable child 的 creation seed 由可选继承前缀和一个 model-hidden between-Turn descriptor 组成，并通过 Session 接受规则分配 seq。
items.titleEn: Between-Turn continuable-descriptor seed
items.supportsEn: A continuable child's creation seed contains an optional inherited prefix followed by one model-hidden between-Turn descriptor accepted through Session sequencing rules.

items.title: Descriptor 的 strict parse、snapshot 与 fold
items.supports: 当前版本 descriptor 严格验证字段，创建前做 lossless JSON snapshot；在给定 event slice 中第一个 descriptor 是 authoritative。
items.titleEn: Strict descriptor parse, snapshot, and fold
items.supportsEn: Current-version descriptors strictly validate fields and are lossless-JSON snapshotted before creation; within a supplied event slice the first descriptor is authoritative.

items.title: Fork seed 中 descriptor 的 last-wins projection
items.supports: Identity projection 对 descriptor last-wins，让 child 自己的 descriptor 覆盖 seed 中祖先身份；坏或未知版本重置为 null。
items.titleEn: Last-wins projection for descriptors in fork seeds
items.supportsEn: The identity projection is last-wins so the child's descriptor overrides ancestor identity in its seed; malformed or unknown versions reset to null.

items.title: Best-effort final flush 与 persistence requirement
items.supports: Activation quiescent 后请求 final Session flush；失败只记录恢复可能 stale 的 warning，不阻止释放；新 continuable start 要求 persistence service。
items.titleEn: Best-effort final flush and persistence requirement
items.supportsEn: After Activation quiescence the runtime requests a final Session flush; failure only warns that resume may be stale and does not block release, while new continuable starts require persistence.

items.title: Codex app-server one-shot run lifecycle
items.supports: 每个 run 固定 spawn app-server，在 initialize 与 ephemeral thread 成功后才发布，随后运行一个 text-only Turn；dispose 关闭协议并回收进程树。
items.titleEn: Codex app-server one-shot run lifecycle
items.supportsEn: Each run spawns a fixed app-server and publishes only after initialize and ephemeral-thread success, then runs one text-only Turn; disposal closes the protocol and reclaims the process tree.

items.title: Codex handshake、ephemeral thread 与结果选择
items.supports: Wire 执行 initialize/initialized，强制 ephemeral thread，提交一个 Turn，将 contextWindowExceeded 映射 max-tokens，并选择 last final 或 unphased answer。
items.titleEn: Codex handshake, ephemeral thread, and result selection
items.supportsEn: The wire performs initialize/initialized, requires an ephemeral thread, submits one Turn, maps contextWindowExceeded to max-tokens, and selects the last final or unphased answer.

items.title: Codex 无人值守请求与 notification 过滤
items.supports: Approval 只 cancel/decline，permission/user-input 为空，MCP elicitation 拒绝；notification 绑定 exact thread/Turn，忽略 commentary 并保留最后 final answer。
items.titleEn: Codex unattended requests and notification filtering
items.supportsEn: Approvals only cancel/decline, permission and user-input responses are empty, MCP elicitation is declined, and notifications bind the exact thread/Turn while excluding commentary and retaining the last final answer.

items.title: Codex wire 协议选择测试
items.supports: 测试验证 fixed handshake、ephemeral thread、text input、跨 thread/Turn 过滤、reasoning/commentary 排除和 last-final selection。
items.titleEn: Codex wire protocol-selection test
items.supportsEn: The test verifies the fixed handshake, ephemeral thread, text input, cross-thread/Turn filtering, reasoning/commentary exclusion, and last-final selection.

items.title: Subagent registry 与 lifecycle invariants
items.supports: Invariant companion 检查 provider add/remove、没有重复的 live runId、start/end pairing，以及 provider、child id 与 local 标志一致。
items.titleEn: Subagent registry and lifecycle invariants
items.supportsEn: The invariant companion checks provider add/remove consistency, no duplicate live run IDs, start/end pairing, and matching provider, child ID, and local flag.

items.title: Code preset 的 continuable fork 与禁用外部工具
items.supports: Code preset 把 spawn/fork 都配置为 continuable，并保留 disabled 的 Codex/Claude Code 工具行。
items.titleEn: Continuable fork and disabled external tools in the Code preset
items.supportsEn: The Code preset configures both spawn and fork as continuable and retains disabled Codex/Claude Code tool rows.

items.title: Cordis preset 的 continuable fork
items.supports: Cordis preset 把 spawn 与 fork 工具都设为 continuable，并将外部产品工具保持 disabled。
items.titleEn: Continuable fork in the Cordis preset
items.supportsEn: The Cordis preset configures both spawn and fork tools as continuable and keeps external-product tools disabled.

items.title: Agent prepared-call 与 request-error 边界
items.supports: Agent 在 buildRequest 先 prepareCall；非 NO_ADAPTER 解析错误在 stream 前抛出并直接关闭 Turn，只有 terminal failure chunk 才分派 agent/request-error。
items.titleEn: Agent prepared-call and request-error boundary
items.supportsEn: The Agent prepares in buildRequest; non-NO_ADAPTER resolution errors throw before streaming and close the Turn directly, while only a terminal failure chunk dispatches agent/request-error.

items.title: 最终 adapter 失败边界
items.supports: 未 prepared 的直接 stream 路径在最终边界内完成选择、解析、dispatch 与迭代；prepared 路径的 dispatch/迭代也由该边界转为 terminal finish，middleware/consumer/cleanup 错误保持抛出。
items.titleEn: Final adapter failure boundary
items.supportsEn: The direct unprepared stream path selects, resolves, dispatches, and iterates inside the final boundary; prepared dispatch/iteration also becomes terminal finish, while middleware, consumer, and cleanup errors remain thrown.

items.title: 可序列化且冻结的 failure snapshot
items.supports: 仅当 Error 的自有 data descriptor failure/code 匹配时才信任携带快照；内部字段在 try 中读取并校验但不要求为自有属性，快照复制并冻结。
items.titleEn: Serializable frozen failure snapshot
items.supportsEn: A carried snapshot is trusted only when the Error's own data descriptors for failure/code match; inner fields are read and validated inside a try but need not be own properties, and the copied snapshot is frozen.

items.title: DeepSeek HTTP 错误、Retry-After 与 request id
items.supports: 解析秒数或 HTTP-date Retry-After、两个 request-id header，并把非 2xx status/body 映射为稳定 failure code 与事实。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek HTTP errors, Retry-After, and request id
items.supportsEn: Parses seconds or HTTP-date Retry-After, two request-id headers, and maps non-2xx status/body into stable failure codes and facts.

items.title: 每请求配置快照、idle watchdog 与 transport 清理
items.supports: 一次 stream 固定连接与凭据；区分 TIMEOUT、ABORTED、TRANSPORT，并在 finally abort consumer、等待未耗尽 iterator.return。
items.titleEn: Per-request snapshot, idle watchdog, and transport cleanup
items.supportsEn: One stream freezes connection and credential facts, distinguishes TIMEOUT, ABORTED, and TRANSPORT, then aborts the consumer and awaits an unexhausted iterator.return in finally.

items.title: 同一 Step 内的模型请求恢复循环
items.supports: 每次 attempt 重建 request/assembler；只有 terminal error/aborted finish 进入 request-error，retry action 继续同一 Step，成功后才提交 assistant message 与工具。
items.titleEn: Model-request recovery loop inside one Step
items.supportsEn: Each attempt rebuilds request and assembler; only terminal error/aborted finish enters request-error, a retry action continues the same Step, and only success commits the assistant message and tools.

items.title: Request-error 窄接缝与取消优先测试
items.supports: 证明 middleware 失败不进入恢复、连续失败维持 Turn 1/Step 1、取消胜过 retry action、恢复 listener 失败关闭 Turn。
items.titleEn: Request-error narrow seam and cancellation precedence tests
items.supportsEn: Proves middleware failures bypass recovery, repeated failures stay in Turn 1/Step 1, cancellation beats a retry action, and recovery-listener failure closes the Turn.

items.title: Provider-owned retry policy 默认值与验证
items.supports: 定义 normal/always、默认次数/延迟/jitter/错误码，拒绝未知键、越界、空与重复 code，并返回冻结 policy。
items.titleEn: Provider-owned retry policy defaults and validation
items.supportsEn: Defines normal/always modes and default counts, delays, jitter, and codes; rejects unknown keys, invalid bounds, empty or duplicate codes; returns a frozen policy.

items.title: Retry 执行、持久化计划与 disposal drain
items.supports: 按坐标/policyKey 计数，先写 retry 计划再等待，处理 provider delay 上限与 always 下游组合，并在 disposal 终止且 drain active recovery。
items.titleEn: Retry execution, durable scheduling, and disposal drain
items.supportsEn: Counts by coordinates and policyKey, records retry before waiting, handles provider-delay caps and always-mode downstream composition, and cancels then drains active recovery on disposal.

items.title: Retry 调度、partial chunk 隔离与预算测试
items.supports: 验证 retry 事件先落、同一 Step 成功、EMPTY_RESPONSE、失败 partial chunks 不形成 message/tool side effect，以及有界指数退避耗尽。
items.titleEn: Retry scheduling, partial-chunk isolation, and budget tests
items.supportsEn: Verifies retry is recorded first, same-Step success, EMPTY_RESPONSE recovery, failed partial chunks do not become a message or tool side effect, and bounded exponential exhaustion.

items.title: 真实 DeepSeek HTTP/SSE transport 恢复测试
items.supports: 覆盖 refused connection、stream/partial disconnect、empty response、clean partial EOF 与 stalled body，固定同 request body、同 Step 与默认 retry 分类。
items.titleEn: Real DeepSeek HTTP/SSE transport recovery tests
items.supportsEn: Covers refused connection, stream/partial disconnect, empty response, clean partial EOF, and stalled body while pinning identical request bodies, same-Step behavior, and default retry classification.

items.title: Retry README 的新 Turn 描述漂移
items.supports: README 声称每次 retry 关闭失败 Turn 并打开新编号 Turn，与当前 Step 内循环和测试冲突。
items.titleEn: Retry README drift about fresh Turns
items.supportsEn: The README says every retry closes the failed Turn and opens a freshly numbered Turn, conflicting with the current Step-local loop and tests.

items.title: 协作式工具 timeout policy
items.supports: 只包装声明 timeoutMs 的工具，临时替换 signal，等待下游收敛，仅在本层 timer 获胜时返回 TOOL_TIMEOUT，且不 abandon Promise。
items.titleEn: Cooperative tool timeout policy
items.supportsEn: Wraps only tools declaring timeoutMs, temporarily swaps the signal, awaits downstream convergence, returns TOOL_TIMEOUT only when its own timer wins, and never abandons the Promise.

items.title: Deadline 与 idle watchdog 的信号合同
items.supports: Signal 只通知、调用方必须停止；first abort reason 获胜，code-scoped timeoutOf 区分外层取消，watchdog 仅在 outstanding demand 时计时。
items.titleEn: Signal contract for deadlines and idle watchdogs
items.supportsEn: Signals only notify and callers must stop; the first abort reason wins, code-scoped timeoutOf separates outer cancellation, and the watchdog times only an outstanding demand.

items.title: 工具 timeout 与 caller abort 竞态测试
items.supports: 覆盖合作返回、abort throw、caller-first 与 timeout-first，并证明 timeout 仍等待工具清理 gate 后才完成。
items.titleEn: Tool-timeout and caller-abort race tests
items.supportsEn: Covers cooperative return, abort throw, caller-first, and timeout-first behavior, proving timeout still waits for the tool cleanup gate before completion.

items.title: 并行工具 abort 与 scheduler failure drain
items.supports: Abort 停止新 dispatch、等待并按序提交 started calls，再为 skipped calls 合成结果；scheduler failure allSettled 已在途工作。
items.titleEn: Parallel-tool abort and scheduler-failure drain
items.supportsEn: Abort stops new dispatches, waits and commits started calls in order, then synthesizes skipped-call results; scheduler failure allSettles in-flight work.

items.title: Assistant message 后取消的 replay 完整性测试
items.supports: 取消使工具 body 零执行，但记录匹配 call 与 TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH result，后续请求能回放有效 tool pair。
