items.titleEn: Replay-integrity test for cancellation after assistant message
items.supportsEn: Cancellation keeps tool-body execution at zero but records a matching call and TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH result that a later request can replay.

items.title: Agent cancel、wake latch 与 Turn containment
items.supports: 定义默认清 Inbox/abort、post-abort waking input 重分类与 latch、whenIdle 替换活动跟随、turn/end 平衡和下一 Turn 新 AbortController。
items.titleEn: Agent cancel, wake latch, and Turn containment
items.supportsEn: Defines default Inbox clearing and abort, post-abort waking-input reclassification and latching, replacement-activity tracking in whenIdle, balanced turn/end, and a fresh AbortController for the next Turn.

items.title: Abort-to-idle latch 与 queued-tail 取消测试
items.supports: 验证 latch replay/clear/removal/慢收敛/disposal 边界，并固定 mid-step 默认取消丢弃所有 queued tail。
items.titleEn: Abort-to-idle latch and queued-tail cancellation tests
items.supportsEn: Verifies latch replay, clearing, removal, slow convergence, and disposal boundaries, and pins default mid-Step cancellation dropping the entire queued tail.

items.title: Memoized Agent 生命周期 disposal
items.supports: 融合 caller/owner/factory 取消；共享 disposer 依次 cancel(disposed)、whenIdle、scope.dispose，最后 detach registries 与 ownership。
items.titleEn: Memoized Agent lifecycle disposal
items.supportsEn: Fuses caller, owner, and factory cancellation; the shared disposer performs cancel(disposed), whenIdle, scope.dispose, then registry and ownership detachment.

items.title: Agent teardown 顺序、共享静止点与 ID 复用测试
items.supports: 证明 turn/end 先于 unregister、并发 disposal 等待同一边界、scope cleanup 完成前 ID 不可复用。
items.titleEn: Agent teardown order, shared quiescence, and ID-reuse tests
items.supportsEn: Proves turn/end precedes unregistration, concurrent disposal waits for the same boundary, and an ID cannot be reused before scope cleanup completes.

items.title: Per-session write-behind 与 flush barrier
items.supports: Enqueue clone event；flush 共享 barrier 并 drain 到静止；失败 batch 原序放回队首且自动路径暂停，显式 barrier reject。
items.titleEn: Per-session write-behind and flush barrier
items.supportsEn: Enqueue clones events; flush shares a barrier and drains to quiescence; failed batches return to the head in order, automatic work pauses, and explicit barriers reject.

items.title: Persistence admission、最终 drain 与 retirement 顺序
items.supports: 逆序 teardown 先关闭 event admission，再 flush/等待 chains/close backend；session retirement 先 flush 后释放精确 lifecycle state。
items.titleEn: Persistence admission, final drain, and retirement order
items.supportsEn: Reverse teardown closes event admission before flush, chain draining, and backend close; session retirement flushes before releasing exact-lifecycle state.

items.title: Agent request 前缀与 stream 调用顺序
items.supports: Agent 记录 turn/start，claim Inbox 输入，再记录 step/start 与输入消息；构造 request 后才进入 stream，并把返回 chunk 继续记入会话。
items.titleEn: Agent request-prefix and stream ordering
items.supportsEn: The Agent records turn/start, claims Inbox input, then records step/start and input messages before building the request and entering the stream; returned chunks continue into the log.

items.title: Request header/context 在 stream 前记录
items.supports: buildRequest 在返回带 sessionId 的冻结请求前追加 request/header 与必要的 request/context。
items.titleEn: Request header/context logged before streaming
items.supportsEn: buildRequest appends request/header and any required request/context before returning the frozen request carrying sessionId.

items.title: Tool intent 在 scheduler dispatch 前记录
items.supports: 每个已启动调用先 append tool/call，再 prepare 并进入 scheduler dispatch。
items.titleEn: Tool intent logged before scheduler dispatch
items.supportsEn: Each started call appends tool/call before preparation and scheduler dispatch.

items.title: Scheduler dispatch 经过 tools/execute waterfall
items.supports: scheduled dispatch 先进入 tools/execute waterfall，其最终 next 才调用 tool body。
items.titleEn: Scheduler dispatch traverses the tools/execute waterfall
items.supportsEn: Scheduled dispatch enters the tools/execute waterfall, whose final next invokes the tool body.

items.title: 模型与工具副作用前的 semantic checkpoint
items.supports: 有 live session 时在 downstream model stream 前 flush；顶层 tool body 前 flush，pre-step 也 flush；失败 fail-closed，checkpoint 中取消返回未 dispatch 结果。
items.titleEn: Semantic checkpoints before model and tool side effects
items.supportsEn: With a live session, flushes before the downstream model stream, before a top-level tool body, and during pre-step; failures are fail-closed and cancellation during checkpoint returns not-dispatched.

items.title: Checkpoint 顺序、拒绝与取消测试
items.supports: 验证 adapter/tool dispatch 在 flush 后，checkpoint reject 阻止副作用，取消生成 canonical 未 dispatch 结果，nested tool 复用 outer checkpoint。
items.titleEn: Checkpoint ordering, rejection, and cancellation tests
items.supportsEn: Verifies adapter/tool dispatch follows flush, checkpoint rejection blocks side effects, cancellation produces the canonical not-dispatched result, and nested tools reuse the outer checkpoint.

items.title: 模型 dispatch 与工具副作用 failpoint
items.supports: 子进程在 adapter 收到请求或工具写出外部副作用 marker 后永久等待，为父进程 SIGKILL 提供精确边界。
items.titleEn: Model-dispatch and tool-side-effect failpoints
items.supportsEn: The child waits forever after the adapter receives a request or the tool writes its external-effect marker, giving the parent precise SIGKILL boundaries.

items.title: SIGKILL 模型与工具边界恢复 E2E
items.supports: 自定义硬杀子进程，证明模型 dispatch 前完整请求 durable，以及工具副作用前 call durable、缺结果恢复为 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN。
items.titleEn: SIGKILL recovery E2E at model and tool boundaries
items.supportsEn: Hard-kills a child process to prove the complete request is durable before model dispatch and the call is durable before a tool side effect, with a missing result repaired as TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

items.title: 原始 JSONL 完整记录 scanner
items.supports: 仅提交换行结束、可解码且 sequence 连续的事件记录；未结束 fragment 不进入 committedBytes。
items.titleEn: Complete-record raw JSONL scanner
items.supportsEn: Commits only newline-terminated, decodable event records with contiguous sequence numbers; an unfinished fragment does not advance committedBytes.

items.title: 完整 Zstd frame scanner
items.supports: 逐帧校验 header/block/checksum 边界，只返回完整 frame，并把 EOF 中断的最后一帧起点标为 tornStart。
items.titleEn: Complete Zstd frame scanner
items.supportsEn: Validates frame header, block, and checksum boundaries, returns only complete frames, and marks the start of an EOF-interrupted final frame as tornStart.

items.title: JSONL/Zstd 稳定前缀与 torn-tail repair marker
items.supports: Loader 使用 scanner 的 committed/torn 边界构造稳定事件前缀与 truncation/recovered-events marker，并通过 commitRepair 落修复。
items.titleEn: Stable JSONL/Zstd prefix and torn-tail repair marker
items.supportsEn: The loader uses scanner committed/torn boundaries to construct a stable event prefix and truncation/recovered-events marker, then persists repair through commitRepair.

items.title: JSONL materialize、append rollback 与 fsync
items.supports: 首次写用 synced temp 与不覆盖 publish；POSIX 通过 link 发布并 fsync 父目录；append write/sync 失败截回旧长度并 fsync，repair truncate 也 fsync。
items.titleEn: JSONL materialization, append rollback, and fsync
items.supportsEn: Initial write uses a synced temp and non-overwriting publish; POSIX links and fsyncs the parent directory; append write/sync failure truncates and fsyncs the old length, and repair truncation is fsynced too.

items.title: Windows write-through durable publish
items.supports: Windows 用未设置 replace 或跨卷 copy fallback flag 的 MoveFileExW MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH 把 staging path 发布到 final path。
items.titleEn: Windows write-through durable publish
items.supportsEn: Windows publishes the staging path to the final path with MoveFileExW MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH and without replacement or cross-volume copy-fallback flags.

items.title: JSONL torn tail、append-only 与 fsync rollback 测试
items.supports: 覆盖 torn partial line、开放事件保留和 closer、已提交前缀字节不变、fsync 失败回滚后无 seq gap 重试。
items.titleEn: JSONL torn-tail, append-only, and fsync-rollback tests
items.supportsEn: Covers a torn partial line, open-event preservation and closers, byte-stable committed prefixes, and retry without a sequence gap after fsync rollback.

items.title: Interrupted Turn 的确定性语义修复
items.supports: 区分 TOOL_NOT_STARTED 与 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN，先补 dangling tool result 再关闭 Step/Turn，并在恢复文本中要求副作用风险核验。
items.titleEn: Deterministic semantic repair of an interrupted Turn
items.supportsEn: Distinguishes TOOL_NOT_STARTED from TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, closes dangling tool results before Step/Turn, and instructs side-effect risk verification in recovery text.

items.title: Backend-agnostic crash-repair shared contract
items.supports: 固定 interrupted Turn 保留与关闭、未开始工具的可重试 result、已记录工具的 unknown-outcome 风险提示和可回放 transcript。
items.titleEn: Backend-agnostic crash-repair shared contract
items.supportsEn: Pins interrupted-Turn preservation and closure, a retryable result for an unstarted tool, unknown-outcome guidance for a recorded tool, and a replayable transcript.

items.title: 内存 backend 实例化 shared contract
items.supports: 内存 persistence 测试套件调用 runPersistenceContract。
items.titleEn: In-memory backend instantiates the shared contract
items.supportsEn: The in-memory persistence suite invokes runPersistenceContract.

items.title: JSONL backend 实例化 shared contract
items.supports: 真实 JSONL backend 测试套件调用 runPersistenceContract。
items.titleEn: JSONL backend instantiates the shared contract
items.supportsEn: The real JSONL backend suite invokes runPersistenceContract.

items.title: SQLite backend 实例化 shared contract
items.supports: 真实 SQLite backend 测试套件调用同一个 runPersistenceContract。
items.titleEn: SQLite backend instantiates the shared contract
items.supportsEn: The real SQLite backend suite invokes the same runPersistenceContract.

items.title: DeepSeek 配置双层验证与 last-good generation
items.supports: Schema 加显式 resolver 复核 catalog/bounds/reasoning/timeout/retry；首次失败阻止注册，live invalid snapshot 完整回落 lastGood。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek two-layer validation and last-good generation
items.supportsEn: Schema plus explicit resolver revalidate catalog, bounds, reasoning, timeout, and retry; initial failure blocks registration while an invalid live snapshot falls back to the complete lastGood generation.

items.title: 每请求 credential 恢复与 retry-policy 原位替换
items.supports: 凭据从同一请求 snapshot 延迟解析，缺失抛 MISSING_CREDENTIAL；route 先注册，policy 变化用同步 replace 避免空 registry 窗口。
items.titleEn: Per-request credential recovery and in-place retry-policy replacement
items.supportsEn: Credentials resolve lazily from the same request snapshot and missing values throw MISSING_CREDENTIAL; the route registers independently and policy changes use synchronous replace to avoid an empty registry window.

items.title: DeepSeek 动态 endpoint/key/policy/last-good 测试
items.supports: 验证下一请求读取新 endpoint/key、keyless 后补 key 恢复、policy 原位更新，以及 rejected generation 不泄漏 URL/key 并可后续恢复。
items.titleEn: DeepSeek dynamic endpoint/key/policy/last-good tests
items.supportsEn: Verifies next-request endpoint/key refresh, recovery after adding a key, in-place policy update, and no URL/key leakage from a rejected generation before later recovery.

items.title: 用户 patch watcher 与 present-invalid fail-loud
items.supports: Watcher 重读完整 patch generation 并一次 entry.update；存在但不可读、不可解析或非数组的 patch 明确抛错而非静默跳过。
items.titleEn: User-patch watcher and present-invalid fail-loud behavior
items.supportsEn: The watcher rereads a complete patch generation and performs one entry.update; a present but unreadable, unparsable, or non-array patch throws rather than being skipped.

items.title: 无效配置 refresh 的 last-good 与后续恢复测试
items.supports: Parse failure 和空配置 validation failure 都保留 last-good running tree，下一次合法 edit 成功替换。
items.titleEn: Last-good and later recovery test for invalid config refresh
items.supportsEn: Both parse failure and empty-file validation failure preserve the last-good running tree, and the next valid edit replaces it successfully.

items.title: 用户 patch HMR 的失败、恢复与删除测试
items.supports: 覆盖 add、apply failure、parse failure、recovery 与 removal；失败 candidate 不替换当前 live 配置。
items.titleEn: User-patch HMR failure, recovery, and removal test
items.supportsEn: Covers add, apply failure, parse failure, recovery, and removal; failed candidates do not replace the current live configuration.

items.title: Session 事件日志契约
items.supports: 定义结构化 turn 结束原因，以及只追加、无损、连续序号的原始事件事实源与主要 payload。
items.titleEn: Session event-log contract
items.supportsEn: Defines structured turn outcomes and the append-only, lossless, contiguous raw-event source of truth with its major payloads.

items.title: 请求头快照的组装与记录
items.supports: Agent 从有效模型配置、完整 system prompt 与工具目录组装 header，并按 initial、resume、change 记录。
items.titleEn: Request-header assembly and logging
items.supportsEn: The Agent builds a header from effective model config, full system prompt, and tool catalog, then records initial, resume, or change snapshots.

items.title: Telemetry record 与 sink 契约
items.supports: 定义 ledger/ops channel、最小 attributes、完整 body、同步非阻塞 emit，以及由 backend 所有的 batching 与 loss。
items.titleEn: Telemetry record and sink contract
items.supportsEn: Defines ledger/ops channels, minimal attributes, complete bodies, synchronous non-blocking emit, and backend-owned batching and loss.

items.title: Capture 投影与复制
items.supports: 每个 turn/step 只交付第一条 chunk，其他 event.data 深拷贝后经 redaction 交给 backend。
items.titleEn: Capture projection and copying
items.supportsEn: Hands off only the first chunk per turn/step and deep-copies other event data through redaction to the backend.

items.title: 同步 redaction waterfall
items.supports: Seam 不附带规则；listener 同步组合，抛错逐条 fail-closed，只改变外发副本而不重写 canonical log。
items.titleEn: Synchronous redaction waterfall
items.supportsEn: The seam ships no rule; listeners compose synchronously, throws fail closed per record, and only the outbound copy changes.

items.title: Redaction 边界回归测试
items.supports: 覆盖无规则原样通过、ledger/ops 清洗、listener 叠加、canonical log 不变及抛错扣留。
items.titleEn: Redaction-boundary regression tests
items.supportsEn: Covers no-rule pass-through, ledger/ops scrubbing, listener composition, untouched canonical logs, and throw-to-withhold behavior.

items.title: Handoff cursor 与 adoption
items.supports: Module-scope cursor 标记 handed-off 而非 delivered；live adoption、on-demand suffix 与 firstLiveSeq 起点形成 capture-side at-most-once 高水位，但不约束 downstream retry 或端到端交付语义。
items.titleEn: Handoff cursor and adoption
items.supportsEn: The module-scope cursor marks handed-off rather than delivered; live adoption, on-demand suffixes, and firstLiveSeq form a capture-side at-most-once high-water mark without constraining downstream retries or end-to-end delivery semantics.

items.title: Capture、reload 与故障隔离测试
items.supports: 覆盖 first-chunk-only、on-demand suffix、reload cursor、中间记录拒绝、非等待 flush、shutdown ordering 与 backend 故障 containment。
items.titleEn: Capture, reload, and failure-containment tests
items.supportsEn: Covers first-chunk-only capture, on-demand suffixes, reload cursors, rejected middle records, non-awaited flush, shutdown ordering, and backend containment.

items.title: FULL、FEEDBACK_ONLY 与 DISABLED
items.supports: 默认 disabled；上传模式构建 SDK，FULL live capture；feedback-only 只在 canonical feedback 时释放 eligible suffix：有 cursor 时从其后起，无 cursor 时从 firstLiveSeq 起。
items.titleEn: FULL, FEEDBACK_ONLY, and DISABLED
items.supportsEn: Defaults to disabled; uploading modes build the SDK and FULL captures live, while feedback-only releases an eligible suffix only on canonical feedback: after the cursor when one exists, otherwise from firstLiveSeq.

items.title: OTel sharing mode 测试
items.supports: 覆盖 feedback suffix、non-canonical consent 拒绝、disabled 零 transport、mode disclosure、默认关闭与 fail-loud 配置。
items.titleEn: OTel sharing-mode tests
items.supportsEn: Covers feedback suffixes, rejection of non-canonical consent, zero disabled transport, mode disclosure, default-off behavior, and fail-loud config.

items.title: Feedback 记录与 sharing disclosure
items.supports: Feedback 是不启动模型、未同步 flush 的 log-only event；确认文本区分四种 sharing 状态。
items.titleEn: Feedback recording and sharing disclosure
items.supportsEn: Feedback is an unflushed log-only event that starts no model work, and its acknowledgement distinguishes four sharing states.

items.title: 随包 telemetry 默认配置
items.supports: Base bundle 默认 DISABLED，未挂载 redaction，并明确 endpoint、gzip、batch、queue 与 shutdown 参数。
items.titleEn: Shipped telemetry defaults
items.supportsEn: The base bundle defaults to DISABLED, mounts no redaction, and specifies endpoint, gzip, batch, queue, and shutdown settings.

items.title: 真实 Loader telemetry 组合测试
items.supports: 覆盖外发副本清洗而 canonical secret 保留、feedback-only prefix 与 disabled 本地行为。
items.titleEn: Real Loader telemetry-composition tests
items.supportsEn: Covers scrubbed outbound copies with canonical secrets retained, feedback-only prefixes, and disabled local behavior.

items.title: 最终 telemetry hard opt-out
items.supports: 在 apps/cli profile composition 中，任何非空 DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED 都在 profile、home 与 CLI overlay 后 patch 固定 row id session-telemetry-otel；其他 row id/backend 不受该 patch 约束。
items.titleEn: Final telemetry hard opt-out
items.supportsEn: Within apps/cli profile composition, any non-empty DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED value patches the fixed session-telemetry-otel row id after profile, home, and CLI overlays; another row id/backend is outside that patch.

items.title: OTel Logs 管线与字段映射
items.supports: 构建 LoggerProvider、BatchLogRecordProcessor 与 OTLP log exporter，设置 resource、双 scope、时间、severity、body 与 attributes。
items.titleEn: OTel Logs pipeline and field mapping
items.supportsEn: Builds LoggerProvider, BatchLogRecordProcessor, and OTLP log exporter, setting resource, two scopes, time, severity, body, and attributes.

items.title: Harness-home 匿名 UUID
items.supports: 随机 UUID 尝试按 home 持久并在进程内缓存；持久化收敛后后续进程复用，首次并发有窄竞态，不可写时仅当前进程稳定；它不从主机或网络派生。
items.titleEn: Harness-home anonymous UUID
items.supportsEn: A random UUID is cached per process and persisted per home when possible; later processes reuse it after convergence, concurrent first launch has a narrow race, and an unwritable home is stable only for the current process. It is not host- or network-derived.

items.title: Telemetry backend 的 OTel 依赖面
items.supports: Manifest 声明通用 OTel API、Logs API/SDK、resources、OTLP exporter base 与 OTLP log exporter，不声明 trace 或 metrics SDK。
items.titleEn: OTel dependency surface of the telemetry backend
items.supportsEn: The manifest declares the generic OTel API, Logs API/SDK, resources, the OTLP exporter base, and the OTLP log exporter, with no trace or metrics SDK.

items.title: 真实 SDK 管线到本地 mock collector 的 wire 测试
items.supports: 经真实 OTel SDK 管线向本地 scripted node:http mock collector 发送 OTLP/HTTP JSON，并验证 service.name/user.id、双 scope、source timestamp、severity、session.cwd/event attributes 与 shutdown marker。
items.titleEn: Real SDK-pipeline wire test against a local mock collector
items.supportsEn: Sends OTLP/HTTP JSON through the real OTel SDK pipeline to a local scripted node:http mock collector and verifies service.name/user.id, both scopes, a source timestamp, severity, session.cwd/event attributes, and the shutdown marker.

items.title: Batch ownership 与有界 shutdown
items.supports: Backend 不实现 flush；provider shutdown 与外层 deadline 竞速，deadline 无法取消 SDK transport。
items.titleEn: Batch ownership and bounded shutdown
items.supportsEn: The backend implements no flush; provider shutdown races an outer deadline that cannot cancel the SDK transport.

items.title: Ops error 与 severity 映射
items.supports: Agent error 只保留 name/message；只有 error tool result、error turn/end 与 agent-error 映射为 error severity。
items.titleEn: Ops errors and severity mapping
items.supportsEn: Agent errors retain only name/message; only error tool results, error turn ends, and agent-error map to error severity.

items.title: Live agent error 与 durable turn closure
items.supports: Agent 在重抛前发出带坐标的 live error，driver containment 后仍在 finally 中记录结构化 turn/end。
items.titleEn: Live agent errors and durable turn closure
items.supportsEn: The Agent emits a coordinate-bearing live error before rethrow, contains it at the driver, and still records structured turn/end in finally.

items.title: Host live failure frame
items.supports: 定义只有 session id/message、没有 turn position 的 transient host/agent-error，并称其为该类 live failure 的唯一出口。
items.titleEn: Host live-failure frame
items.supportsEn: Defines transient host/agent-error with session id/message but no turn position, and calls it the only outlet for that class of live failure.

items.title: Telemetry 故障 containment 日志
items.supports: Backend shutdown 与逐步 capture 故障只写本地 warning，不影响 agent loop 或应用 teardown。
items.titleEn: Telemetry-failure containment logs
items.supportsEn: Backend shutdown and per-step capture failures only warn locally and do not affect the agent loop or application teardown.

items.title: 后台持久化失败诊断
items.supports: 后台 write 失败写 warning，并明确 buffered events retained；显式 flush 仍传播失败。
items.titleEn: Background-persistence failure diagnostics
items.supportsEn: Background write failure warns that buffered events are retained, while explicit flush still propagates failure.

items.title: Projection fail-soft 降级
items.supports: session.list 与 subagent.history 的 projection helper 会在失败时记录 warning，并返回 undefined 以继续服务不含 projection block 的响应。
items.titleEn: Fail-soft projection degradation
items.supportsEn: Projection helpers for session.list and subagent.history warn on failure and return undefined so responses continue without the projection block.

items.title: Subagent history 调用 fail-soft projection helper
items.supports: subagent.history 的 live 与 detached tail 都通过 fail-soft helper 计算 projection。
items.titleEn: Subagent history invokes the fail-soft projection helper
items.supportsEn: Both live and detached subagent.history tails compute projections through the fail-soft helper.

items.title: Session list baseline 调用 fail-soft projection helper
items.supports: session.list 的 attached 与 cold summary baseline 都通过 listProjectionsFor 注入可选 projection block。
items.titleEn: Session-list baseline invokes the fail-soft projection helper
items.supportsEn: Both attached and cold session.list summary baselines inject their optional projection block through listProjectionsFor.

items.title: 普通 session history 的直接 projection 路径
items.supports: 普通 session.history cut 直接调用 live snapshot 或 detached restore，没有 list/subagent helper 的 catch。
items.titleEn: Direct projection path for ordinary session history
items.supportsEn: The ordinary session.history cut directly calls the live snapshot or detached restore without the list/subagent helper catches.

items.title: Session-query 完整本地诊断
items.supports: Service boundary 尽力在本地渲染可打印的完整 stack/cause chain，不可打印值使用固定 placeholder，并防守循环 cause 与诊断自身失败。
items.titleEn: Full local session-query diagnostics
items.supportsEn: The service boundary best-effort renders complete printable stack/cause chains locally, uses a fixed placeholder for unprintable values, and contains cyclic causes or diagnostic failure.

items.title: Whole-log stats 契约
items.supports: 定义与客户端分页无关的 turn、step、模型/工具时间、TTFT 与 decode 指标。
items.titleEn: Whole-log stats contract
items.supportsEn: Defines turn, step, model/tool time, TTFT, and decode figures independent of client pagination.

items.title: Session stats 纯 fold
items.supports: 逐事件实现 step、first token、assistant、tool pair 与 turn cleanup 的计数和时序，并防守 usage、clock skew 与 prototype key。
items.titleEn: Pure session-stats fold
items.supportsEn: Implements per-event step, first-token, assistant, tool-pair, and turn-cleanup timing/counting with usage, skew, and prototype-key guards.

items.title: Stats UI 的 projection 优先级
items.supports: UI 优先读取 whole-log sessionStats，缺失时才使用 window fold，并展示 timing、throughput、cache 与 token 信息。
items.titleEn: Stats UI projection precedence
items.supportsEn: The UI prefers whole-log sessionStats, falls back to a window fold only when absent, and displays timing, throughput, cache, and token figures.

items.title: Stats 计数与时序测试
items.supports: 覆盖 rejected/cancelled/max-token/retry、tool pair、无效 usage、clock skew、late mount 与 HMR。
items.titleEn: Stats counting and timing tests
items.supportsEn: Covers rejected, cancelled, max-token, retry, tool pairing, invalid usage, clock skew, late mount, and HMR.

items.title: 分页历史 stats E2E
items.supports: 长历史的 tail page 直接显示 full-session total，load-older 后数值保持不变。
items.titleEn: Paged-history stats E2E
items.supportsEn: A long history's tail page immediately shows full-session totals that remain unchanged after load-older.

items.title: Raw history 分页契约
items.supports: 页面按 message origin 对齐，包含 raw event 与 host view；只有 tail 带 partial/projection，读取不会 resume Agent。
items.titleEn: Raw-history pagination contract
items.supportsEn: Pages align to message origins and include raw events plus host views; only the tail carries partial/projections, and reads never resume an Agent.

items.title: 客户端连续窗口与 gap repair
items.supports: Load-older 检查相邻 sequence，live 按 seq 去重，gap 时 buffer、重拉 tail 并拼接；不连续页与 transport exception 写 console，RPC error result 静默保留窗口。
items.titleEn: Client contiguous window and gap repair
items.supportsEn: Load-older checks adjacent sequences, live data deduplicates by seq, and gaps buffer and repull the tail; discontinuities and transport exceptions log to console, while RPC error results silently preserve the window.

items.title: Raw mux、transient projection 与 remote frame
items.supports: Mux 直接携带 raw session event；projection 是可重算的 transient push；allowlisted remote frame 不做 redaction。
items.titleEn: Raw mux, transient projections, and remote frames
items.supportsEn: The mux carries raw session events, projections are replayable transient pushes, and allowlisted remote frames apply no redaction.

items.title: Trajectory 浏览器视图契约
items.supports: 定义 window-scoped ledger、分页、虚拟化、timeline、inspector、空白 in-flight duration，以及对模型无影响。
items.titleEn: Trajectory browser-view contract
items.supportsEn: Defines a window-scoped ledger with paging, virtualization, timeline, inspector, blank in-flight durations, and no model effect.

items.title: Trajectory snapshot builder
items.supports: 按 raw seq 组合 event node、request、schema、partial、running call、compaction 与 turn error。
items.titleEn: Trajectory snapshot builder
items.supportsEn: Composes event nodes, requests, schemas, partials, running calls, compactions, and turn errors in raw-sequence order.

items.title: Prompt snapshot 与变化检测
items.supports: 从 request/header 重建 config、完整 system 与 tools，并标注 initial/system/tools 变化。
items.titleEn: Prompt snapshots and change detection
items.supportsEn: Reconstructs config, full system text, and tools from request/header and classifies initial/system/tools changes.

items.title: 统一 session-query 服务
items.supports: Exact read/filter/trace 为 backend-independent；完整读取 replay-validate，并提供 surface、lineage、event trace 与 bounded raw window。
items.titleEn: Unified session-query service
items.supportsEn: Exact read/filter/trace behavior is backend-independent; full reads replay-validate and expose surfaces, lineage, event traces, and bounded raw windows.

items.title: Event relationship 与 session lineage
items.supports: 计算 replacement/source/derived 关系、current/shadowed/log-only classification，以及含 unresolved/cycle 语义的 ancestry/descendants。
items.titleEn: Event relationships and session lineage
items.supportsEn: Computes replacement/source/derived links, current/shadowed/log-only classification, and ancestry/descendants with unresolved and cycle semantics.

items.title: Live-preferred logical corpus
items.supports: 单目标 exact load 对已知 live target 不查 persistence；corpus-wide 操作不享有该保证。Persisted exact target 经 list/inspect，仍 detached 才检查 header compatibility，late live attach 则直接胜出。
items.titleEn: Live-preferred logical corpus
items.supportsEn: Single-target exact loads bypass persistence for known live targets, unlike corpus-wide operations. Persisted exact targets list/inspect and check header compatibility only if still detached; a late live attachment wins directly.

items.title: 五个模型侧 session-query 工具
items.supports: 说明五个 opt-in 工具默认不随 host 挂载、exact read 不删节，以及通用 spill policy 的职责。
items.titleEn: Five model-facing session-query tools
items.supportsEn: Documents five opt-in tools not mounted by shipped hosts, unabridged exact reads, and the generic spill policy's responsibility.

items.title: Workspace 授权与 lineage 剪枝
items.supports: Caller 来自 Agent；self 或精确 cwd equality 才授权，observed header 再检查，未授权 subtree 变 null marker。
items.titleEn: Workspace authorization and lineage pruning
items.supportsEn: The caller comes from the Agent; self or exact cwd equality authorizes, observed headers are rechecked, and unauthorized subtrees become null markers.

items.title: 当前 step 的自搜索边界
items.supports: 当前 session 的 event search 把上界截到最近 step/start 之前，并对返回 header 再授权。
items.titleEn: Current-step self-search boundary
items.supportsEn: Current-session event search caps its range before the latest step/start and re-authorizes the returned header.

items.title: 模型边界错误净化
items.supports: 保留 caller cancellation；尽力在本地记录可打印的完整诊断，不可打印时用固定 placeholder；向模型只返回 allowlisted stable code/message 或 generic failure。
items.titleEn: Model-boundary error sanitization
items.supportsEn: Preserves caller cancellation, best-effort logs complete printable diagnostics locally with a fixed placeholder for unprintable values, and exposes only allowlisted stable codes/messages or a generic failure to the model.

items.title: 离开机器的数据与 lineage 说明
items.supports: 枚举上传的消息、工具、文件、prompt、todo、compaction、feedback 与 cwd；无内置 redaction，credential 结构性缺席。
items.titleEn: Data leaving the machine and lineage notes
items.supportsEn: Enumerates uploaded messages, tools, files, prompts, todos, compaction, feedback, and cwd; no built-in redaction exists, while credentials are structurally absent.
